Notre double ambition est d’allier performance et durabilité, pour construire un leadership pérenne. Nos solutions sont une combinaison unique de People et de technologie. Notre plateforme Eki.Decisions complète l’expertise de nos équipes en marketing, efficacité commerciale et data science, pour connecter l’IA aux décisions qui structurent toute l’organisation. Avec une équipe 100% internalisée et des bureaux à Paris, Londres, New York, Hong Kong et Shanghai, nous nous engageons pour une IA responsable et frugale, pour garantir un avantage concurrentiel constant, et pour rester fidèles à nos valeurs et à notre ADN. Vous rejoignez l’équipe Produit – R&PD Au sein de l’équipe R&PD (Research & Product Development) nous concevons et industrialisons des solutions Data & IA SaaS à fort impact business, qui répondent aux enjeux de nos clients grâce à l’analytics, la data science et l’intelligence artificielle. A ce titre, nous recrutons un·e Product Owner pour notre solution Marketing Effectiveness avec pour objectif de structurer la roadmap produit, maximiser son adoption, son time-to-market et la valeur délivrée à nos clients. Votre rôle dans l’équipe Product Owner de notre solution Marketing Effectiveness (Eki.Decisions), vous transformez les besoins business, marché et utilisateurs en fonctionnalités concrètes, documentées et alignées sur une logique de plateforme commune. Vous travaillez au quotidien avec le Product Manager, les équipes engineering et data, ainsi que les équipes projet et delivery, pour construire une solution fiable, adoptée et scalable. Vos principales missions Piloter le backlog et le delivery Structurer, prioriser et maintenir le backlog de la solution Rédiger les user stories, spécifications fonctionnelles et critères d’acceptance Clarifier les besoins avec l’engineering et accompagner chaque livraison de bout en bout Suivre l’avancement, lever les blocages et sécuriser les engagements Animer les rituels agiles : refinement, sprint planning, reviews, rétrospectives, synchronisations produit/tech Rendre la roadmap, les priorités et les arbitrages lisibles pour toutes les parties prenantes Contribuer à la vision produit Co-construire la vision et la roadmap avec le Product Manager Traduire les enjeux business et marché en opportunités produit concrètes : fonctionnalités, parcours utilisateurs, briques mutualisées, standards d’expérience Prioriser selon la valeur business, l’impact client, la contribution à la platformisation et la capacité à accélérer le time-to-market Participer à la product discovery Comprendre les besoins des utilisateurs et des clients sur le Marketing Effectiveness Maîtriser les usages, comportements et règles métier qui font la valeur de la solution Identifier les enjeux fonctionnels et opérationnels : expérience utilisateur, cohérence des parcours, adoption, scalabilité, industrialisation Conduire ou contribuer aux activités de discovery : interviews, retours terrain, analyses d’usage, benchmarks Faire adopter et améliorer en continu Accompagner le déploiement des nouvelles fonctionnalités auprès des parties prenantes clés, avec une communication claire sur ce qui est livré Mesurer l’impact : adoption, satisfaction, valeur délivrée aux clients Animer la boucle de feedback avec les équipes Produit, Business, Tech et Delivery S’appuyer sur les outils de tracking pour monitorer les usages et prioriser de façon data-driven Garantir la qualité : documentation produit, release notes, support, monitoring d’usage Collaborer en transverse Travailler avec les équipes Produit, Tech, Data, IA et Delivery pour assurer la cohérence des solutions émergentes avec la plateforme Servir de relais entre les équipes business, produit, engineering et delivery Participer aux démonstrations, formations internes, retours d’expérience et communications produit Votre profil Expérience 3 ans minimum en tant que Product Owner ou Product Manager Expérience sur des produits SaaS ou digitaux, idéalement dans un environnement data, IA ou tech Compétences Forte appétence business : vous reliez les fonctionnalités à la valeur client et aux enjeux marché Aisance avec les profils tech : vous comprenez les enjeux d’un produit technique, sans avoir besoin d’être développeur·se Maîtrise du backlog : clarifier les besoins, prioriser des sujets complexes, suivre le delivery Logique de plateforme : mutualisation des usages, convergence des solutions, cohérence des parcours Sensibilité forte à l’expérience utilisateur, à l’adoption et à la qualité produit Capacité à vulgariser et à embarquer les parties prenantes autour d’une vision commune Savoir-être Organisé·e, rigoureux·se, autonome, curieux·se et orienté·e impact Langues Français et anglais courants, à l’écrit comme à l’oral Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Chez Ekimetrics, vos idées comptent vraiment et vous appartiennent: à vous de leur donner vie. Nous cultivons un esprit entrepreneurial qui vous encourage à repousser les limites pour créer un impact significatif. Mais il ne s’agit pas seulement de réussites individuelles : nous avançons ensemble, en nous enrichissant mutuellement. Ensemble, nous apprenons et progressons en continu , que ce soit à travers des parcours de carrière personnalisés, des projets stimulants, du mentorat, ou simplement grâce à la diversité des perspectives que chacun.e apporte. Et surtout, nous croyons au plaisir dans le travail. Ekimetrics est un environnement stimulant et bienveillant, où chacun.e peut s’épanouir en étant pleinement soi-même. En 2023, Ekimetrics a obtenu le statut d’entreprise à mission qui témoigne de notre ambition forte en matière de RSE. Notre raison d’être : Faire de la data science et de l’intelligence artificielle l’accélérateur de la transformation durable des organisations. Ekimetrics fait partie du classement French Tech 120 ! Nous avons été sélectionnés par La French Tech pour rejoindre le prestigieux groupe des 120 scale-ups françaises les plus performantes, avec un fort potentiel pour devenir des leaders internationaux. Vous aurez accès : Au catalogue de formation Eki.Academy qui contient des programmes qui vous feront monter en compétences sur nos solutions et nos métiers, des parcours apprenants sur notre plateforme digitale ainsi que des programmes dédiés à nos enjeux prioritaires, dont la sensibilisation aux sujets environnementaux avec la Climate School. A une vie sportive, artistique, musicale, ludique, caritative et engagée : de notre salle de sport privatisée à nos expositions d’art, en passant par des jeux vidéo et des concerts, ou encore les défis RSE sur la plateforme Vendredi. Toutes ces initiatives sont portées par nos Eki.People. De nombreux évènements et séminaires pour rester proche de votre communauté. Des locaux chaleureux dans un quartier dynamique au cœur de Paris (Grands boulevards). Une politique de télétravail flexible, avec 3 jours de présence obligatoire par tranche de 15 jours. En tant qu’employeur, Ekimetrics offre à tous les mêmes opportunités d’accès à l’emploi sans distinction de genre, ethnicité, religion, orientation sexuelle, statut social, handicap et d’âge. Ekimetrics veille à développer un environnement de travail inclusif qui reflète la diversité dans ses équipes. Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Performance Engineer, Kernel and Memory
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3>Available Locations</h3> <ul> <li>Austin, US</li> <li>New York, NY</li> <li>Washington DC</li> </ul> <h3><strong>About the Role</strong></h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we have our eyes set on an ambitious goal: to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers approximately 25 million Internet properties, for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. </p> <p>We realize people do not fit into neat boxes. We are looking for curious and empathetic individuals who are committed to developing themselves and learning new skills, and we are ready to help you do that. We cannot complete our mission without building a diverse and inclusive team. We hire the best people based on an evaluation of their potential and support them throughout their time at Cloudflare. Come join us! </p> <p><strong>About the Department</strong></p> <p>Cloudflare’s engineering teams build and maintain the systems and products that power our global platform. A global platform which is within approximately 50 milliseconds of about 95% of the Internet connected population, serving on average, over 46 million HTTP requests per second.</p> <p><strong>About the Team</strong></p> <p>Delivering this platform with high performance and efficiency depends on advanced Linux kernel and hardware capabilities, and that is where this team works.</p> <p>The Performance Team owns overall system and application performance across that fleet: resource optimization, instrumentation, and the tooling that lets us see what the hardware is actually doing. System memory sits alongside CPU cycles, network processing, and storage IOPS as a first-class resource, and how the kernel manages it is increasingly the thing that decides how hot we can safely run every machine we own.</p> <p>We work upstream first. Several of us maintain or regularly contribute to the Linux kernel, and our default is to fix problems in mainline rather than carry private patches. This role is built on that principle.</p> <p><strong>The problem you would own</strong></p> <p>Using memory efficiently is one of the highest-leverage problems we have. At our scale, how the kernel's memory-management subsystem behaves under pressure has direct consequences for both performance and cost. As DRAM prices climb, getting more out of the memory we already own is a real lever on infrastructure spend.</p> <p>Using custom low-overhead instrumentation on production servers, we have identified several scalability bottlenecks in the kernel memory layer that show up under real workloads. We are looking for an expert to take on these problems, fix them against production workloads, and drive the changes upstream. Solving them lifts efficiency and latency across the entire fleet rather than in one place.</p> <p><strong>What you will do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Diagnose and fix performance and scalability bottlenecks in the Linux kernel memory-management subsystem, informed by real production telemetry at a scale few environments can offer.</li> <li>Land your work upstream. We expect MM changes to go to mainline first and want you to keep doing the maintainership and review work that earns standing in the community.</li> <li>Build and extend low-overhead kernel instrumentation (tracepoints, BPF, perf) so we keep measuring before we change, and prove the impact afterwards.</li> <li>Partner with kernel, networking, storage, and product engineers across the company to turn observed system behavior into concrete MM improvements.</li> <li>Set technical direction for how Cloudflare uses, tunes, and evolves kernel memory management as we push utilization higher.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Requirements</strong></p> <ul> <li>Deep expertise in the Linux kernel memory-management subsystem: the page allocator, virtual memory and memory mapping, reclaim, and the locking and concurrency that hold it together.</li> <li>A track record of upstream Linux contribution, ideally including maintainership or sustained work in MM or an adjacent subsystem.</li> <li>Strong systems programming in C, with the judgement to make high-risk changes to shared infrastructure safely.</li> <li>Ability to dive deep into a complex codebase while keeping the fleet-wide picture in mind, and to own a problem and its outcome rather than a single patch.</li> <li>Clear communication with engineers across many teams, since the symptoms of an MM problem usually show up far from the MM code.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonuses</strong></p> <ul> <li>Strong understanding of Linux kernel internals pertaining to memory management</li> <li>Experience troubleshooting and resolving performance issues in large-scale distributed systems.</li> <li>Experience with large scale configuration/deployment management.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodat

title: Director of Engineering, KYX
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><strong>A</strong><strong>BOUT TIDE</strong></h3> <p>At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.</p> <p>Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France.</p> <p>Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.</p> <p><strong>Tide facts:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs</li> <li>Over 2 million members across UK and India</li> <li>Over $300 million raised in funding</li> <li>Over 2,800 Tideans globally</li> <li>Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India’s Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026</li> <li>We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg</li> </ul></div><h3>ABOUT THE ROLE:</h3> <p>Tide is hiring a Director of Engineering to lead the engineering organisation behind KYX (KYC and KYB). Our vision for KYX is a world where every genuine business, business owner, their team, and everyone connected to them, onboards to Tide in minutes, unlocks the products they need as they grow, and never has to think twice about their data, while we identify bad actors, stop them at the door, continuously review their activity and off-board them the moment they're found.</p> <p>You will be accountable for engineering strategy, organisation and execution across three domains. Onboarding KYX covers identity and access for registration and login, due diligence policy execution and vendor orchestration across the onboarding journey, and the risk scoring and agentic AI that assesses new applicants. Continuous KYX covers ongoing due diligence through periodic and event-triggered reviews, and how business owners bring their own team members onto their account. Risk Scoring is the KYX Scoring & ML team whose models power decisions across both domains.</p> <p>This role sits at the intersection of regulated risk operations, member-facing conversion and applied AI. KYX Ops and KYX Policy set the rules you build for, Second Line of Defence sets the risk appetite, and our regulators set the bar. We need someone who can raise onboarding conversion and due diligence quality while driving the cost of KYX servicing per member down, and who can scale agentic solutions into workflows where a wrong answer has consequences for a member and for Tide.<br><br>As Director of Engineering, KYX you will</p> <ul> <li>Own the engineering strategy and organisation for KYX, from onboarding identity, access and due diligence through continuous monitoring to risk scoring, unifying leadership that today sits in separate Onboarding and Continuous KYX lines.</li> <li>Lead engineering across backend, frontend, data science and ML engineering, distributed across Hyderabad, Delhi, Sofia, Belgrade, Bucharest and Vilnius.</li> <li>Own KYX Scoring & ML as a shared capability serving both onboarding and ongoing decisioning, including the model lifecycle end to end from development through backtesting and staged rollout to production monitoring.</li> <li>Scale agentic AI in regulated workflows, from onboarding risk scoring through to screening, review and verification, in line with Tide's agentic governance framework.</li> <li>Work with KYX Ops, KYX Policy, Second Line of Defence and Product across the UK, EU and India, and with IAM on the still-to-be-sharpened boundary around login and access.</li> <li>Deliver measurable outcomes: higher automated decisioning rates, better due diligence and screening quality, and a falling KYX cost per member.</li> <li>Build once, deploy globally, and keep market-specific logic isolated.</li> </ul> <p>This is one of the most important engineering roles at Tide. You will shape how quickly and how well we onboard members, how confidently we scale into new markets under our own licences, and how far applied AI can compound into a lasting advantage in a regulated environment.</p> <h3>WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:</h3> <ul> <li>Experience leading engineering organisations in identity, onboarding, fraud, financial crime or another regulated decisioning domain.</li> <li>Strong track record of turning platform investment into measurable outcomes: conversion, due diligence quality, unit economics and workflow automation.</li> <li>Experience taking title: AI Enablement Consultant (m/w/d)
description: Viele Teams haben AI Tools zur Verfügung und wissen nicht, wie sie anfangen sollen. Bei uns bist du die erste Person, die sie kennenlernen. Du holst sie im Training ab, lässt sie selbst ausprobieren und findest mit ihnen die Stellen, an denen AI ihre Arbeit spürbar leichter macht. WE BUILD AI ist eine AI Beratung mit eigenem Engineering in Köln. Wir sind rund zehn Leute und arbeiten mit Mittelstand und Enterprise. Unser Anspruch geht über den Chat hinaus: Wir bringen AI dorthin, wo sie in Prozessen und in der Wertschöpfung wirkt. Deine Rolle Den Großteil deiner Zeit verbringst du in Trainings und Workshops bei unseren Kund:innen. Dabei entstehen Listen an Pain Points sowie potenzielle Use Cases, von denen du die vielversprechendsten in unsere Discovery Sprints bringst. Das sind kurze, intensive Formate, in denen wir mit Fachbereichen herausfinden, wo AI den größten Hebel hat. Ob deine Arbeit wirkt, siehst du daran, wie viele Teams nach dem Training dranbleiben und wie viele Projekte daraus wachsen. Enablement ist ein neuer Bereich bei uns, und du gestaltest ihn von Anfang an mit. Aufgaben Du gibst Trainings und Workshops, in denen Teams AI selbst ausprobieren und erste Anwendungen bauen. Was bei Teams ankommt, fließt bei dir direkt in die nächste Version unserer Formate und Unterlagen. Aus Trainings und Gesprächen sammelst du Use Cases und bewertest sie nach Nutzen und Machbarkeit. Manche schafft ein Team allein, andere brauchen ein größeres Projekt mit uns. In Discovery Sprints moderierst du Workshops und führst Interviews mit Fachbereichen, Führungskräften und den Menschen, die täglich mit dem Prozess arbeiten. Mit Fachbereichsleitungen und Geschäftsführung sprichst du auf Augenhöhe und erkennst früh, wo ein Folgeprojekt sinnvoll ist. Angebote, Methoden und Vorlagen für den Bereich Enablement baust du mit auf. Qualifikation Trainings geben macht dir Freude, auch wenn es das vierte im Monat ist. Gruppen vom Fachteam bis zur Geschäftsführung bringst du zum Mitmachen, und kritische Rückfragen nimmst du gelassen. Du weißt, wie Sprachmodelle funktionieren und wo ihre Grenzen liegen. So bleiben deine Use Cases realistisch. Moderation und Interviews liegen dir: Du hörst zu, fragst nach und fasst so zusammen, dass Entscheidungen möglich werden. Du hast Lust, etwas aufzubauen, für das es noch keine Vorlage gibt. Idealerweise kommst du aus einem der Bereiche Training, Beratung, Learning & Development, Change Management oder agilem Coaching. Benefits Benefit-Budget von 30 Euro pro Monat für Gutscheine bei 100+ Anbietern, Urban Sports Club oder als Mobilitätszuschuss fürs Deutschlandticket. Dienstrad-Leasing per Gehaltsumwandlung, bis zu 40 Prozent Ersparnis. Vollkasko und Wartung inklusive. Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Homeoffice nach eigener Verantwortung. Flache Hierarchien und kurze Entscheidungswege. Mentoring und ehrliches Feedback, das dich weiterbringt. Regelmäßige Teamevents, gemeinsame Workations und Bürohunde. Kostenlose Getränke und Snacks im Büro in Ehrenfeld. Unser Bewerbungsprozess: Kennenlern-Call mit Mounir und Frederic, ca. 30 Minuten. Wir reden über dich, über uns und schauen, ob die Grundlage stimmt. Probeaufgabe für zuhause plus Vorstellung im Call, 45 bis 60 Minuten. Du arbeitest an einer technischen Aufgabe, die zu dem passt, was du bei uns wirklich machen würdest. Kennenlernen vor Ort in Köln. Gemeinsames Essen, Einblicke in unsere Projekte und Sparring mit dem Team. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Data Scientist - Intern
description: About Mirakl: Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy. Today, Mirakl's operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus). With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy's, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways. For more information: www.mirakl.com . Mirakl in Numbers: 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo 🇫🇷 350+ Mirakl Tech teams members mainly based in France ⚙️ 5 Saas Solutions Our Values: Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique. Our 5 values guide how we collaborate: 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success 🏆 Get Things Done: We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results 🚀 Go Above & Beyond: We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success Data Science Intern - January 2027 1. The Team You'll Join You'll be part of our Data Science team, a group of around 70 data professionals working at the heart of Mirakl's platform. Together, you'll be making the most of rich and diverse marketplace data to grow customer revenue, optimize operations, and ensure the safety of users and transactions. 2. Your Impact Analyze and prepare data to ensure quality and relevance for algorithm development, following best practices for exploration and transformation Prototype and iterate on algorithms , testing and refining ideas with the support of your mentor and team Collaborate with Data Engineers to bring your solutions from experimentation to real-world production deployment Build dashboards to showcase the relevance of your work and monitor performance in production Present your findings weekly with the team, contributing to brainstorming sessions and tech watch initiatives 3. What You'll Bring to the Role Experience: Currently enrolled in the final year of a Master's (Bac+5) in Computer Science at an engineering school or university Familiarity with data preparation techniques and feature engineering Understanding of statistics, machine learning, and deep learning algorithms Interest in the industrialization and scaling of data science models beyond experimental work Skills: Cloud environment awareness (AWS, Google Cloud, or MS Azure) Strong communication and ability to work collaboratively in cross-functional teams Curiosity, autonomy, and a proactive approach to problem-solving 4. Tech Stack Python & its data science ecosystem (pandas,sklearn), SQL for data querying and manipulation, TensorFlow, Keras, PyTorch, Databricks, Spark, AWS (Amazon Redshift, S3), Airflow, Delta Lake, streamlit, pydantic 5. Languages French – Fluent required English – Professional level required 6. Compensation, Perks & Benefits Internship stipend: Based on your Master's status Perks & Benefits: A workplace that supports well-being and balance: breakfasts, fitness and yoga classes, after-work events, game nights Mentoring from senior technical experts and regular feedback to support your growth Immersion in a collaborative, international team passionate about sharing knowledge 2 remote work days per month Access to Works Council discounts (tickets, etc.) Gymlib pass for your well-being Modern offices in the heart of Paris (near the Eiffel Tower) Swile meal vouchers Transportation covered (50% Navigo, bike, etc.) 7. Our Hiring Process We warmly encourage you to apply to any of our roles, even if you think you're not an exact match. Please click the "Apply" button to submit your application — this helps us make the best possible assessment and get back to you as quickly as possible. Manual screening of your CV by a recruiter, followed by an AI-powered screening conversation (10 min) with Emma, Mirakl's AI Talent Ambassador, to explore your background and motivation for the role. You will need to complete this step within 3 days , otherwise we won't be able to move forward with your application. Interview with your future manager — Pierre Lourdelet , Data Scientist Interview with a future colleague, using structured STAR-method interviews to ensure transparency and fairness. Welcome to Mirakl! 🎉 This is an internship position based in Paris, with up to two days of remote work permitted per month. We welcome collaborators with their diverse perspectives and experiences to power us forward. These often far exceed conventional job requirements and help us create a culture of continuous learning. If you're ready to join a global leader powering digital transformation for 450+ of the world's most innovative retailers and B2B organizations. As part of our recruitment process, Mirakl processes your personal data to review and manage your application and, where appropriate, to consider your profile for future opportunities. You can exercise your data protection rights at any time, and as further detailed in our policies. For more information about how we process your personal data and your rights, please consult our Recruitment Privacy Notice, here in English and here in French. We may use Artificial Intelligence (AI) solutions to help streamline our hiring process, including screening applications, analyzing resumes, and assessing responses. While AI helps us work efficiently, all final hiring decisions are made by humans. For more information, visit our AI Guidelines for Candidates and Interviews . description: Commercial(e) terrain indépendant(e) – SumUp Vous avez une réelle expérience de la prospection à froid, sur le terrain ou par téléphone ? Rejoignez SumUp et accompagnez les commerçants avec des solutions de paiement simples et reconnues. Vos missions Prospecter les cafés, restaurants, boutiques, salons et entreprises de votre secteur ; Identifier leurs besoins, présenter la solution adaptée et réaliser des démonstrations ; Accompagner les commerçants jusqu'à l'activation et développer votre portefeuille. La prospection est réalisée par vos soins : aucun portefeuille de leads n'est fourni. Votre rémunération Cette activité est rémunérée exclusivement à la commission, sans salaire fixe ni plafond : 50 % de commission immédiate sur le matériel, les logiciels et les paiements générés par le commerçant au cours de son premier mois ; 20 % de revenus récurrents sur l'activité de chaque commerçant signé, versés mensuellement pendant une durée pouvant aller jusqu'à 24 mois. Exemple : un commerçant actif générant environ 15 000 € de volume de paiement mensuel peut vous permettre de percevoir plus de 1 000 € de commissions cumulées sur 24 mois. Ce montant indicatif varie selon les produits vendus, l'activation, le volume réel et le maintien de l'activité du commerçant. Aucun revenu minimum n'est garanti. Vos outils et votre organisation SumUp fournit une formation initiale, un terminal de démonstration et des supports commerciaux. Un référent de secteur reste disponible pour vous accompagner. Votre zone est définie pendant le recrutement selon votre localisation et les secteurs ouverts. Vous organisez librement votre activité. Vos déplacements et les frais associés restent à votre charge ; aucun véhicule de fonction n'est fourni. Votre profil Au moins un an d'expérience en prospection à froid, terrain ou téléphonique, au cours des six dernières années ; À l'aise dans une démarche commerciale proactive auprès de professionnels ; Autonome, persévérant(e), fiable et orienté(e) résultats ; Disponible au moins trois jours par semaine ; Numéro SIRET valide au démarrage. Processus de recrutement Échange téléphonique avec notre équipe recrutement ; Entretien avec le ou la référente de votre secteur ; Décision rapide fondée sur votre expérience et votre motivation. title: Data analytics engineer
description: Hybrid working one day per week in our London, Edinburgh or Bath office. About us Seccl is the Octopus-owned embedded investment platform, on a mission to help more people invest, and invest well. We’re building the infrastructure behind the next generation of investing. Our technology already powers some of the UK’s most ambitious fintechs, banks, financial advisers and wealth firms, with close to a million investors relying on Seccl-powered platforms. And we’re now expanding into Europe. We’ve got a proven product, strong momentum and big ambitions for what comes next: helping more household-name brands launch and scale investment propositions, entering new markets and replacing outdated investment infrastructure with technology that’s faster, simpler and built for scale. We’re proud to be part of Octopus, one of the UK’s most successful privately held investment and technology groups. That gives us the backing and long-term perspective to build something substantial, while keeping the pace and energy of a high-growth business. Seccl and Octopus are both B Corp certified and share a belief that profit and purpose should go hand in hand. If you want to help shape the future of investing in the UK and across Europe, you’ll be in good company. Check out the Seccl website to see what we’re building and read more about our mission to shape the future of investments. The role Seccl is growing fast, and so is the opportunity to make better use of our data. Our Data Engineering team has built strong foundations for reliable, scalable data delivery, and we’re now expanding our capabilities to make that data more accessible, actionable, and valuable to our teams and clients. As a Data Analytics Engineer, you’ll sit at the intersection of data engineering and analytics. You’ll use strong software engineering and data modelling practices to develop production-quality datasets, while working closely with stakeholders to understand how data can help solve real business problems. You’ll also help us evolve how data moves through our platform, including opportunities to work with streaming and event-driven technologies as we move towards more timely and incremental data processing. On a typical day you will be… Designing, building, and maintaining robust data models using SQL and DBT, transforming complex source data into clear, reusable datasets for analytics and downstream consumers Working with Product managers, Engineers, Operations, and client-facing teams to understand requirements, clarify business logic, and translate problems into scalable data solutions Helping define and maintain consistent metrics, modelling standards, and analytical best practices across the business Supporting our journey towards more real-time and incremental data processing, including working with technologies such as MongoDB change streams, Kafka, and AWS MSK Helping teams become more self-sufficient with data by making datasets understandable, well documented, and easy to consume You’ll be successful in this role if you… Have strong SQL and data modelling skills and are comfortable transforming large, complex datasets into reliable, reusable analytical models Have experience with Python and modern analytics engineering tooling such as DBT, including testing, documentation, version control, and CI/CD practices Are familiar with both relational and non-relational database architecture Understand dimensional modelling and how to design datasets that are intuitive and effective for analytics, BI, and downstream data products Have experience working with cloud data platforms and services, ideally within AWS Ideally have experience with event-driven or streaming data architectures, particularly Kafka/AWS MSK, MongoDB change streams, CDC, or similar technologies title: Head of GTM, AI Inference
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2>Available Locations</h2> <ul> <li>New York, US</li> <li>San Francisco, US</li> </ul> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p data-path-to-node="4">Cloudflare is building one of the most differentiated AI inference platforms in the market. We are looking for a leader to partner across our organization and own the go-to-market strategy for this business.</p> <p data-path-to-node="5">As Head of GTM, AI Inference, you will serve as key connective tissue between our cutting-edge AI infrastructure, our product teams, and the global market. You will work directly with Workers AI prospects evaluating Cloudflare as a source of GPU capacity, partner with product leadership to shape how we position and package our inference capabilities, and build the analytical frameworks that help us target the right strategic customers and partners.</p> <p data-path-to-node="6">In this role, you will help craft our operational playbook, test it against real market signals, and iterate as the landscape shifts. You will bring equal comfort building financial models for inference unit economics and engaging in strategic, consultative conversations with technical leaders and CTOs.</p> <h2>Responsibilities</h2> <h3>Market Strategy & Positioning</h3> <ul> <li> <p data-path-to-node="9,0,0">Lead Cloudflare's GTM strategy for AI inference, defining how we compete beyond the commoditized GPU/hour model.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="9,1,0">Develop and continuously refine our positioning around Cloudflare's structural advantages: serverless GPU pricing, edge-distributed infrastructure, and integration with the broader developer platform (Workers, R2, D1, Agents SDK).</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="9,2,0">Identify and evaluate customer and partner segments where Cloudflare's inference model creates disproportionate value, prioritizing focus areas for maximum impact.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="9,3,0">Guide promotional strategies with key model partners to accelerate the adoption of new models and inference capacity.</p> </li> </ul> <h3>Strategic Sales & Revenue</h3> <ul> <li> <p data-path-to-node="11,0,0">Partner directly with Workers AI prospects and high-value accounts evaluating Cloudflare for GPU capacity and inference workloads.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="11,1,0">Lead strategic sales conversations, helping prospects understand the architectural and economic advantages of our approach.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="11,2,0">Collaborate with Sales and Developer GTM leadership to build repeatable qualification frameworks and deal structures for inference revenue.</p> </li> </ul> <h3>Market Intelligence & Cross-Functional Leadership</h3> <ul> <li> <p data-path-to-node="13,0,0">Serve as Cloudflare's primary listener and synthesizer for inference market signals: pricing shifts, competitive moves, model ecosystem changes, and emerging workload patterns.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="13,1,0">Facilitate internal alignment across Product, Strategy, Engineering, and GTM leadership to translate market intelligence into clear product and commercial decisions.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="13,2,0">Partner with the AI Gateway / Models Marketplace team to align strategy across both the hosting and consumption sides of the model ecosystem—ensuring our GTM motion is coherent across all channels.</p> </li> </ul> <h3>Analytics & Business Rigor</h3> <ul> <li> <p data-path-to-node="15,0,0">Build the analytical foundations for the inference business: unit economics models, customer segmentation frameworks, win/loss analysis, and pipeline forecasting.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="15,1,0">Define and track meaningful business metrics for an inference platform at our stage—focusing on sustainable growth, product-market fit, and revenue quality.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="15,2,0">Utilize data-informed insights to guide strategy, test hypotheses, and adapt approach as market dynamics evolve.</p> </li> </ul> <h2>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h2> <p>At Cloudflare, we know that great candidates come from diverse backgrounds with non-linear paths. If you are excited about building a better Internet and ready to make an impact, please apply.</p> <ul> <li> <p data-path-to-node="17,0,0"><strong data-path-to-node="17,0,0" data-index-in-node="0">GTM prospective partners.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="17,4,0"><strong data-path-to-node="17,4,0" data-index-in-node="0">Adaptability:</strong> Comfort navigating fast-evolving markets, making title: Deal Desk Manager, EMEA
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: </strong>Lisbon </p> <hr> <h4><strong>About the Deal Desk Team:</strong></h4> <p>The Deal Desk team is a critical component of the Finance function, acting as a strategic partner to the global Sales organization. We are responsible for partnering with sales to structure, negotiate, and close complex deals. We ensure that deals meet the requirements of "good business" while also keeping our customers' best interest in mind. We are committed to building a data-centric and AI-augmented Deal Desk that leverages predictive analytics and automated workflows to optimize pricing in real-time and automate routine approvals, allowing for deeper strategic focus.</p> <p><strong>Role Summary:</strong></p> <p>As a Deal Desk Manager, you will be the architect of our AI-driven deal desk, transitioning our sales process from manual workflows to an intelligent, automated engine that spans from initial scoping to final execution. By leveraging agentic workflows and automated data layers, the focus shifts to high-judgment architecture for non-standard enterprise deals. The objective is to serve as a high-influence "Sales Co-pilot," using AI-driven insights to maximize deal velocity and Long-Term Value (LTV) while relentlessly reducing friction through iterative process automation.</p> <p><strong>What you’ll do:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Orchestrate Strategic Deal Architecture: Lead the structuring and execution of non-standard, high-value enterprise deals, providing high-judgment guidance that balances competitive differentiation with long-term business health.</li> <li>Sales Co-pilot & Strategic Influence: Serve as a strategic partner to Sales leadership, utilizing AI-driven data to maximize deal velocity, improve LTV, and ensure discovery reflects true customer needs. Perform analysis on pricing and deal terms, leveraging AI insights to recommend "next best action" for deal structuring and margin optimization.</li> <li>Curate and Tune AI Agents: Manage the enterprise deal approval ecosystem by tuning automated agents and models to ensure compliance and accuracy at scale.</li> <li>Drive Process Iteration: Partner with cross-functional teams (Legal, Finance, Product) to build, streamline, and automate deal desk processes, architecting autonomous approval workflows and focusing on reducing field friction through relentless automation.</li> <li>Champion AI & Automation Integration: Champion the integration of LLMs and generative AI tools to automate deal desk workflows, significantly reducing deal cycle times. Identify bottlenecks and implement AI-powered productivity solutions.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Required Skills & Experience:</strong></p> <ul> <li>6-8+ years of Deal Desk, FP&A, Revenue Operations, or similar experience, with a proven track record of supporting large-scale enterprise sales motions; 3+ years of deal desk experience preferred.</li> <li>Financial & Sales Acumen: Solid understanding of SaaS metrics, pricing models, and financial concepts like ARR, Gross Margin, churn, and profitability. Experience with revenue recognition principles (e.g., ASC 606) is highly desirable. Experience selling software is a bonus.</li> <li>Contract & Pricing Knowledge: Experience drafting and interpreting commercial contracts, with a focus on terms that impact revenue recognition and financial risk. Ability to analyze and recommend the best course of action for complex pricing and licensing situations.</li> <li>Data & AI Literacy: Proficiency in leveraging agentic workflows and prompt engineering to scale influence, extract insights from large datasets, and automate repetitive operational tasks and internal documentation.</li> <li>Algorithmic Thinking: The ability to understand and audit automated pricing models to ensure alignment with long-term company goals.</li> <li>Strategic Influence: Demonstrated ability to navigate complex, cross-functional negotiations and make high-judgment decisions in fast-paced environments.</li> <li>Process Design Mindset: A relentless focus on iterative automation and the ability to translate complex business policies into streamlined, automated logic.</li> <li>Communication Excellence: Exceptional written and oral communication skills, capable of explaining complex deal structures and financial data to both technical and executive stakeholders.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice-to-Have Skills:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience in software sales or sales operations, providing a "boots on the ground" perspective of the sales cycle.</li> <li>Deep knowledge of Cloud/SaaS infrastructure and the global cybersecurity competitive landscape.</li> </ul> <p>If you're excited by fast-paced innovation, dedicated to driving global growth, and want to help build a better internet, we'd love to hear from you.</p> <p><strong> </strong></p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Sitting within the GTM organization and reporting to a Customer Engineering Leader, you will not hand off your customers once an initial agreement is reached. Proactively monitor customer health scores and telemetry to ensure rapid time-to-value, resolve integration bottlenecks, and reduce deployment risk.</li> <li><strong>Commercial Accountability & Expansion: </strong>Carry a variable quota tied directly to new business acquisition and/or ongoing account growth. Be commercially accountable for ensuring deep platform adoption, retaining revenue, and identifying strategic cross-sell and up-sell opportunities based on product usage data. Lead technical Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to translate platform capabilities into return on investment for C-level executives.</li> <li><strong>Trusted Advisory: </strong>Act as a trusted technical advisor throughout the entire customer lifecycle, maintaining a continuous, deep relationship with key stakeholders from initial onboarding through maturity, renewal, and expansion. Provide thought partnership on architecture, AI control layers, security posture, and deployment confidence. Identify potential deployment risks or integration bottlenecks early, and provide remediation strategies to de-risk customer outcomes. </li> <li><strong>AI Orchestration & Workflow Automation: </strong>Leverage AI agents, Large Language Models (LLMs), and internal platforms to automate routine tasks such as RFP/Security Questionnaire responses, sandbox provisioning, basic telemetry monitoring, and internal/external documentation, reclaiming your time for strategic customer advisory.</li> <li><strong>Education & Enablement:</strong> Partner closely with the Enablement Team to design, build, and govern technical resources. Define, document, and educate both internal teams and customers on deliverables such as Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), architectural best practices, and technical guides to continuously raise the technical baseline across the organization.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Minimum Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience: Experience in a customer-facing technical role, such as Solutions Engineering, Customer Engineering, Professional Services,  Sales Engineering, Technical Account Management, or as a Forward Deployed Engineer (years of experience required will vary based on Associate, Senior, Staff, or Principal leveling).</li> <li>Architectural Mindset: Ability to white-board, design, and articulate complex enterprise network and security architectures clearly.</li> <li>Consultative & Advisory Skills: Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate deeply technical concepts into business outcomes for both hands-on engineers and C-level executives.</li> <li>Commercial Mindset: Proven track record of operating in a quota-carrying or revenue-aligned environment, with a strong understanding of SaaS metrics, business value translation, and enterprise sales cycles.</li> <li>Communication: Exceptional presentation and stakeholder management skills, capable of bridging the gap between deep technical implementation details and high-level C-suite business strategy.</li> <li>Technical Breadth: We do not expect every candidate to be an expert in every domain. Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Pulumi), CI/CD pipelines, and observability for developer-led deployments.</li> </ul> </ul> <p><strong>Strongly Preferred Qualifications (The "Good-to-Haves")</strong></p> <ul> <li>Technical Enablement: Track record of creating and delivering technical enablement - workshops, code samples, documentation, or developer onboarding - that accelerates customer adoption of complex platforms. </li> <li>Applied AI Knowledge: Experience with LLM orchestration, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures, and model-access controls.</li> <li>Regulatory Knowledge: Understanding of regulatory requirements such as PCI DSS, HIPAA, and SOC 2.</li> <li>Hyperscaler / Digital Native Background: Talent coming out of hyperscalers, digital natives, distributed systems environments, or startups is strongly valued for its deeper cloud fluency and advanced architecture depth.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Education</strong></p> <p>Undergraduate or graduate degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. </p> <p><strong>Travel</strong></p> <p>This role may require travel up to 20–50% to attend customer meetings, conferences, industry events, and in-person team collaboration.</p> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>Thi

description: Stellenbeschreibung Du gewinnst die richtigen Menschen und übernimmst Verantwortung für alles, was danach kommt? Pammys ist in wenigen Jahren auf über eine Million Kundinnen und Kunden gewachsen. Unsere Logistik sorgt täglich dafür, dass unsere Produkte zuverlässig bei ihnen ankommen. Dafür brauchen wir starke Mitarbeitende und eine Personalarbeit, die vorausdenkt, Entscheidungen voranbringt und im Alltag funktioniert. Als Senior HR People & Talent Partner (m/w/d) übernimmst du die operative Personalarbeit für unseren Lagerstandort in Lensahn. Du gewinnst neue Talente, begleitest Mitarbeitende über den gesamten Beschäftigungszeitraum und unterstützt Führungskräfte bei anspruchsvollen Personalentscheidungen. Gleichzeitig entwickelst du HR-Prozesse und setzt Projekte eigenständig um. Dein Arbeitsplatz ist in unserem Hamburger Office . Zweimal im Monat bist du vor Ort in Lensahn. Du bist Teil unseres HR-Teams und arbeitest eng mit unserer Head of HR, dem COO und unserem Head of Logistics zusammen. Deine Aufgaben Recruiting ganzheitlich verantworten: Du steuerst die Personalgewinnung für Lensahn – von der vorausschauenden Bedarfsplanung über Stellenausschreibungen, aktive Kandidatenansprache und Interviews bis zur Einstellung. Neue Recruiting-Wege erschließen: Du findest geeignete Kanäle für die Gewinnung gewerblicher Mitarbeitender, setzt neue Maßnahmen um und entwickelst eine verlässliche Bewerberpipeline. Dabei behältst du Bewerberqualität und Besetzungsgeschwindigkeit im Blick. Führungskräfte als Sparringspartner unterstützen: Du erkennst personellen Handlungsbedarf frühzeitig, gibst klare Empfehlungen und entwickelst gemeinsam mit COO und Head of Logistics pragmatische Lösungen für den Lageralltag. Employee Relations aktiv gestalten: Du bist eine zentrale Ansprechperson für Mitarbeitende und Führungskräfte, klärst Personalfragen und begleitest auch anspruchsvolle Gespräche und Konfliktsituationen souverän. Arbeitsrechtliche Personalthemen steuern: Du ordnest Sachverhalte ein, bereitest erforderliche Maßnahmen vor und setzt sie in Abstimmung mit der Head of HR um. Dazu gehören Veränderungen im Arbeitsverhältnis, der Umgang mit Pflichtverletzungen und die professionelle Begleitung von Trennungsprozessen. Verträge und Fristen im Griff behalten: Du erstellst und koordinierst Arbeitsverträge, Verlängerungen, Zusatzvereinbarungen und weitere Personaldokumente. Du sorgst dafür, dass anstehende Entscheidungen frühzeitig vorbereitet und relevante Fristen eingehalten werden. Personio und digitale Personalakten aufbauen: Du strukturierst die Personalverwaltung für Lensahn in Personio, sorgst für vollständige Unterlagen und aktuelle Stammdaten und etablierst verlässliche digitale Abläufe. HR-Projekte vorantreiben: Du identifizierst Verbesserungspotenziale und verantwortest größere standortbezogene Projekte – von der Konzeption bis zur Umsetzung. Dazu gehören beispielsweise ein strukturiertes Onboarding, die Digitalisierung von Personalprozessen und einheitliche Standards für die Zusammenarbeit zwischen HR und Logistik. Den gesamten Mitarbeiterzyklus begleiten: Du stellst sicher, dass vom Eintritt bis zum Austritt alle personellen und administrativen Schritte ineinandergreifen und das Offboarding vollständig abgeschlossen wird. Dein Profil Mehrjährige fundierte Erfahrung im operativen HR-Management mit eigenständiger Verantwortung für Recruiting, Personalbetreuung und arbeitsrechtliche Themen. Ein abgeschlossenes Studium mit Schwerpunkt Personalmanagement, Wirtschaftsrecht, Betriebswirtschaft oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation mit einschlägiger Berufserfahrung. Nachweisbare Recruiting-Erfolge , idealerweise bei der Gewinnung gewerblicher Mitarbeitender in Logistik, Lager, Produktion oder einem vergleichbaren Umfeld. Fundierte Kenntnisse im deutschen Arbeitsrecht und praktische Erfahrung mit anspruchsvollen Personalfällen. Du kannst Handlungsmöglichkeiten bewerten und erkennst, wann eine zusätzliche rechtliche Prüfung erforderlich ist. Erfahrung darin, Führungskräfte zu beraten, klare Empfehlungen auszusprechen und schwierige Personalgespräche professionell zu führen. Nachweisbare Erfahrung in der eigenständigen Umsetzung von HR-Projekten und im Aufbau funktionierender Personalprozesse. Einen sicheren Umgang mit Personio oder einem vergleichbaren HR-System sowie hohe Sorgfalt bei Verträgen, Daten und Dokumentation. Eigeninitiative und einen hohen Anspruch an deine Ergebnisse: Du wartest nicht auf Aufgaben, sondern erkennst Handlungsbedarf, setzt Prioritäten und bringst Themen verbindlich zum Abschluss. Die Bereitschaft, Verantwortung bis ins operative Detail zu übernehmen – vom Recruiting-Konzept bis zur vollständigen Personalakte. Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sowie die Bereitschaft, zweimal im Monat unseren Standort in Lensahn zu besuchen. Deine Vorteile bei Pammys Ein eigener Verantwortungsbereich: Du gestaltest die Personalarbeit für unseren Lagerstandort und beeinflusst unmittelbar, wie das Team wächst und zusammenarbeitet. Eine Rolle mit Substanz: Du verbindest Recruiting, Employee Relations, Arbeitsrecht und HR-Projekte und begleitest Themen von der ersten Idee bis zur Umsetzung. Direkte Zusammenarbeit und kurze Entscheidungswege: Du arbeitest eng mit unserer Head of HR, dem COO und dem Head of Logistics zusammen. That’s why every journey is unique: there’s no standardized path through the program, just continuous opportunities to learn, and lead.</p> <p> </p> <h3><strong>Where you’ll make an impact</strong></h3> <p>From day one, you’ll be embedded in a business team, taking ownership in one of the following domains:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Consumer</strong> - Drive growth through pricing, supplier strategy, and our market strategy. title: R&D Intern - Fairness in Deep Learning - Paris
description: <p><strong>Contexte :</strong></p> <p>Offre de stage de recherche de master d’une durée de 4 à 6 mois, débutant en hiver 2026-2027. Ce document liste les possibles directions pour le stage, qui seront ajustées au fil du stage. Le stage aura lieu au sein du centre de recherche d’Artefact à Paris.</p> <p>L’objectif est d'étudier les réseaux de neurones dans un cadre où l’on souhaite garantir l'indépendance des prédictions vis-à-vis d'une variable sensible continue (telle que l'âge, le revenu, la couleur de peau, etc.).</p> <p><strong>Présentation d’Artefact :</strong></p> <p>Artefact est une société internationale de services autour de la data, spécialisée dans le conseil en transformation data, dont la mission est de transformer la donnée  en délivrant des résultats tangibles sur l’ensemble de la chaîne de valeur des entreprises. L’approche unique d’Artefact, qui fait le pont entre la donnée et le business, permet à nos clients d’atteindre leurs objectifs business de façon dédiée et efficace. Nos 2500 employés allient leurs compétences pluridisciplinaires au profit  de l’innovation business des entreprises. Nos technologies de pointe en Intelligence Artificielle, nos méthodes agiles garantissent le succès des projets IA de nos clients, de la conception au déploiement, jusqu’à la formation et l’accompagnement au changement.</p> <p><strong>Sujet :</strong></p> <p>Les réseaux de neurones sont aujourd'hui au cœur de nombreuses applications industrielles. Leur capacité à extraire des représentations riches à partir des données en fait des outils de choix, mais elle les rend aussi susceptibles d'encoder et d'amplifier des biais présents dans les données d'apprentissage, renforçant ainsi des discriminations chez les populations traitées par ces modèles [1]. Cet enjeu est un domaine de recherche dénommé fairness, et est particulièrement dynamique, avec la réglementation des modèles d’IA qui évolue, comme par exemple avec l’AI Act de l’Union Européenne.</p> <p><br>Pour mesurer et mitiger les biais discriminatoires dans les modèles, la littérature s'est majoritairement concentrée sur des variables sensibles binaires ou catégorielles (genre, origine ethnique, etc.), pour lesquelles les groupes sont bien définis [2-5]. Cependant de nombreuses variables sensibles sont intrinsèquement continues : l'âge, le revenu, ou encore la couleur de peau. Discrétiser ces variables en groupes est une pratique courante mais problématique : le choix des seuils est arbitraire, de l'information est perdue, et un modèle peut sembler équitable pour un découpage donné tout en restant fortement biaisé pour un autre [6]. Contrôler la dépendance entre les sorties d'un modèle et une variable continue reste un problème ouvert, notamment pour les réseaux de neurones, où il faut à la fois mesurer cette dépendance et la pénaliser de façon différentiable au cours de l'apprentissage.</p> <p><br>Durant ce stage, le/la stagiaire explorera les méthodes de réduction des biais par rapport à une variable sensible continue pour des réseaux de neurones. Le travail commencera par l'implémentation des méthodes existantes (régularisations basées sur des mesures de dépendance telles que la corrélation maximale de Hirschfeld-Gebelein-Rényi ou “Generalized Disparate Impacte”, etc.), listées dans les références [7-8], et par la mise en place d'un protocole robuste pour les comparer, en tenant compte du compromis entre performance et fairness. Dans un second temps, le stage se concentrera sur la conception et l'expérimentation de nouvelles méthodes de réduction de biais adaptées aux variables continues. Pour cela, le/la stagiaire pourra s'appuyer sur des bibliothèques open source (PyTorch, scikit-learn), afin de rester dans un cadre de code reproductible et facile à adopter.</p> <p><strong>Pré-requis</strong></p> <p>Le profil recherché pour ce poste est le suivant :<br>BAC+4/BAC+5 : Formation en mathématiques appliquées, statistiques ou machine learning au sein d’une université ou école d’ingénieur<br>Stage de césure ou stage de fin d’études<br>Date de début : Hiver 2026-2027<br>Durée : 4 à 6 mois</p> <p><strong>Références</strong></p> <ol> <li>Risser, L., Sanz, A. G., Vincenot, Q., & Loubes, J. M. (2022). Tackling algorithmic bias in neural-network classifiers using wasserstein-2 regularization. <em>Journal of Mathematical Imaging and Vision</em>, <em>64</em>(6), 672-689.</li> <li>Buolamwini, J., & Gebru, T. (2018, January). Gender shades: Intersectional accuracy disparities in commercial gender classification. In <em>Conference on fairness, accountability and transparency</em> (pp. 77-91). PMLR.</li> <li>Cho, J., Zala, A., & Bansal, M. (2023, October). Dall-eval: Probing the reasoning skills and social biases of text-to-image generation models. In <em>2023 IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV)</em> (pp. 3020-3031). IEEE.</li> <li>Li, X., Chen, Z., Zhang, J. M., Sarro, F., Zhang, Y., & Liu, X. (2023). Dark-skin individuals are at more risk on the street: Unmasking fairness issues of autonomous driving systems. <em>CoRR abs/2308.02935</em>.</li> <li>Thong, W., Joniak, P., & Xiang, A. (2023, October). Beyond skin tone: A multidimensional measure of apparent skin color. In <em>2023 IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV)</em> (pp. 4880-4890). IEEE.</li> <li>Shilova, V., Malherbe, E., Palma, G., Risser, L., & Loubes, J. M. (2025). Fairness-aware grouping for continuous sensitive variables: Application for debiasing face analysis with respect to skin tone. In <em>ECAI 2025: 28th European Conference on Artificial Intelligence 25-30 October 2025, Bologna, Italy-Including 14th Conference on Prestigious Applications of Intelligent Systems (PAIS 2025) Proceedings</em> (pp. 5344-5351).</li> <li>Mary, J., Calauzenes, C., & El Karoui, N. (2019, May). Fairness-aware learning for continuous attributes and treatments. In <em>International conference on machine learning</em>(pp. 4382-4391). PMLR.</li> <li>Giuliani, L., Misino, E., & Lombardi, M. (2023, July). Generalized disparate impact for configurable fairness solutions in ML. In <em>International Conference on Machine Learning</em> (pp. 11443-11458). PMLR.</li> </ol> Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Manager, Global Procurement (Materials)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>ABOUT QUINCE</strong></span></p> <p>Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes  and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.</p> <p>What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.</p> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>OUR CULTURE</strong></span></p> <p>Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.</p> <ul> <li>We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA.  Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.</li> <li>Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths. </li> <li>Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory. </li> </ul> <p>If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.</p></div><p data-renderer-start-pos="2290" data-local-id="6a0d0d38-3057-4834-9012-12f09f19e465"><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>Open Roles</strong></span></p> <ol> <li>Senior Manager, Global Raw Materials Procurement - Linen, Cotton & Other </li> <li>Senior Manager, Global Raw Materials Procurement - Cashmere & Silk </li> <li>Senior Manager, Global Raw Materials Procurement - Denim, Active & PKG Labels </li> <li>Senior Manager, Global Raw Materials Procurement - Leather & Down</li> </ol> <p data-renderer-start-pos="2290" data-local-id="6a0d0d38-3057-4834-9012-12f09f19e465"><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>THE IDEAL CANDIDATE: </strong></span></p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="2290" data-local-id="6a0d0d38-3057-4834-9012-12f09f19e465">We are looking for an exceptional Senior Manager, Global Procurement [Materials] to own and drive cost structures and savings. This role offers the opportunity to make a significant impact on our business,contribute to company growth, and shape the future of our global procurement strategy.</p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="2290" data-local-id="6a0d0d38-3057-4834-9012-12f09f19e465"><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES: </strong></span></p> <ul> <li data-renderer-start-pos="2290" data-local-id="6a0d0d38-3057-4834-9012-12f09f19e465"><strong>Commodity Insights:</strong> Establish a monitoring framework to forecast global market shifts, raw material fluctuations, currency risks, and macro-material trends.
