title: (Senior) Go to Market Scaling Manager - Germany (m/f/d)
description: 1KOMMA5° At 1KOMMA5° , we pursue a clear vision: Living on wind and sunlight forever for free . To make this a reality, we are building the energy system of the future with Heartbeat AI. Want to be part of it? We bring together regional craftsmanship and scalable software: We don't think of solar, batteries, heat pumps, and e-mobility as isolated components, but control them as an intelligent, integrated overall system in our virtual power plant. Directly connected to the electricity market – in real time, fully automated. This way, energy is used when it is available from renewables and particularly cost-effective. By 2030, our goal is to transition 1.5 million households to renewable energies. Over 3,000 people are working towards this every day, at more than 80 locations worldwide, from Finland to Australia. Want to take responsibility and build solutions that truly matter? Apply now and help us shape the energy world of tomorrow. Learn about our Product & Tech team! Deine Position Heartbeat AI is our energy optimisation platform that always provides our customers with the cleanest and cheapest energy. As the ( Senior) Go-to-Market Scaling Manager - Germany, your first focus is optimising the performance, positioning, and monetisation of Heartbeat AI within our largest and most established market while adding new products to it and making sure our new customer-facing features get seen. You will take ownership of what's already working and what isn't, fine-tuning pricing, packaging, and go-to-market execution while working closely across Product, Tech, Sales, and Marketing to keep the German market performing at its full potential. You own the performance and monetisation of Heartbeat AI within the German market, working to continuously optimise what's already in place rather than build from zero. You fine-tune pricing and packaging, identify where existing structures are leaving value on the table, and drive the changes needed to capture it. You bring new positioning ideas to an already mature market, testing and validating fresh angles alongside the initiatives already running. You develop a deep understanding of the unit economics behind Heartbeat AI in Germany, using that insight to shape monetisation strategy across pricing, packaging, and the broader product suite. You work closely with Product, Tech, Marketing, and Sales stakeholders, translating technical constraints into commercial decisions and commercial priorities into technical requirements. You track performance across the German market, using data to spot where monetisation or positioning is underperforming and turning that into concrete action. You operate with significant cross-functional influence, managing diagonally across tech, sales, and marketing to keep initiatives moving. You report into the Go-to-Market Director, working closely with senior leadership to present performance updates and build the case for changes to positioning or monetisation strategy. Dein Profil You bring at least 5 years of experience in a similar commercial, product, or GTM role, ideally within the tech and energy industry. You are confident optimising an already-established market, spotting where fine-tuning pricing, packaging, or positioning can unlock further performance. You are structured by default and follow through without being asked: you manage multiple concurrent initiatives and dependencies without losing the thread, and own action items end to end. You are ambitious and impact-driven, yet humble and a strong influencer in equal measure. You set a high bar for what "good" looks like, quickly credit the team and admit when something isn't working, and can bring sceptical stakeholders on board to inspire the cross-functional effort to scale the German market. You have a strong grasp of unit economics and a genuine passion for how they drive monetisation decisions, and you can translate margin and cost-structure insights into concrete pricing and product strategy. You are comfortable working closely with Tech, Sales and Marketing teams and fluent in both sales/marketing and technology language, translating technical trade-offs into business decisions and commercial priorities into technical requirements, without needing someone else to broker the conversation. You are confident presenting to and working directly with executives and can turn data and KPIs into clear, decision-ready updates. You are native in German and fluent in English (C1/C2), written and verbal. Knowledge of and experience in the German energy market is clearly a plus, but not a must. Benefits You are part of an international, dynamic, and highly motivated team of people who have proven to make things happen With your work, you accelerate the "energy transition" and hence have a direct impact on our climate Work with and learn from other super-smart colleagues You will enjoy direct contact with core decision-makers You will enjoy the best chances of entering full-time in one of Europe’s most thriving scaleups You work remotely (Germany-wide), with offices in Hamburg, Berlin or Munich Create a healthy balance alongside your work and enjoy all the benefits of the EGYM Wellpass Benefits and discounts are yours with Futurebens Whether city bike or e-bike - be flexible with our job bike leasing and do something good for the environment at the same time Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Design Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3>Available Locations | Austin, US</h3> <h3>About the Role</h3> <p>Emerging Technologies & Incubation (ETI) is where new and bold products are built and released within Cloudflare. Rather than being constrained by the structures which make Cloudflare a massively successful business, we are able to leverage them to deliver entirely new tools and products to our customers. Cloudflare’s edge and network make it possible to solve problems at massive scale and efficiency which would be impossible for almost any other organization.</p> <h3>Responsibilities</h3> <ul> <li>In this role, you will collaborate with a team of Design Engineers and Systems Engineers.</li> <li>You will help design and develop frontend experiences that improve overall developer experience throughout our dashboard.</li> <li>You will own your code from inception to release and bring attention to detail to the work you complete for both coding patterns & visual aesthetics.</li> <li>On any given day, you might be working in Figma collaborating on designs or inspiration, developing new components and user interactions, polishing existing pages, or improving developer experience in any number of ways you might imagine.</li> <li>You can expect to interact with a variety of languages and technologies. title: Associate Account Manager (Paris)
description: The AI-powered OS for beauty, wellness and self-care About Fresha Fresha is the AI-powered operating system for the global beauty, wellness and self-care industry, connecting and powering everything from salons and barbers to spas, medspas, fitness studios and health practices. Trusted by millions of consumers and businesses worldwide. Fresha is used by 140,000+ businesses and 450,000+ stylists and professionals worldwide, processing over 1 billion appointments to date. The company is headquartered in London, United Kingdom, with 15 global offices located across North America, EMEA and APAC. Fresha allows consumers to discover, book and pay for beauty and wellness appointments with local businesses via its marketplace, while beauty and wellness businesses and professionals use an all-in-one platform to manage their entire operations with an intuitive business software and financial technology solutions. Fresha’s ecosystem gives merchants everything they need to run their business seamlessly by facilitating appointment bookings, point-of-sale, customer records management, marketing automation, loyalty, beauty products inventory and team management. The consumer marketplace unlocks revenue potential for partner businesses by leveraging the power of online bookings and automated marketing through mobile apps and advanced integrations with major tech brands including Instagram, Facebook and Google. Role overview Given our exciting and progressive growth plans, we are looking for an exceptional Associate Account Manager to come and join our global business. Reporting directly to the Account Manager Team Lead, you will be accountable for building relationships and driving monetisation of the Fresha platform. This is a great opportunity for someone looking to work in a fast-paced and changing environment, who likes to work autonomously, enjoys a challenge, and wants to make an impact. To foster a collaborative environment that thrives on face-to-face interactions and teamwork, all Fresha employees work from office five days per week in Paris, on the Champs-élysées. Commercial Growth Engagement - Accountable for meeting key performance indicators on monetisation and revenue growth by proactively engaging with and educating our Partners on the value of the Fresha platform. Sales Cycle - Proactively introduce, educate and convert Partners on to Fresha’s payments solution. Market Trends - Optimise listing content and availability competitiveness on the marketplace to maximise conversions. Relationship Building Partnering - Have a pool of Partner accounts serving as a dedicated advisor for all your Partners assisting them on their journey to product adoption. Advisor - Advising Partners on suitable product selection based on their needs and specifications. Business Partnering - Ensure a strong Partner Experience through building relationships by attending video meetings with your pool of Partners and effectively communicating the Fresha features and benefits. Relationships - Build key internal relationships with our Sales and Onboarding teams to ensure smooth transition and handover of Partners through the Partner journey. Collaboration - Collaborate with our Product teams to provide important product feedback to help enhance future releases. Persuasion - Use consultative sales techniques to understand customer needs and requirements and have the ability to upsell and cross-sell the Fresha Platform. This list is not exhaustive and there may be other activities you are required to deliver. What we are looking for Experience - 1-2 Years experience in effectively delivering commercial outcomes from a previous Account Management role Closing Skills – Demonstrated ability to effectively close deals, negotiate, and convert opportunities Adaptability - Shown to be commercially motivated with an ability to adapt and achieve targets Analytics - Proven experience in using and analysing data and reporting effectively to improve commercial outcomes Curiosity - Naturally proactive and inquisitive, with a desire to consistently learn and improve Tele-prospecting - Previous experience in an outbound call environment or a related sales position preferred Communication - Excellent and proven written, verbal and presentation skills Innovative - Creative thinking and problem-solving mindset Relationship Building - You are a true hunter and relationship builder Team Player - Happy to roll sleeves up and assist the team when required Initiative - Ability to self-starter with a proactive approach Added Bonus Bi-lingual - Fluency in English and another language Beauty & Wellness - Experience within the beauty and wellness industry At Fresha, we value passion and potential as much as specific skills. If you're enthusiastic and eager to learn, we encourage you to apply, even if you don't meet every listed requirement. We believe in fostering growth and providing the support needed for you to excel in your role. Interview Process Screen Call - Video-call with a member from the Talent Team (30 mins) Skills & Experience - In-Person interview with Team Leads (30 mins) Presentation - In-Person interview with General Manager. We aim to complete the entire interview process and deliver feedback within 2 weeks . Every job application received is reviewed manually by our talent team. While we strive to assess applications within 7 days, the sheer volume of talented individuals expressing interest may occasionally extend this timeframe Inclusive workforce At Fresha, we are creating a culture where individuals of all backgrounds feel comfortable. We want all Fresha people to feel included and truly empowered to contribute fully to our vision and goals. Everyone who applies will receive fair consideration for employment. We do not discriminate based on race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, marital status, gender identity, national origin, disability, or any other applicable legally protected characteristics in the location in which the candidate is applying. If you have any accessibility requirements that would make you more comfortable during the interview process and/or once you join, please let us know so that we can support you. title: Principle Software Engineer - Product, Platform, Infrastructure
description: Help us build the future of public administration! Ayunis is a Munich-based GovTech company trusted by more than 800 cities, municipalities and districts across the DACH region. With Ayunis Core, we are building an open-source AI platform that automates repetitive administrative work. We use cutting-edge AI and engineering tools to build cutting-edge agentic technology—both for our customers and for our own development workflows. Tasks Your role As Principal Engineer, you will provide hands-on technical leadership across our product, integration platform and production infrastructure. Working closely with the CTO and engineering team, you will set technical direction, make critical architectural decisions and help other engineers deliver independently. You will remain close to code and production without becoming the bottleneck for every difficult problem. Your responsibilities Evolve the architecture of Ayunis Core across frontend, backend, agent runtime, identity, permissions and extension interfaces. Own the technical direction of our infrastructure, including deployments, reliability, observability, security and incident readiness. Build stable APIs, SDKs and reusable integration patterns for external systems such as document management systems and identity providers. Make pragmatic trade-offs between delivery speed, simplicity and long-term maintainability. Work with Product and customer-facing teams to turn recurring needs into reusable product capabilities. Collaborate with open-source contributors, software vendors and integration partners. Requirements What you bring Experience operating at Staff, Principal or a comparable level in a production software environment. Strong backend and systems architecture skills, ideally with TypeScript and Node.js. Hands-on experience with agent runtimes like LangChain, OpenAI Agent SDK, Mastra or similar. Hands-on experience with sovereign infrastructure, containers, CI/CD, scaling, observability and security. Experience designing APIs and integrations, such as OAuth/OIDC, webhooks, synchronization or event-driven systems. The ability to move between high-level architecture and hands-on implementation and debugging. A pragmatic product mindset: you judge technical decisions by their effect on reliability, delivery speed and customer value. The ability to set technical direction and lead engineers without relying on formal authority. An interest in using and systematically improving AI-assisted software development. Confident communication in German and English. Our stack TypeScript, Node.js, NestJS, React, TanStack, PostgreSQL, Redis, S3-compatible storage, Docker Compose, Hetzner, GitHub Actions, OpenTelemetry and multiple LLM providers. No LangChain though – we've built our agent orchestration from the ground up. Benefits What we offer A competitive salary €2,000 annual personal development budget 30 days of holiday Significant influence over an open-source product and engineering organization Flexible working hours, hybrid work and EU workations Modern Munich office and equipment Regular team events and off-sites Public transport subsidy and Wellpass Interested? We look forward to hearing from you. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Go-to-Market Engineer (m/w/d)
description: Wir bauen die Software, mit der WEG- und Mietverwaltungen ihren Alltag rechtssicher und ohne Medienbrüche organisieren, umfangreich und modern, aber erschwinglich, für das digitale Zeitalter der Immobilienwirtschaft. Die Immobilienverwaltung zählt zu den analogsten Branchen in Deutschland, genau das wollen wir ändern. Unser Team kombiniert Erfahrung aus dem Verwalteralltag mit dem IT-Know-how eines innovativen Tech-Unternehmens. Seit unserer Gründung 2020 sind wir aus der Praxis für die Praxis gewachsen. Wir sind ein Team von 26 Menschen in Brühl bei Köln, das Verantwortung ernst nimmt und Entscheidungen schnell trifft. Wir wachsen und mit uns die Anforderungen an unsere Infrastruktur über Marketing, Vertrieb und Customer Success hinweg. Dafür suchen wir keine Person, die HubSpot verwaltet, sondern jemanden, der sie baut: Strukturen, Automatisierungen und Tracking, die den gesamten Weg vom ersten Kontakt bis zur langfristigen Kundenbeziehung sauber abbilden. Du berichtest direkt an unsere CRO. Aufgaben Du übernimmst HubSpot als zentrale Infrastruktur für Marketing, Vertrieb und Customer Success und baust Strukturen, die mit unserem Wachstum mitskalieren. Du entwickelst Automatisierungen, die manuelle Arbeit aus unseren Teams herausnehmen, von Content-Automatisierung über Lead-Routing bis zu automatisierten Abläufen im Customer Success, etwa beim Onboarding neuer Kund:innen. Du baust mit n8n oder vergleichbaren Low-Code-Tools Workflows, die Systeme miteinander verbinden, die bisher nebeneinander laufen. Du setzt KI gezielt dort ein, wo sie echten Mehrwert bringt: bei Recherche, Optimierung, Datenanreicherung oder Content-Erstellung. Bei Bedarf baust du auch mal eine Landingpage in Webflow oder ein Tracking-Setup, das uns zeigt, was auf dem Weg zum Kunden tatsächlich funktioniert. Du arbeitest eng mit Marketing, Vertrieb und Customer Success zusammen und verstehst deren Prozesse gut genug, um sie in Systeme zu übersetzen, die im Alltag wirklich helfen. Qualifikation Gute bis sehr gute HubSpot-Kenntnisse: Du hast bereits Strukturen aufgebaut, nicht nur gepflegt, und weißt, wie Workflows, Properties und Automatisierungen zusammenspielen. Fortgeschrittene Erfahrung mit Automatisierung über Low-Code- oder No-Code-Tools wie n8n. Echtes Interesse an KI und was sie im Business-Kontext leisten kann. Du musst kein Profi sein, aber du hast bereits ausprobiert, gelernt und weißt, wo KI wirklich hilft und wo nicht. Ein Systemblick: Du denkst in Prozessen über Teamgrenzen hinweg, nicht in einzelnen Tickets, hast das Gesamtsystem im Kopf und weißt, wie sich eine Änderung an einer Stelle an anderer Stelle auswirkt. Technikaffinität, die über HubSpot hinausgeht. Ein Tool wie Webflow schreckt dich nicht ab. Bock, in einem Startup mitzugestalten, statt in einem eingespielten Prozess zu verwalten. Wer zu uns passt Wir suchen niemanden, der schon alles kann. Wir suchen jemanden mit echtem Interesse an der Aufgabe. Jemanden, der Automatisierung und KI nicht nur kennt, sondern gerne selbst in die Hand nimmt. Wichtig ist, dass du KI oder Automatisierung bereits im Business-Kontext eingesetzt, nicht nur privat ausprobiert hast. Das kann jemand mit ersten Erfahrungen sein, der Lust hat, sich weiter reinzuarbeiten, oder jemand mit viel Erfahrung, der Bock auf die nächste Stufe hat. Senior oder Expertin musst du dafür nicht sein. Entscheidend ist, dass dir das Bauen selbst Spaß macht, nicht nur das Ergebnis. Was SCALARA bietet Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit unserem CRO und echte Verantwortung ab dem ersten Tag. Die Möglichkeit, eine Infrastruktur von Grund auf mitzugestalten, statt eine bestehende zu verwalten. Ein Tech-Unternehmen, das auf Innovation und KI setzt und in dem gute Ideen schnell umgesetzt werden. Arbeitskultur: Ein offenes, wertschätzendes Team von 26 Menschen in Brühl bei Köln, das eng zusammenarbeitet und mit Herzblut und Spaß bei der Sache ist. Flexibilität: Hybrides Arbeiten zwischen Büro in Brühl und Home-Office, remote Arbeiten auf Anfrage. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Developing it further takes engineers who combine technical excellence, pragmatic judgement and entrepreneurial spirit. The AI & Platform Innovation Engineer we are looking for embodies these qualities. He or she is up for making a major contribution to our company and to our society. Tasks Develop AI-agentic solutions from scratch or integrating existing agents and foundational technologies. This involves close cooperation with our Business Development team and other users. Use AI to aggressively ship high-quality code. Architect and build AI‑first software solutions for complex user‑stories: scalable, robust, maintainable. Work closely with stakeholders to deliver end‑to‑end innovations. Own the full development pipeline: from design and development, through QA and deployment, to production monitoring. Lead architectural discussions, code reviews, and retrospectives; mentor fellow engineers. Champion AI‑powered features: integrate LLMs, RAG pipelines, agentic workflows, embeddings and deep learning frameworks to unlock business value. Requirements Have excelled somewhere, somehow through an impacting technical contribution — one which we can talk about. Have experience in developing AI agents and integrating them into workflows. Be on top of the latest tools, models and trends in AI-assisted software engineering. We expect you to be amazing at context engineering (incl. prompting), to know when to leverage different models, and to have first-hand experience with Claude Code or Cursor. Have hands‑on record of building production‑grade software, preferably with AI components (LLMs, embeddings, PyTorch/TensorFlow, RAG pipelines, autonomous agents). Practice a truly agnostic approach to stack and tools: you pick the right tech for the problem — not vice‑versa. Show exceptional autonomy: your are able to self‑drive from idea to finished product, yet know when to collaborate and escalate. Have the ability to thoughtfully challenge ideas and drive constructive discussions (colleagues, product owners, CTO). Be a strong, respectful team player: highly autonomous but grounded in humility and partnership. Reside within ±3 hours of Central European Time (to enable effective collaboration), at best in one of our office locations in Barcelona, Berlin, Frankfurt, Leipzig, and Sevilla. Full professional proficiency in English at C2 level Bonus Prior experience integrating AI into SaaS business workflows. Familiarity with modern AI‑tooling ecosystem (agents, memory systems, vector databases). Experience leading a tech team or architecting across the stack — from frontend to infrastructure. Professional proficiency in German. Benefits You’ll work in an international, closely knit team of high‑performers and entrepreneurial spirits. Remote‑friendly + flexible work hours. Excellent compensation + participation in the company through our ESOP. Growth mindset: Hard skills are important — but mindset matters more. If you meet most of the requirements and you’re hungry to learn, apply anyway. If you’re a high‑impact engineer who thrives on autonomy, drives real results, and is passionate about applying AI to change how teams work — let’s talk. Even if you don’t check every bullet above, but you bring exceptional drive, creativity, and a growth mindset, please apply — we believe the right mindset counts more than checkboxes. title: Tech Lead - AI & Innovation
description: Vicoland gives the professional services market a new dimension: Virtual Companies – "Vicos". We invented Vicos as a new type of supplier, more efficient than traditional professional services firms (consultancies, system integrators, agencies etc.). We have received 20 million € in round A financing. Vicos may consist of freelancers, SMEs and AI agents. They organize through our AI-driven SaaS platform to act like real companies, competing successfully for large enterprise projects, e g. ERP introductions or AI transformations. Vicos have proven to be more cost-efficient and to deliver better quality than traditional companies. Already, 120+ Vicos with thousands of freelancers work on projects for enterprise clients like BASF, Miele, Siemens or Daimler and many SME. Forbes and Forrester have named Vicoland as a leading force transforming the market. Our certified platform is key to our success. It provides the full digital infrastructure which makes Vicos come true as a new form to organize human labor and human-agentic interaction. It covers end-to-end all essential areas: marketing, finance, legal, and organization. Given its ambitious and transformative purpose, our platform is highly complex (though easy use). Developing it further takes engineers who combine technical excellence, pragmatic judgement and entrepreneurial spirit. The Tech Lead: AI & Innovation we are looking for embodies these qualities in his or her leadership. He or she is up for making a major contribution to our company and to our society. Tasks You will lead, grow and enable a team of (forward deployed) engineers: make every engineer successful in their role and hire new ones who strengthen the team. You will be the only (and main) tech lead for the engineering team, with carreer option to progress to CTO Own the technical direction and technology decisions for Vicoland. Set the architecture across the stack, from frontend to infrastructure, and make sure what we build is scalable, robust and maintainable. Stay hands-on: contribute features yourself end-2-end by understanding business needs, coding, building prototypes, and for all that using AI to aggressively ship high-quality software alongside your team. Translate business needs into technical roadmaps in close cooperation with Business Development, Product and other stakeholders. Prioritize, scope and make trade-offs explicit. Makre sure each team member can work end-to-end: concept & design, development, QA, deployment and production monitoring, with clear engineering standards and quality gates. Continuously improve how we build with AI: best practices for context engineering, model selection, evaluation, tracing and observability, so that quality is measured, not assumed. Run architectural discussions, code reviews and retrospectives; create a culture of ownership, constructive challenge and continuous learning. Act as a sparring partner to the Chief Product Officer and the business leadership team on technology strategy, build-vs-buy decisions and team setup. Requirements Have proven people leadership experience: you have led an engineering team (ideally 3+ engineers), including hiring, performance evaluations, career development and coaching. Have excelled somewhere through an impactful technical contribution, one which we can talk about, and still enjoy writing code yourself. Have deep hands-on experience across the stack (frontend, backend, data, infrastructure/cloud) and a track record of architecting and shipping production-grade software, preferably with AI components (LLMs, embeddings, RAG pipelines, autonomous agents, PyTorch/TensorFlow). Have experience developing AI agents and integrating them into business workflows. Be on top of the latest tools, models and trends in AI-assisted software engineering. You are excellent at context engineering (incl. prompting), know when to leverage which model, and have first-hand experience with Claude Code or Cursor, and you know how to roll these practices out across a team. Know how to evaluate what gets built. You can design eval sets, work with LLM-as-judge or ground-truth data, use tracing and observability tooling to find and fix regressions, and make evaluation a team habit. Practice a truly agnostic approach to stack and tools: you pick the right tech for the problem, not vice versa, and can explain your choices to both engineers and business stakeholders. Balance autonomy and alignment: you drive your team from idea to finished product independently, while knowing when to involve, align with or escalate to others. Have the ability to thoughtfully challenge ideas and drive constructive discussions with users, engineers, product, and business leadership. Lead with humility: you create psychological safety, give and receive honest feedback, and measure your success by the success of your team. Reside within ±3 hours of Central European Time (to enable effective collaboration), at best in one of our office locations in Barcelona, Berlin, Frankfurt, Leipzig, and Sevilla. Full professional proficiency in English at C2 level. Full professional proficiency in German at C1 level. Bonus Qualifications Experience building or scaling an engineering team in a startup or scale-up environment. Prior experience integrating AI into SaaS business workflows, ideally in a client-facing or forward-deployed setup. Familiarity with the modern AI-tooling ecosystem (agents, memory systems, vector databases, orchestration frameworks). Experience working with distributed or multi-location teams. Benefits You’ll work in an international, closely knit team of high‑performers and entrepreneurial spirits. Remote‑friendly + flexible work hours. Excellent compensation + participation in the company through our ESOP. Growth mindset: Hard skills are important — but mindset matters more. If you meet most of the requirements and you’re hungry to learn, apply anyway. If you’re a high‑impact tech lead who thrives on autonomy, drives real results, and is passionate about applying AI to change how teams work - let’s talk. Even if you don’t check every bullet above, but you bring exceptional drive, creativity, and a growth mindset, please apply. We believe the right mindset counts more than checkboxes. Harmonising customer requirements across OEM partners to maximise reusable assets, scalability and efficient feature delivery. Setting clear performance targets and ensuring features meet customer requirements, internal capabilities and agreed delivery specifications. Supporting testing, evaluation and validation to ensure feature quality and readiness for production. Maintaining and evolving the strategic feature roadmap as Wayve’s technology advances towards higher levels of autonomy. Participating in agile planning and delivery rituals, helping teams manage dependencies, risks and priorities effectively. Ensuring feature delivery aligns with relevant automotive quality, safety and compliance expectations. 🙌 You should apply if: You have strong experience specifying and delivering ADAS features from concept through to production, particularly across Collision Avoidance or Lane Keeping functions such as AEB, LKA, ESA, AES or BSM. You are confident working directly with OEM customers: understanding their needs, negotiating requirements and representing their perspective internally while maintaining a clear view of Wayve’s product strategy. You have sufficient technical depth to engage credibly with engineering teams on feature trade-offs, feasibility, testing, evaluation and validation. You are a strong cross-functional collaborator who can bridge technical and commercial perspectives, creating alignment across customers, product and engineering teams. You proactively identify risks and issues before they escalate, balancing immediate delivery needs with the longer-term product roadmap. You are comfortable in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment and can bring structure and clarity without adding unnecessary process. Experience shipping complete ADAS features into large-scale automotive production programmes would be valuable. Knowledge of automotive quality, safety and compliance standards—including ASPICE, SOTIF, functional safety, GSR-II and DCAS—would be valuable. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines. Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility. The person who hears the customer describe their workflow should be the person who writes the requirement, and the person who writes the requirement should be able to build the first version themselves. That is you. 1. You translate customer reality into engineering requirements — and into revenue. Then you pull out the workflow: what actually happens, in what order, where it breaks, what the customer would pay to never do again. A skill library they can reach for. Onboarding that lands in days rather than months. Where Customer Success needs legal depth you step in, fix it, and turn the fix into something the team can handle alone next time. Your success is measured by how rarely you need to be in the room, and by what happens to adoption and expansion when you are not. 4. You are the legal authority in the building. A note on how we are weighting this role. Three capabilities make someone exceptional here: commercial instinct, legal depth, and technical ability to build. The ideal candidate has all three. If instead you have supported enterprise sales teams in demos, pilots, and expert calls, tell us what you changed about the outcome. You prioritise by impact, you are comfortable deciding without permission, and you would rather ship something imperfect this week than something elegant next quarter. 4. Language. Excellent German and English. German is non-negotiable: our customers are DACH legal teams and the nuance lives in their language. You can run a room of legal buyers, ask the sharp question, and write a specification precise enough to build from. Other EU languages are a plus. Why us? Impact over hype. You define a new discipline at the intersection of law, product, and AI. Your work directly shapes how thousands of legal professionals will operate. No silos. You sit between Product, Engineering, and the customer, with a direct line to all three. The better argument wins, not the higher title. We invest in you. The enterprise motion (multi-stakeholder pilots, procurement cycles, security reviews) is teachable, and we teach it: side by side in real customer calls from week one. Real ownership. Competitive salary and employee stock options (ESOP). Build in public. We want you to keep publishing what you build, because it makes you better and it makes us visible. Offices in Berlin, Leipzig, and Zurich with a flexible hybrid setup. Regular apéros, lunches, and hiking trips as we enjoy the journey together. Process Expectations. title: Chief of Staff, Data Science & Analytics
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>Brief info about Vinted </strong></h2> <p data-renderer-start-pos="1"><span data-sheets-root="1">Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third. <br>The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:<br><br><strong><a href="https://careers.vinted.com/marketplace" target="_blank">Vinted Marketplace</a></strong> is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.<br><br><a href="https://careers.vinted.com/vintedgo" target="_blank"><strong>Vinted Go</strong></a> enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.<br><br><a href="https://careers.vinted.com/vintedpay" target="_blank"><strong>Vinted Pay</strong></a> is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.<br><br>Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. </span></p></div><h2><strong>Information about the position </strong></h2> <p>The Chief of Staff is part of the senior leadership team of the Vinted-wide Data Science & Analytics function. Your primary role will be to build an aligned, engaged, and impactful team while ensuring the successful management and execution of key data strategies and initiatives. The Chief of Staff reports directly to the Vice President of Data Science & Analytics (“VP of DSA”) and acts as a trusted advisor and partner in ensuring that the department runs smoothly, efficiently, and effectively.</p> <p><strong>This is a fixed-term (maternity cover) position for approximately 1 year.</strong></p> <h2><strong>In this position, you’ll </strong></h2> <ul> <li>Serve as a trusted advisor to the VP of DSA, providing advice and guidance on all matters within the function (e.g. operating cadence, planning, problem analysis, communication). </li> <li>Own and run the function’s reporting cycles end-to-end (e.g. QBRs, OKR meetings, DSA All Hands); including content creation, preparation, facilitation, and follow-ups.</li> <li>Be responsible for coordinating the development and driving the execution of key function strategies and initiatives  (e.g. data related initiatives that drive long-term impact), and supporting broader cross-functional and organisational initiatives that involve DSA (e.g. reorganisations and operating model shifts).</li> <li>Oversee and manage recurrent DSA operations (e.g. DSA’s onboarding programme as well as the Data Science & Analytics Academy programme).</li> <li>Own the delivery of key functional events, including planning groups and agenda development (e.g. offsites, function week).</li> <li>Be accountable for maintaining an efficient operating model by ensuring processes, policies, and ceremonies are in place and effective, fostering an aligned, engaged, and impactful team.</li> <li>Support the DSA leadership team on the integration of AI into our data team’s (300+ team members) workflows.</li> <li>Be the driving force behind the senior and extended DSA leadership teams; coordinating and managing meetings, keeping track of decisions and pending relevant actions, holding the group accountable, and ensuring follow-through.</li> <li>(Co-) author key documents on function-related topics, ranging from vision and strategy papers to process and standards documentation, based on high-level instructions and discussions with the team and stakeholders.</li> <li>Conduct research and analysis on industry trends, best practices, and emerging technologies related to the function, and provide recommendations to the DSA leadership team.</li> <li>Own the organisation and documentation of the function’s governance (e.g., Google Groups, Drive, Confluence spaces, Slack Channels).</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About you </strong></h2> <ul> <li>Significant experience in strategy, consulting, or strategic transformation roles, with a track record of success in project management, management engagement, and strategic planning.</li> <li>Strong analytical skills, with the ability to break complex initiatives and challenges into manageable deliverables.</li> <li>Strong organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects and initiatives simultaneously.</li> <li>Proven leadership and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work collaboratively and build relationships across all levels of the organisation.</li> <li>Strong facilitation and moderation skills, with experience designing and leading workshops to discuss strategic priorities, build alignment, and drive decision-making.</li> <li>Comfortable interpreting aggregate (analytical) data and turning it into actional conclusions – but advanced data analysis skills are not required.</li> <li>Excellent communication skills, with the ability to effectively convey complex information to both technical and non-technical audiences.</li> <li>Hands on and detail-oriented problem solver, able to identify operational gaps and inefficiencies.</li> <li>Adaptable and comfortable operating under ambiguity, with the ability to pivot quickly, reprioritise effectively, and respond to emerging challenges with a solutions-oriented mindset.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Work perks  </strong></h2> <ul> <li>The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme</li> <li>30 days of paid annual leave</li> <li>Newest MacBook models</li> <li>Confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your family</li> <li>Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture</li> <li>Lunch benefit per your workday</li> <li>Frequent team-building events</li> <li>A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted</li> <li>Access to a discounted gym membership plan</li> <li>Pension Plan with Vinted matching 150% of your chosen contribution</li> <li>Supplemental Private Health Insurance</li> <li>Life and Disability insurance</li> <li>A subsidised Deutschlandticket for your commute to the office by public transport</li> <li>A dog-friendly office</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Working at Vinted </strong></h2> <p><strong>Workation policy </strong></p> <p>Better balance holidays with workdays by working remotely! Up to 90 days per year in the EU, of these, 21 days can be spent globally. For non-EU citizens, it's 21 days worldwide. This can be combined with time off for vacation or personal time.</p> <p><strong>Individual learning budget</strong></p> <p>Each year, you’ll be given a learning budget (starting at €3,000), and a total of up to 10 working days over a 2-year period to support your personal and professional development.</p> <p><strong>Hybrid work </strong></p> <p>Our hybrid model, with 2 recommended office days a week, gives you and your team the flexibility to decide if and when you want to work from home, and when to catch up in person.</p> <p><strong>Equal opportunity</strong></p> <p>We welcome applications from everybody, regardless of your background, identity, or life experiences. Job openings come with guides, not checklists. If you’re excited about a role, but don’t identify with every point in the ‘About you’ section, apply anyway – you might still be the perfect match!</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="title">The annual gross salary range for this position is:</div><div class="pay-range"><span>€83.300</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>€112.700 EUR</span></div></div></div> Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Associate - Venture & Growth (m/f/d)
description: <p>Senior Associate - Venture & Growth (m/f/d)</p> <p><strong>Join the team rewriting the rules in private markets.</strong></p> <p>Moonfare delivers what few others can: the highly sought-after funds and hidden-gem investments that go beyond what most private banks offer. Every opportunity is subjected to a ruthless vetting process; the bar is unforgivingly high. The result? Institutional-quality portfolios for investors who demand more.</p> <p>Our team combines finance veterans with talent from tech, consulting, law and industries you’d never expect. Headquartered in Berlin, we operate from eight offices across Europe, the US and Asia.</p> <p>If you're ready to build what's next in private markets, let's talk.</p> <p><strong>Mission:</strong></p> <p>Turn Moonfare's access to the world's leading venture managers into a steady, well-underwritten flow of single-company investments our clients can actually buy.</p> <p><strong>About the role:</strong></p> <p>A significant share of Moonfare's AuM sits in venture and growth, and the direct side of it, co-investments and secondaries in VC-backed companies, is where the business is growing fastest. Right now that dealflow arrives faster than we can review it, which puts the deployment of our proprietary funds at risk and caps how far the direct platform can scale. The scope of this role begins the moment an opportunity reaches us and ends when the deal closes, so operations sits outside it, as does the client raise itself. Your first year is weighted towards screening, pipeline and diligence, with the sourcing and business development side building from there as your market view and relationships deepen. You will work alongside senior members of the team rather than alone, and what moves forward is decided together.</p> <p><strong>The team:</strong></p> <p>Venture & Growth sits inside Moonfare's Investment team and runs two connected things. One is a multi-manager vehicle making primary fund investments into leading VC and growth managers across the US and Europe, where we have historically backed Founders Fund, a16z, Accel, Lightspeed, Khosla and General Catalyst. The other is the direct programme of co-investments and secondaries that those manager relationships generate, which is where this role's centre of gravity sits. You will report to the Head of VC & Direct Investing and work daily with the commercial team, who depend on you for qualified dealflow, and alongside Legal and Operations to close deals and launch the SPVs we distribute on the platform.</p> <p><strong>You will:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Own the direct deal pipeline. </strong>Everything from the moment an opportunity reaches us through to close is yours to run, so nothing sits unscreened and no access window quietly closes while we are still deciding.</li> <li><strong>Screen inbound co-investments and secondaries, and bring a view to the team. </strong>You run the first pass on what reaches us and form a position on it. What progresses is decided together with the Head of VC & Direct Investing and the wider team, so the value of your screen lies in the quality of the argument you bring to that conversation and in how sharply you separate the two or three worth our time from the rest.</li> <li><strong>Run diligence on direct deals. </strong>The core of it is judgement on the business itself: how good the company is, how strong the founding team is, how large and how contested the market is, and whether the thesis survives contact with the evidence. The technical layer sits underneath, with cap table analysis, preference stacks and waterfalls, and pricing and NAV work on secondary positions, so we know exactly what we are buying and at what price. You will do this with support from senior members of the team, and contribute to primary fund diligence alongside the direct mandate.</li> <li><strong>Author the investment memos that go to IC. </strong>The committee decides on what you put in front of it, so a memo with a gap in it, an inaccuracy, or a risk nobody spotted becomes a decision made on the wrong basis.</li> <li><strong>Build the market view, and then the market position. </strong>Relationships with intermediaries, GPs and, over time, founders are what get us into constrained opportunities and keep us current on where secondaries are pricing. This part of the role grows as you do, and watching how competitors structure and go to market belongs to it, because that is what keeps us competitive on price.</li> <li><strong>Help make the process repeatable. </strong>You will refine how we diligence direct deals and contribute to the sourcing, screening and monitoring tooling behind it, including AI-enabled approaches, so the volume we can handle is not capped by how much a person can read.</li> <li><strong>Turn deals into something our clients can buy. </strong>The commercial team depends on this seat for qualified dealflow and for support packaging opportunities into investor-ready materials. Fund deployment runs at the pace this work sets.</li> </ul> <p><strong>The next Moonfarian:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Four or more years centred on venture and growth investing. </strong>That comes along one of two paths. Either direct investment expertise, sourcing and diligencing investments in technology companies at a venture capital, growth equity or crossover fund, or an allocator seat focused on VC and growth where you have underwritten co-investments hands-on. Directly relevant adjacent backgrounds include TMT and technology investment banking, tech-focused private equity or software buyout, corporate development or corporate VC at a technology company, and consulting with a tech or commercial diligence focus. What matters most is a demonstrable track record of hands-on deal work: screening opportunities, running diligence, and taking a view through to a decision.</li> <li><strong>A network in venture you can already use. </strong>This one is non-negotiable. Relationships with GPs, intermediaries such as placement agents and bankers, and other LPs and co-investors, enough to get us access to constrained opportunities, support diligence and track spin-out candidates. You do not need the network of someone twice your experience. You do need a real one, and you will build a much larger one here.</li> <li><strong>Investment judgement you can defend. </strong>You form a view on a company and argue it, including the case against. You can read a business and a founding team, size a market and test a thesis against what the evidence actually supports. You are genuinely fluent in emerging technology and can develop conviction on themes and business models, with AI front of mind but not the only lens. You assess attractiveness quickly on limited or imperfect information, you are comfortable with financial modelling and market analysis, and you know your way around cap tables, preference stacks and waterfalls, secondary pricing, VC term sheets and SPV mechanics. You can hold several live opportunities at once and prioritise sharply between them.</li> <li><strong>An entrepreneurial instinct, which matters here as much as the investing. </strong>This one is non-negotiable too. This is a builder's seat as much as an investor's. You want a hand in structuring, go-to-market, process design and the operational scaffolding of a business line that is still being built. Your AI fluency goes past using the tools to designing processes around them.</li> <li><strong>Communication that works in three different rooms, and relationships that outlast any one deal. </strong>You can pitch and tailor to an investment committee, to a commercial team, and to clients, and prepare the reports and presentations each of them needs. Just as important is what you build over time with GPs and intermediaries, the standing that makes them think of us when something scarce comes up, because that is what turns a contact list into access. Excellent written and spoken English is essential.</li> </ul> <p><strong>How the role is measured: </strong></p> <ul> <li>Deals sourced, screened, and taken through to IC.</li> <li>Timely deployment of Moonfare's proprietary funds, such as the Moonfare Technology Fund.</li> <li>Allocation secured with GPs and intermediaries, meaning access we would not otherwise have had.</li> <li>Whether IC can decide on your memos without rework, and whether risks surface in diligence rather than after close.</li> <li>Capital raised on direct deals and the performance ultimately generated. These are programme outcomes you contribute to rather than own alone, and they are read that way.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What success looks like:</strong></p> <p><strong>By six months, </strong>the deal pipeline runs without the Head of VC & Direct Investing having to chase it. Opportunities are screened as they arrive, you are bringing a formed view on each one to the team, and the queue is visible to everyone who needs it.|<br><strong>By twelve months, </strong>deal review is fully operationalised, with a process the team can run rather than one person's habits, and more than ten direct deals have been through IC.</p> <p><strong>This role is unlikely to be a good match if you</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Prefer to let relationships develop slowly and mostly in writing.</strong> Much of our access comes from conversations with managers and intermediaries you do not know yet, and someone reserved about starting them will find the sourcing half of this job hard going.</li> <li><strong>Want a defined process to work inside. </strong>A good part of what this role runs does not exist yet, and you would be designing it while live deals are moving.</li> <li><strong>Want sole authority over what you invest in.</strong> We discuss deals as a team and decide together what progresses, which means your view gets argued with before it gets acted on. If you want to run your own book without that, this will frustrate you.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What your growth could look like:</strong></p> <p>The next step from here is Associate Principal. Getting there means leading the majority of diligence processes rather than running them with support, and having a network that generates opportunities rather than one that keeps you informed.</p> <p>What you get here that you would not get at a fund: you join the Head of VC & Direct Investing in GP conversations from early on and inherit access to a built-up base of manager relationships. You see the commercial side of raising capital for a deal alongside the investment side, which most investors never touch. And you help build a wider business, across a discretionary fund, capital raising for individual deals and, in time, a secondary market.</p> <p><strong>If you feel you do not meet all of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply!<br></strong></p> <p><strong>We can only accept applications from those eligible to live and work in Berlin/London. This is a hybrid role with office attendance required 4 days/week.</strong></p&gt

description: <h4><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>Professional Services Senior Project Manager (German Speaking)</strong></span></h4> <p><strong>Location: </strong>Germany (Remote)</p> <p><strong>Department:</strong> Professional Services (PS)</p> <p><strong>Language Requirements:</strong> German Speaking. </p> <p><strong>About the Job </strong><br>Rubrik Professional Services is looking for a high-energy, strategic, and results-driven Senior Project Manager to lead complex, enterprise customer implementations and help shape the future of our delivery practice. You will own high-stakes client engagements end-to-end, bringing deep project management expertise to solve problems on the ground and drive customer outcomes with minimal oversight.</p> <p><strong>About You </strong><br>As a Senior Project Manager in our PS Organisation, you will drive impact primarily through hands-on delivery excellence, leadership, and practice enablement.</p> <p>1. best practices for your engagements, resource allocation, utilisation tracking, and project health reporting across the PS portfolio.</p> <p><strong>Required Qualifications:</strong><br>● 8+ years of margin, utilization, project profitability).<br>● Experience contributing to PMO governance practices.</p> <p><strong>About the Team </strong><br>Rubrik Professional Services transforms possibilities title: Senior Principal Optical Systems Engineer
description: We are seeking a Senior Principal Optical Systems Engineer to lead the architecture, design, modeling, integration, characterization, and validation of advanced optical microsystems and photonic test solutions. This senior individual-contributor role owns complex development efforts from concept through production release and applies deep expertise in optics and photonics to resolve multidisciplinary technical challenges. This is an on-site position based in Karlsruhe, Germany, where Keystone does exciting work on advanced 3D-printed micro-optics and optical probe heads. The role is part of our parent company, FormFactor, and will work in close collaboration with a team on the U.S. West Coast. Candidates should be willing to travel to the U.S. several times per year. FormFactor, Inc. (NASDAQ: FORM), is a leading provider of essential test and measurement technologies along the full semiconductor product life cycle — from characterization, modeling, reliability, and design debug, to qualification and production test. Semiconductor companies rely upon FormFactor’s products and services to accelerate profitability by optimizing device performance and advancing yield knowledge. The company serves customers through its network of facilities in Asia, Europe, and North America. Tasks The successful candidate will provide technical leadership across engineering, manufacturing, quality, software, and commercial teams; translate customer and product needs into system requirements; and establish robust design, simulation, test, and validation methods. This role influences technical roadmaps and engineering practices through expertise and collaboration rather than direct people management. Optical System Architecture and Product Development • Lead development of advanced optical systems, micro-optical components, and photonic test solutions from concept through commercial deployment. • Translate customer, product, and application requirements into system architectures, performance specifications, interfaces, and verification plans. • Own system-level optical performance and manufacturability, reliability, cost, schedule, and scalability of optical subsystems. • Drive technical decisions for complex programs with significant ambiguity, multidisciplinary dependencies, and business impact. • Collaborate closely with Mechanical and Controls engineering teams to integrate optical components into precision alignment systems. • Select and characterize subsystem optical components including fiber array units (FAUs) and optical connectors. • Apply structured design reviews, risk assessment, and requirements traceability throughout the product lifecycle. Simulation, Modeling, and Analysis • Develop and validate advanced optical models using wave optics, diffraction, beam propagation, and photonic-device simulation methods. • Perform tolerance analysis, sensitivity analysis, error budgeting, and performance prediction for complete optical systems. • Correlate simulation results with laboratory measurements, production data, and field performance. Test, Metrology, and Automation • Lead development of optical characterization techniques, measurement methods, fixtures, and system-level verification strategies. • Define automated test and data-acquisition approaches supporting development, manufacturing, and quality assurance. • Integrate advanced metrology, image processing, and in-line monitoring solutions for process control and performance verification. • Use statistical analysis and data-driven methods to improve repeatability, capability, yield, and product performance. Requirements • Degree or PhD in Optical Engineering, Physics, Photonics, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline. • 8+ years of relevant experience in optical-system development, photonics, semiconductor equipment, or test and measurement. Equivalent combinations of education and industry experience may be considered. • Deep expertise in wave optics, optical-system analysis, and photonic devices. • Demonstrated success leading complex technical projects from concept through implementation or product release. • Strong experience with optical modeling, simulation, tolerance analysis, and experimental correlation. • Hands-on experience developing and validating optical test and measurement methodologies. • Proven ability to independently solve complex, multidisciplinary problems and make sound technical decisions with incomplete information. • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills, including the ability to communicate complex topics to technical and nontechnical stakeholders. • Experience with silicon photonics, photonic integrated circuits, or wafer-level optical testing. • Demonstrated experience in optical design and analysis using ANSYS Zemax. • Knowledge of advanced microfabrication, additive manufacturing, cleanroom, or semiconductor process technologies. • Experience with precision optical alignment, opto-mechanical systems, packaging, and system integration. • Programming and automation experience using Python, MATLAB, LabVIEW, or similar tools. • Familiarity with machine vision, image processing, automated inspection, statistical process control, or design of experiments. Benefits • Competitive salary and bonus structure. • The opportunity to work on leading semiconductor test technology in the growing photonics industry. • A pleasant working environment in Karlsruhe, including access to a canteen. • A supportive and international team culture. Everyone can make an impact here. Whether it's improving products, supporting customers, or positively influencing peers and the community, the contributions of our people matter. title: Senior Software Engineer, Network On-Ramps
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Locations: Austin TX, Champaign IL, Lisbon Portugal, London England</strong></p> <p><strong>About The Team:</strong></p> <p>Cloudflare is redefining the way networks are run at scale. Our Network Services product suite puts the connectivity, scale, and performance of Cloudflare’s global network in front of customers’ network infrastructure and private networks, providing a single pane of glass for network connectivity, visibility, and operating network functions like BGP, WAN optimization, and more. We are a team of engineers and product managers who obsess over quickly building products that solve real customer problems using innovative technologies and techniques which leverage Cloudflare’s unique architecture and global network footprint.</p> <p><strong>About the role</strong></p> <p>We are hiring engineers of all experience levels on our teams. You’ll build, deploy, and operate our team’s systems on top of one of the largest edge networks in the world. title: Senior Backend Engineer(Go), Storage Platform
description: About Wolt At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe. Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life. What you'll be doing As part of Wolt's Platform department (Core Group), you'll help improve and automate operations for our storage access platform - our real time database abstraction layer solution designed with scale and resiliency in mind . The product you will build enforces best practices by design, abstracts database infrastructure, and supports Multi-Region architecture through data sharding and replication. You join a team of highly skilled engineers in designing, building and optimizing this platform and ensuring smooth developer onboarding, constant improvement and optimization. As an engineer on the Storage access platform team, you'll work on platform features such as UI for developer teams, storage abstraction layer, database automation, client SDK and proxy, Change Data Capture pipelines, caching and ephemeral storage, Hot & Cold storage management and more. Our humble expectations You'll be a great fit for this role if you have the following skills and experience: A strong developer-to-developer mindset, with a genuine enjoyment of building for internal customers and treating other engineers as your primary users. Adaptability and strong motivation for working with distributed systems. A data-driven approach to decision-making and a collaborative mindset, with the ability to navigate disagreements constructively and deliver consistently. Autonomy in dynamic, fast-paced environments with frequent change. A product- and platform-oriented approach to engineering challenges. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with stakeholders and cross-functional teams. A collaborative spirit and experience contributing to diverse and inclusive work environments. Technical proficiencies: Expertise in NoSQL databases, particularly Cassandra or DynamoDB. Experience with large-scale distributed systems, emphasizing both velocity and scalability. Familiarity with SRE principles; however, a background in Backend Development is essential. Practical knowledge of Kubernetes, including EKS, as an end user. You don't need to tick every box, but if you see yourself in many of these points, we'd love to hear from you! What we offer At Wolt, we're committed to building an environment where engineers can make an impact while enjoying meaningful challenges. As a member of the the team you'll enjoy: Working on solutions that support millions of users Solving complex problems in performance, reliability and automation A collaborative and inclusive culture that supports your professional and personal well-being We also offer flexible work arrangements, competitive compensation, and ongoing learning opportunities to help you thrive. Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel. Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash . title: Mitarbeiter Qualitätsstelle (m/w/d)
description: Über uns Die FP Pro­duk­ti­ons- und Vertriebs-GmbH, ein Un­ter­neh­men der welt­weit tä­ti­gen Tata Grup­pe, ist ein füh­ren­der An­bie­ter von in­no­va­ti­ven und hoch­wer­ti­gen Bau­kom­po­nen­ten für die in­dus­tri­el­le und ge­werb­li­che Bau­wei­se. Mit über 80 Jah­ren Er­fah­rung set­zen wir Maß­stä­be in der Her­stel­lung von Pro­fil­ble­chen, Sandwichpaneelen und in­no­va­ti­ven Lö­sun­gen für So­lar- und Be­grü­nungs­sys­te­me. Un­ser Fo­kus liegt auf der Ent­wick­lung von Lö­sun­gen, die höchs­te An­sprü­che an En­er­gie­ef­fi­zi­enz und Nach­hal­tig­keit er­fül­len. Durch den Ein­satz mo­derns­ter Tech­no­lo­gi­en und um­welt­freund­li­cher Ma­te­ri­a­li­en tra­gen un­se­re Pro­duk­te da­zu bei, die En­er­gie­ef­fi­zi­enz von Ge­bäu­den zu stei­gern und den CO₂-Ausstoß sig­ni­fi­kant zu re­du­zie­ren. Wir se­hen es als un­se­re Ver­ant­wor­tung, einen nach­hal­ti­gen Bei­trag zur Scho­nung der na­tür­li­chen Res­sour­cen zu leis­ten und gleich­zei­tig die Zu­kunft des Bau­ens ak­tiv mit­zu­ge­stal­ten. Ihr Aufgabenbereich umfasst im Wesentlichen: Durchführung von Qualitätsprüfungen und Laboruntersuchungen an Sandwichelementen (PIR- und MIWO-Kern) Überwachung und Sicherstellung der Produktqualität während der laufenden Produktion Durchführung von Wareneingangs-, Prozess- und Endkontrollen Technologische Prüfungen der Bauprodukte sowie Unterstützung und Durchführung von Produkt- und Entwicklungsversuchen Probenentnahme, Herstellung und Vorbereitung von Prüfkörpern für Laborprüfungen Auswertung, Dokumentation und Bewertung der Prüfergebnisse Kontrolle der Elementqualität nach Produktwechseln inkl. Einleitung von Korrekturmaßnahmen Unterstützung bei Reklamationsanalysen sowie Mitwirkung bei Ursachenforschung (intern / ggf. Baustelle) Betreuung von Bauteilversuchen sowie Herstellung und Begleitung von Versuchselementen Was Sie mitbringen sollten: Abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung im technischen Bereich, idealerweise in der Metallindustrie oder Bauelemente- bzw. Baustoffindustrie Erste Erfahrungen im Bereich Qualitätssicherung oder Labor, idealerweise bei Sandwichelementen oder vergleichbaren Produkten Kenntnisse im Umgang mit Prüftechnik und Laborequipment Gute PC-Kenntnisse (MS Office, idealerweise Zwick/TestXpert oder vergleichbare Prüfsoftware) Technisches Verständnis für Werkstoffe (Metall, PIR, Mineralwolle) von Vorteil Sorgfältige, analytische und strukturierte Arbeitsweise Teamfähigkeit, Zuverlässigkeit sowie ausgeprägtes Qualitäts- und Sicherheitsbewusstsein Bereitschaft zur Arbeit im Schichtbetrieb Was wir bieten: Eine interessante Tätigkeit innerhalb eines internationalen Konzernumfeldes Eine der Aufgabenstellung entsprechende Vergütung Individuelle Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten 30 Tage Urlaub Bike-Leasing Corporate Benefits Urban Sports Club Ihre ersten Monate In den ersten sechs Monaten Ihrer Probezeit lernen Sie unsere Abläufe, Fertigungsanlagen und das Qualitätsmanagement-Team in Netphen im Detail kennen. Sie arbeiten sich Schritt für Schritt in die eigenständige Prüfung unserer Baukomponenten ein und übernehmen Verantwortung für Ihre ersten eigenen Prüfprozesse. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Es ist nicht der Kern der Stelle, aber es kommt vor, und wir sagen es lieber vorher. Was du nicht machst Bankgespräche führen, Markenentscheidungen treffen, Zahlungen freigeben. Das bleibt im ersten Jahr bei der Geschäftsführung. Vorbereiten und mitdenken wirst du überall. Wer du bist Uns interessiert weniger, was du schon gemacht hast, als wie du bist. title: Deal Desk Manager, APAC
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h4><strong>About the Deal Desk Team</strong></h4> <p>The Deal Desk team is a critical component of the Finance function, serving as a trusted advisor to critical internal stakeholders as deal architect working on structuring, negotiating, approving and closing large complex commitment deals while balancing margin preservation, compliance, and velocity. We are committed to building a data-centric and AI-augmented Deal Desk that leverages predictive analytics and automated workflows to optimize pricing in real-time and automate routine approvals, allowing for deeper strategic focus.</p> <p><strong>Available Location: Singapore</strong></p> <p><strong>Role Summary</strong></p> <p>As a Deal Desk Manager, you will be the architect of our AI-driven deal desk, transitioning our sales process from manual workflows to an intelligent, automated engine that spans from initial scoping to final execution. By leveraging agentic workflows and automated data layers, the focus shifts to high-judgment architecture for non-standard enterprise deals. The objective is to serve as a high-influence "Sales Co-pilot," using AI-driven insights to maximize deal velocity and Long-Term Value (LTV) while relentlessly reducing friction through iterative process automation.</p> <p><strong>What you’ll do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Orchestrate Strategic Deal Architecture: Lead the structuring and execution of non-standard, high-value enterprise deals, providing high-judgment guidance that balances competitive differentiation with long-term business health. Build creative financial models and custom discount strategies that align customer usage patterns with corporate revenue goals.</li> <li>Sales Co-pilot & Strategic Influence: Serve as a strategic partner to Sales leadership, utilizing data driven insights and workflows to maximize deal velocity, improve LTV, and ensure discovery reflects true customer needs.
