Drive consensus across internal stakeholders (Legal, Finance, Revenue Recognition, Compliance and Product) to negotiate viable compromises on non-standard commercial, financial, and legal terms while safeguarding corporate margin thresholds and risk tolerance.</li> <li>Champion AI, Curate and Tune AI Agents for Automation Integration: Manage the enterprise deal approval ecosystem by tuning automated agents and models to ensure compliance and accuracy at scale. Champion the integration of LLMs and generative AI tools to automate deal desk workflows, significantly reducing deal cycle times. Identify bottlenecks and implement AI-powered productivity solutions.</li> <li>Drive Process Iteration: Partner with cross-functional teams (Legal, Finance, Product) to build, streamline, and automate deal desk processes, architecting autonomous approval workflows and focusing on reducing field friction through relentless automation.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Role Specifications & Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>Minimum 8+ years of Deal Desk, FP&A, Revenue Operations, or similar experience with a proven track record supporting large-scale enterprise sales motions; 3+ years of direct deal desk experience (deal analysis, deal governance and customer negotiation) preferred</li> <li><strong>Financial & Sales Acumen: </strong>Solid understanding of SaaS metrics, pricing models, and financial concepts like ARR, Gross Margin, churn, and profitability. Experience with revenue recognition principles (e.g., ASC 606) is highly desirable. Experience selling software is a bonus</li> <li><strong>Contract & Pricing Knowledge: </strong>Experience drafting and interpreting commercial contracts, with a focus on terms that impact revenue recognition and financial risk. Ability to analyze and recommend the best course of action for complex pricing and licensing situations</li> <li><strong>Data & AI Literacy: </strong>Proficiency in leveraging agentic workflows and prompt engineering to scale influence, extract insights from large datasets, and automate repetitive operational tasks and internal documentation. Ability to understand and audit automated pricing models to ensure alignment with long-term company goals.Relentless focus on iterative automation and translating complex business policies into streamlined, automated logic</li> <li><strong>Strategic Influence & Negotiation: </strong>Demonstrated ability to navigate complex, internal cross-functional negotiations and make high-judgment decisions in fast-paced environments. Partner directly with Sales Management and Account Executives  during external customer negotiations, equipping them with counter-proposal options or directly engaging in client commercial discussions to structure win-win enterprise agreements</li> <li><strong>Communication: </strong>Serve as the single point of contact between Sales, Finance, Revenue Recognition (ASC 606), Legal, and Product Management on advising deal constructing and managing deal escalation. Skilled in commercial negotiation strategy, advising Sales on customer-facing concessions, and directly engaging in external negotiations with customer procurement/legal teams to drive deal closure. Exceptional written and oral communication skills, capable of explaining complex deal structures and financial data to both technical and executive stakeholders</li> <li>Language Preference: Additional proficiency in Mandarin or Japanese would be beneficial for engaging with customers and stakeholders in relevant APJC markets.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About WPP Media</strong></p> <p>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. Dans un monde où les médias sont omniprésents nous regroupons la meilleure plateforme, les meilleurs talents et les meilleurs partenaires pour développer les solutions les plus innovantes, offrant une croissance inégalée à nos clients. Pour plus d'informations, visitez <a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/">wppmedia.com</a>.</p> <p>Chez WPP Media, nous croyons en la puissance de notre culture et de nos collaborateurs. C'est grâce à cette synergie que nous parvenons à créer des expériences véritablement exceptionnelles, tant pour nos clients que pour nos équipes internes. Pour réussir dans ce poste, il est fondamental d'incarner les valeurs essentielles qui unissent WPP et WPP Media :</p> <ul> <li>Être <strong>Extraordinaire</strong> en favorisant un leadership collectif qui inspire une créativité véritablement transformationnelle.</li> <li>Créer un environnement <strong>Ouvert</strong> en trouvant l'équilibre parfait entre l'épanouissement de nos données auprès des différentes équipes.</li> <li>Accompagner les membres de l’agence dans l’adoption et l’utilisation des outils Data & Tech.</li> <li>Assurer le respect des directives digitales globales de Richemont.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Compétences requises :</strong></p> <ul> <li>En bac +4/+5 en école d’ingénieur ou de commerce spécialisation digitale, data, tech, à la recherche d'un stage de 5 mois minimum</li> <li>Une passion pour les médias, la publicité et les nouvelles technologies.</li> <li>Une bonne capacité d’analyse et d’interprétation des données et des chiffres</li> <li>Des qualités de chef de projet : coordination, agilité et priorisation des sujets</li> <li>Anglais : C1/C2 à l’oral et à l’écrit impératif <em>(une deuxième langue serait un atout)</em></li> <li>Outils : Excel (maîtrise des TCD et de RechercheX, Somme.si)</li> <li>Connaissance de Google Analytics ou autre outil d’attribution</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>La vie chez WPP Media et ses avantages</strong></p> <p>Notre engagement à façonner l'avenir des médias se manifeste par un soutien actif au développement professionnel de nos talents, les aidant à atteindre leur title: Field Marketing Manager, SMB and Mid-Market - EMEA
description: <h2><strong>Who we are </strong></h2> <h3><strong>About Stripe</strong></h3> <p>Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.</p> <h3><strong>About the team</strong></h3> <p>The Stripe EMEA Marketing team is a dynamic and rapidly growing group dedicated to transforming customers into enthusiastic advocates for Stripe. Collaborating closely with sales, we focus on accelerating the path to purchase and enhancing product adoption among our user base. Our regional marketing efforts involve crafting and executing tailored marketing plans that resonate with local audiences, as well as spearheading our most significant conferences and sponsorships that drive go-to-market success and business growth. Join us and be part of a culture that celebrates teamwork, innovates boldly, and makes a meaningful impact.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <p>We’re looking for a strategic, results-oriented marketing leader to drive our marketing engine for SMB and Mid-Market segments across EMEA, with an emphasis on Ideal Customer Profiles. This segment represents a massive portion of Europe’s economic fabric and is a critical driver of our ambitions in the region.</p> <p>This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who thrives at the intersection of strategy, execution, and cross-functional influence. You'll translate global priorities into locally resonant programs, ensuring that audiences in the SMB and Mid-Market space have high-quality, insight-driven experiences throughout their lifecycle, from early exploration to long-term partnership.</p> <p>The ideal candidate is data-driven, has an unbridled passion for working hand-in-hand with regional sales teams to drive successful user outcomes, and is excited about building a high-velocity revenue engine.</p> <h3><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Define and execute the EMEA marketing strategy for SMB and Mid-Market segments with an emphasis on Ideal Customer Profiles</li> <li>Own key business and revenue metrics throughout the sales funnel, with a strong emphasis on accelerating pipeline through upsell and cross-sell opportunities</li> <li>Collaborate with Partner Marketing to create successful co-selling initiatives that extend our reach within the partner and developer ecosystems</li> <li>Develop and execute comprehensive full-funnel marketing plans, partnering with digital marketing and demand generation teams to secure high-value deals</li> <li>Partner closely with Sales leadership to align account plans, ensure disciplined lead follow-up, and establish trust as a strategic partner</li> <li>Collaborate with EMEA demand generation and product marketing to identify, scope, and produce or localize compelling content and marketing assets</li> <li>Track, measure, and communicate program results, continually optimizing for efficiency and scale while seeking to generate new global best practices, and innovate ways to educate a diverse range of personas about the value that Stripe delivers to businesses</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Who you are</strong></h2> <p>We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.</p> <h3><strong>Minimum requirements</strong></h3> <ul> <li>7+ years of relevant B2B marketing experience in the EMEA technology market, including specific experience with demand generation and field marketing</li> <li>Proven track record of defining and executing B2B marketing strategies that successfully drive metrics, key performance indicators, and pipeline generation</li> <li>Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to convey complex topics with simplicity to diverse audiences</li> <li>Strategic mindset with strong problem-solving capabilities and a data-driven approach to decision-making, along with a deep understanding of full-funnel journeys and marketing technology like Salesforce</li> <li>Experience scaling programs through agency resources and collaborating across key go-to-market stakeholders</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Preferred qualifications</strong></h3> <ul> <li>A startup mentality with a bias to action and the ability to flex in a fast-paced industry and work environment</li> <li>Experience in the payments, financial technology, or adjacent industries, or marketing FinTech solutions or to FinTech companies</li> <li>Understanding of the payments, financial technology, and ecommerce industries and partner ecosystems</li> <li>Demonstrated success delivering marketing programs with and through consulting and technology partners</li> </ul> <p> </p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

description: Job summary (Short promotional text) We are looking for a Senior Consultant to strengthen our European Grants team in France. title: Go To Market Lead, DACH
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>About Gigs</strong></h2> <p data-start="67" data-end="227">At Gigs, we're building the operating system for mobile services—a platform that lets tech companies embed global connectivity into their products effortlessly.</p> <p class="p1">Just as Stripe lets any business add a payment button in seconds, Gigs empowers platforms to weave in connectivity—bridging the traditional world of telecom with modern tech. From fintechs launching mobile services to HR platforms offering work phone plans, we automate provisioning and remove telecom complexity.</p> <p data-start="585" data-end="974">Our team of around 150 people across the US and Europe, backed by nearly $100 million in funding from Ribbit Capital, Google, and Y Combinator. As one of the fastest-growing tech companies, bringing together early-stage engineers, product builders, and business athletes from companies like Stripe, Airbnb, and Shopify. We’re tackling deep technical and regulatory challenges to make connectivity truly seamless.</p> <p class="p1">If you’re driven by curiosity, creativity, and the chance to shape the future of telecom, we’d love to hear from you.</p> <h2><strong>Things We Care About</strong></h2> <p>We are building in a highly complex space and tackling a massive problem. We want people who lean in when things get hard.</p> <ul> <li><strong>Speed. </strong>We move and we ship. We set bold deadlines and treat every week like it matters.</li> <li><strong>Ownership.</strong> If you see something broken, fix it. We don't wait for permission.</li> <li><strong>Customer Obsession</strong>. Our customers' product is our product.</li> <li><strong>Ambiguity. </strong>We're building frontier technology in a complex domain. You'll need sound judgement and good instincts to make decisions without complete information.</li> <li><strong>First principles. </strong>We don't ask how things have been done before. We ask why they were done that way at all.</li> </ul></div><h2><strong>The Role</strong></h2> <p>DACH is one of the most exciting European markets for Gigs. With world-class fintech infrastructure, highly digitised economies, strong telecom ecosystems, and some of Europe’s most sophisticated B2B buyers, the region is a natural fit for what we’re building.</p> <p>We’re looking for a Go to Market (GTM) Lead to own our DACH strategy and execution end-to-end - from landing lighthouse customers and building operator partnerships to setting up and growing a high-performance regional team.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Salary range: </strong>€125,000 - €150,000 basic salary + sales commission plan. </p> <p class="p1">(The final offer depends on your background, skills, and how you perform through the process. We're open to considering outlier candidates, which may result in an adjustment to the scope and compensation)</p> <p> </p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h2>Work At Gigs</h2> <p>At Gigs, we value in-person collaboration. We believe the best ideas, decisions, and relationships are built when teams spend meaningful time together, and our culture is designed around that belief. We support flexibility where it makes sense. Some focused work can be done remotely, and not every role or week looks the same. <strong>You should expect regular time in one of our</strong> <strong>hubs</strong>, as well as occasional travel for team workshops, customer meetings, and <strong>Gigs Republic, our bi-annual company off-site</strong>. Our offices are designed to feel like home-inspired workspaces, with plants, thoughtful tools, and small, tight-knit teams that make collaboration feel natural, energizing, and effective.</p> <h2>What We Offer</h2> <p>At Gigs, we believe in rewarding excellence. We also provide stipends for your home office or work setup, a budget for learning and development to fuel your career, and of course, a free phone and international data plan</p> <p><em>Want to learn more about our benefits, hubs, and what it’s like to work at Gigs? Check out our <a href="https://gigs.com/careers">Careers</a> page.</em></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Software Engineer Intern (2027)
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lisbon, PT</li> </ul> <p><strong>Available Terms</strong></p> <ul> <li>Winter/Spring (January - May 2027) </li> <li>Summer (May - September 2027)</li> </ul> <p><strong>About the Role</strong></p> <p>Anytime we push code, it automatically affects the millions of Internet properties (powering websites, remote teams, APIs, mobile apps, etc.) running on our global network. Cloudflare's network is one of the largest in the world and spans over 330 cities in more than 125 countries. What's more, Cloudflare operates within 50 milliseconds of 95% of the Internet-connected population globally (for context, the blink of an eye is 300-400 milliseconds!). We are passionate about making the Internet more secure, reliable, and faster for everyone.</p> <p>Cloudflare’s Engineering teams build and run the software that handles the massive amount of traffic that flows through our network. We also have teams that build the UI and control plane for our software, using modern patterns and libraries in a microservices-based architecture. Technologies include: Typescript/Javascript, Go, Rust, C/C++ and Python.</p> <p>The ideal intern is passionate about making the Internet a better place. You will work alongside experienced engineers. You will push code this internship that touches hundreds of millions of web surfers. We like to get things done, so we are looking for interns who are curious, proactive, and able to complete projects. This is a great opportunity for engineers who want to learn to develop at Internet scale.</p> <p>You can check out our <a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/tag/internship-experience/">internship blogs</a> to learn more about our program and hear directly from our past interns.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Ship and deliver projects over 12-14 weeks with autonomy and support.</li> <li>Work cross-functionally with various teams.</li> <li>Work closely with a mentor to guide you through the internship and help with career goals.</li> <li>Build your network across the company through our various in and out of office socials, networking programs, Employee Resource Group (ERG) programs, and Activity Groups.</li> <li>Present your project to the entire company at the end of the internship.</li> <li>Connect and learn from our executives and leadership team including our co-founders.</li> <li>Learn and develop skills through our professional development workshops.</li> <li>Write for our <a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/">Cloudflare blog</a> and be featured on <a href="http://cloudflare.tv/">Cloudflare.tv</a> sessions. </li> </ul> <p><strong>Desirable Skills, Knowledge and Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>Currently pursuing a degree or program in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics or relevant field to the role.</li> <li>Demonstrated critical thinking skills and drive to learn and adapt new technologies.</li> <li>Curiosity, empathy and ability to get things done.</li> <li>Ability to commit to a full-time (40 hours/week Monday - Friday) for a minimum 12 week internship.</li> <li>In office 3-5 days a week in Lisbon, PT.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus Points</strong></p> <p>Demonstrated passion for software development, such as personal projects, open-source contributions, or experience with our developer platform using <a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/students/">Cloudflare for Students.</a></p> <ul> <li>For Portugal based hires: the monthly salary is €2,450.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Please note</strong></p> <ul> <li>We will be hiring interns on a rolling basis until all roles are filled.</li> <li>We are not considering remote or part-time for either terms. This is a full-time (40hr/week internship) with in-person expectations; standard business hours are typically 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM. You should not be enrolled in classes, which would conflict with full-time commitment.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. title: Director, Key Accounts
description: Imagine having the power to stress-test an entire power grid against a hurricane or thunderstorm before the clouds even gather. That is the reality we are creating at Neara. This is a hands-on, high-impact player-coach role focused predominantly on personal account execution paired with informal team leadership and commercial mentoring. To succeed in this role, you will need a consultative mindset, excellent communication skills, and knowledge of the utilities industry. You will also need a proven track record of commercial execution across large, multi-year, multi-faceted contracts, and experience leading or mentoring a customer-facing team. What You'll Do Personally own and grow relationships with a portfolio of our most strategic accounts, serving as the senior commercial relationship owner and executive point of contact. Develop and deliver expansion plans across assigned key accounts to execute against business metrics and revenue goals. Coach the team on account strategy, executive engagement, and commercial execution on complex, multi-year contracts. Identify new workflow improvements and use-case opportunities, helping to upskill the broader customer-facing team in commercial best practices. Collaborate with Customer Success Operations, Customer Value Architects, and Product on overall account strategy and execution. Develop processes to scale the Key Account Management function as Neara's European business grows. Co-present with utilities at key conferences and events across Europe, helping elevate Neara’s market presence. Report on account performance, pipeline, and expansion opportunities to senior leadership. Who You Are Demonstrated history of personally managing and expanding enterprise-level accounts within complex technical or SaaS environments, ideally operating as a Director of Key Accounts, Director of Sales, Key Account Manager, Client Partner, or in a similar enterprise role. Domain exposure to the utilities sector or a similarly complex, technical, infrastructure-heavy industry is highly desirable. Experience leading, managing, or mentoring Account Managers or Customer Success Managers, ideally in a player-coach capacity. Experience in strategic sales, management consulting, or tech-enabled enterprise environments. Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to navigate executive dynamics and foster a collaborative, customer-centric culture internally. Fluent in English (required); additional European languages are a plus. What We Are Offering You Competitive salary + commission structure. Significant development opportunities with scope for lateral and upward movement in a high-growth company. Highly meritocratic, non-bureaucratic, and low-ego work culture. description: <h1><strong>Staff Digital Product Designer – E-Commerce / Web Platform</strong></h1> <p><strong>Department:</strong> E-Commerce & Customer Experience / Web Team</p> <p><strong>Level:</strong> Individual Contributor Lead (Staff Level)</p> <p><strong>Location:</strong> Lille / Paris </p> <h2><strong>1. Context & Project</strong></h2> <p>Decathlon's purpose is to bring people together through sport to make wellbeing accessible for all, guiding our overarching ambition to build a <strong>Local Human Bond</strong> and deliver accessible, unique sporting solutions globally. In this context, our goal is to build personalized, enriched experiences across all digital touchpoints and physical stores, leveraging Digital, Data, and AI to elevate the global customer journey.</p> <h3><strong>The E-Commerce Web Challenge</strong></h3> <p>As the digital front door for millions of sport practice enthusiasts around the globe, our web platform (decathlon.country) must seamlessly convert online curiosity into real-world sport experiences. Our challenge is to transform a massive, multi-category web store into an intuitive, frictionless digital portal.</p> <p>We need to guide every user—from a first-time visitor searching for sports goods to a returning member—through a smooth journey that connects online browsing directly with local store availability, click-and-collect, and circular services like rentals and repairs.</p> <p>By building a standardized, modular web experience, we equip country teams and international franchise partners with pre-validated, high-converting funnel journeys so they can scale local commerce effortlessly without rebuilding core web experiences from scratch.</p> <h3><strong>Scope & Structure (4 Dedicated E-Com Squads)</strong></h3> <ol> <li><strong>Acquisition:</strong> Turn global internet users into active visitors through high-converting landing experiences, SEO, campaign entry points, and personalized traffic onboarding.</li> <li><strong>Navigation:</strong> Help users find the exact product or advice they need within a vast catalog through intelligent search, taxonomy, filtering, and catalog hierarchy.</li> <li><strong>Decision:</strong> Give users every compelling reason to choose a product using rich product detail pages (PDP), media, sizing confidence, customer reviews, and circular/sustainability options.</li> <li><strong>Conversion:</strong> Deliver frictionless checkout, flexible payment methods, order self-tracking, store pickup options, and effortless returns.</li> </ol> <h2><strong>2. Your Mission</strong></h2> <p>As a <strong>Staff Digital Product Designer</strong>, you operate as a principal individual contributor and strategic leader within the Decathlon E-Commerce team. Operating with high autonomy on complex, cross-squad web challenges, you shape our long-term </p> <p><strong>E-Commerce Web Experience Vision</strong>.</p> <p>You will work in close triad leadership with <strong>Staff Engineering</strong> and <strong>Staff Product Managers (GPMs)</strong>, while partnering hand-in-hand with a <strong>dedicated UX Researcher (UXR)</strong> as your main practice partner to ground every design decision in deep user insights and quantitative data.</p> <p>Beyond defining strategy, you lead <strong>hands-on experimentation, product de-risking, and rapid validation loops</strong>—ensuring high-stakes web features across Acquisition, Navigation, Decision, and Conversion are proven through A/B testing, CRO analysis, and real user data before global rollout. You align the 4 web squads around a unified web vision, accelerate commercial value delivery, and elevate design craft maturity across teams.</p> <h2><strong>3. What You’ll Do</strong></h2> <h3><strong>Strategic Alignment & Web Funnel Vision</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Triad Leadership:</strong> Partner closely with Staff Engineers, Staff PMs, and your dedicated UXR partner to define long-term roadmaps, tech feasibility, and strategic UX priorities across squads.</li> <li><strong>Web Experience Strategy:</strong> Define and advocate for the long-term web design strategy, establishing web principles that influence product and commercial roadmaps.</li> <li><strong>4-Squad Orchestration:</strong> Drive alignment across the <strong>Acquisition, Navigation, Decision, and Conversion</strong> squads to ensure a cohesive end-to-end web journey without siloed user friction.</li> <li><strong>Priority Segment Focus:</strong> Set strategic web UX direction tailored to key user segments (<strong>Families, New Customers, Members</strong>), driving personalization and context-aware landing journeys.</li> <li><strong>Macro Metrics Tracking:</strong> Track and optimize web performance metrics across the full funnel: <strong>SEO Traffic, CTR, Search Success, Add-to-Cart Rate, Conversion Rate, and Retention</strong>.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Product De-Risking & Web Experimentation Strategy</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Research Partner Alignment:</strong> Work hand-in-hand with UXR to formulate hypotheses, map user knowledge gaps, and design research strategies for complex e-commerce flows.</li> <li><strong>De-Risking Frameworks:</strong> Formulate and drive product de-risking strategies for high-impact web initiatives—identifying usability, commercial, and technical risks early in discovery.</li> <li><strong>Concrete Web Experimentation:</strong> Design and execute hands-on A/B tests, multivariate testing, CRO experiments, and prototype usability tests across the 4 squads to validate hypotheses before engineering rollouts.</li> <li><strong>Data-Informed Decisions:</strong> Partner with Data & Analytics leads to build quantitative testing frameworks, leveraging web analytics to guide roadmap trade-offs.</li> <li><strong>Testing Culture Elevation:</strong> Coach web product squads on hypothesis formulation, CRO best practices, and rapid build-measure-learn loops.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>4. Role & Responsibilities (Skills & Behaviors)</strong></h2> <h3> </h3> <h3><strong>Craft / Technical Skills</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Research & Web Strategy:</strong> Partner closely with our UXR to enrich foundational customer knowledge (B2C web journeys) and co-define a CX vision to build collective alignment across stakeholders.</li> <li><strong>Problem Discovery:</strong> Uncover drop-off points across the 4 squads through quantitative funnel analytics and qualitative research; structure decisions using Opportunity Solution Trees (OST).</li> <li><strong>Solution Discovery:</strong> Explore and prototype web interfaces early and often; design high-converting, accessible, and responsive layouts connected to our Design System.</li> <li><strong>Testing & CRO:</strong> Continuously de-risk solution feasibility, usability, and conversion lift using context-tailored testing tools (A/B testing, user testing, CRO analytics).</li> <li><strong>AI Exploration:</strong> Test and integrate AI tools (e.g., generative search, smart recommendations, automated layout testing) to amplify design and research workflows.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Behaviors / Soft Skills</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Leadership & Strategic Collaboration:</strong> Lead cross-squad web taskforces alongside Staff Engineering and Staff PMs, make sound decisions under partial data, and support the Design Manager in org planning and hiring committees.</li> <li><strong>Influence & Emotional Intelligence:</strong> Work proactively across PMs, Engineering Managers, and Business Leads to shape priorities using emotional intelligence and data-backed storytelling.</li> <li><strong>Cross-Functional Collaboration:</strong> Involve engineering, data, UXR, and SEO teams early in the design process to create a psychologically safe, feedback-rich environment.</li> <li><strong>Design Mentoring:</strong> Elevate the web design practice by mentoring 3–4 designers, facilitating cross-squad design critiques, and connecting design solutions across teams.</li> <li><strong>Growth Mindset:</strong> Turn failed A/B experiments into collective learning opportunities and maintain a structured personal growth plan.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>5. Why Join the E-Commerce Web Team?</strong></h2> <h3><strong>Challenges You Will Tackle</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>High-Scale Web Impact:</strong> Optimizing a global web platform handling millions of daily visits across dozens of international markets.</li> <li><strong>4-Squad Synergy:</strong> Unifying <strong>Acquisition, Navigation, Decision, and Conversion</strong> into one fluid, frictionless web journey.</li> <li><strong>Strong Triad Partnership:</strong> Working in direct alignment with Staff Engineering, Staff PMs, and a dedicated UXR partner to shape high-level product strategy.</li> <li><strong>Performance & Accessibility at Scale:</strong> Designing lightweight, lightning-fast web pages that meet strict WCAG accessibility and SEO benchmarks.</li> </ul> <h3> </h3> <h3><strong>This Role Is a Perfect Match for You If…</strong></h3> <ul> <li>You thrive on <strong>de-risking web journeys via A/B testing and CRO data</strong> rather than subjective opinions.</li> <li>You excel at <strong>triad collaboration</strong> with Staff Tech and Staff PMs, backed by deep research partnership with UXR.</li> <li>You enjoy <strong>orchestrating design across multiple squads</strong> (Acquisition through Conversion) to deliver a unified customer experience.</li> <li>You balance <strong>commercial conversion into  goals with high design standards and accessibility</strong>.</li> <li>You love <strong>mentoring designers</strong> and upskilling teams in experimentation, data literacy, and web craft excellence.</li> </ul> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><p> </p> <p><strong>DECATHLON DIGITAL CONTEXT </strong></p> <p>What if technology allowed us to push the boundaries and take sports experiences to new levels? That's exactly our goal at Decathlon Digital! We are a team of 5,000+ experts in software engineering, product management, data, cloud, and cybersecurity, distributed across Paris, Lille, and Amsterdam. Together, we are creating the largest digital sports platform, leveraging tech innovation from design to value chain optimization, connected experiences and product second life.</p> <p><br&

description: Notre mission ⚖️ Chez Doctrine, nous construisons le leader de l’IA juridique en Europe. Notre conviction ? Le droit ne doit pas être ralenti par des tâches répétitives. Rejoindre une entreprise avec une vie d’équipe riche et dynamique : conférences, team-buildings, déjeuner, offsite, afterwork, etc. Nos valeurs 🤝 Chez Doctrine, nos 4 valeurs nous accompagnent au quotidien et dans notre ambition de faire bouger les choses. title: Forward Deployed Inference Engineer
description: About Tensordyne Tensordyne is building a new class of AI inference system designed for high-performance, power-efficient deployment of the world's most demanding generative AI workloads. Our platform combines purpose-built silicon, new AI math, optimized scale-up networking, and memory architecture into a tightly integrated system purpose built for large-scale AI inference. We work with hyperscalers, Neoclouds, frontier model developers, enterprises, and infrastructure partners operating at the leading edge of AI. As Tensordyne moves from system development into silicon bring-up, customer validation, beta deployments, and production rollout, we are building the technical customer organization that will sit directly between our engineering teams and the companies deploying the platform. Role summary We are looking for a Forward Deployed Inference Engineer who combines deep AI systems expertise with strong customer instincts. This person will own the path from a customer workload or model request to a technical result and, where needed, to an optimized model running successfully on Tensordyne hardware and software. The role sits at the intersection of model architecture, inference performance, systems optimization, developer tooling, and customer deployment. You will work hands-on with engineering while also acting as a technical bridge to Product, BizDev, Sales, and customers. What you will do Turn customer workloads into fast, credible performance answers through profiling & benchmarking . Define relevant KPIs, compare against competitive baselines, and keep our evaluation methodology current with external benchmarks. Model enablement & optimization: convert and bring up customer models on the Tensordyne stack, validate numerical quality, identify performance bottlenecks, and work with compiler, runtime, kernel, and system teams to improve results. Deployment / forward engineering: work directly with customers and partners on technical PoCs, integration, deployment, and debugging; translate requirements into measurable acceptance criteria for quality, latency, throughput, and other relevant KPIs. Track profiling-to-hardware accuracy by continuously comparing profiling/simulation results with actual hardware deployments, explain material gaps, and flag missing capabilities in the compiler, SDK, inference server, KV-cache management, or adjacent systems to the owning teams. Turn repeated customer-specific learnings into reusable tooling, documentation, benchmarks, or product improvements. Core qualifications Strong hands-on experience with AI models and inference systems , especially dense and MoE LLMs (Llama, DeepSeek, Qwen, GPT-OSS, Kimi, GLM), and VLM, speech and diffusion models. Strong Python and PyTorch skills and the ability to understand and modify model code. Experience profiling, benchmarking, or optimizing model inference and reasoning about latency, throughput, memory, and utilization. Strong problem-solving and communication skills, with the ability to drive ambiguous technical problems across team boundaries. Proficiency in using AI-powered developer tools (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor). Strong pluses Experience with LLM serving and deployment stacks such as vLLM, SGLang, or similar systems. Experience working directly with customers or external technical partners . title: Senior Product Developer – Candy & Confectionery (All Genders)
description: YOU & AHEAD At ahead, we are on a mission to clean up the world’s candy drawers. We make the snacks everyone actually craves: chocolate bars, protein bars, wafers, cookies, gummies and more. Our products contain up to 90% less sugar with zero compromise on taste. We are a 130-person team based in Hamburg, with our own lab, a portfolio of more than 170 SKUs and ambitious growth plans across D2C, retail, Amazon and Europe. We are looking for a Senior Product Developer for Candy & Confectionery to own the technical development of our portfolio from the first brief through formulation, sensory validation, scale-up and launch. As our Senior Product Developer, you will bring technical depth to one of our most important categories and make sure every decision works in the real world: in the recipe, in the factory and in the customer’s hands. Are you a food developer who knows how to turn a great idea into a product people genuinely love? Someone who can balance taste, texture, stability, cost, compliance and timing while getting the product over the line? If you like taking ownership and enjoy solving real product problems, we would love to hear from you! YOUR TASKS End-to-End Product Development: You own candy and confectionery projects from brief to launch. You translate requirements into clear technical targets, develop and optimise formulations, oversee trials, sensory validation and technical decisions. Sugar Reduction & Product Performance: You develop reduced-sugar and no-added-sugar products without compromising on taste. You understand how ingredients affect texture, processing, stability and shelf life, and make clear trade-offs between quality, cost, compliance and speed. Sensory, Shelf Life & Scale-Up: You plan and coordinate sensory, shelf-life and stability testing. You prepare for pilot and industrial trials, work closely with co-manufacturers, troubleshoot issues and follow solutions through to production. Specifications, Suppliers & Compliance: You manage formulations, specifications, technical documentation, ingredients and samples. Together with our Quality team, you ensure that food law, labelling, allergen, nutritional and claims requirements are considered from the start. Cross-Functional Ownership: You work closely with Product, Quality, Operations, Procurement, Brand, Retail and Marketing. You communicate clearly, flag risks early, challenge assumptions and keep projects moving. Building Better NPD Processes: You document decisions and learnings, create clear handovers and help make product development more structured and predictable as ahead grows. YOUR PROFILE You bring 5+ years of experience in food product development, R&D, or NPD, with a track record from brief through formulation, sensory validation, scale-up, and launch. Hands-on experience in gummies, candy, chocolate, confectionery, or a related sweet-goods category is mandatory. You understand how taste, texture, processing, stability, shelf life, ingredients and production realities come together in a successful product. You have experience with sugar-reduction or no-added-sugar systems and know how to balance product performance with consumer expectations. You have worked with ingredient suppliers and co-manufacturers and have been involved in pilot or industrial-scale production. You are comfortable with specifications, technical documentation, and food-law requirements. You take ownership and follow through. You are structured without being bureaucratic, comfortable with ambiguity and willing to challenge a brief, assumption or timeline when needed. You communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders and enjoy working as a senior individual contributor without direct reports initially. You hold a degree or equivalent training in food science, food technology, chemistry, nutrition science, ecotrophology, or a comparable field. You communicate confidently in German and English. WHAT MAKES YOUR PROFILE COMPLETE Experience launching 10+ food products, ideally across multiple markets. Experience working with gummies, candy, chocolate bars, cookies, filled confectionery or similar products. Strong knowledge of sugar reduction, sweetener systems, fibres and texture management. Experience planning, conducting or interpreting sensory tests, shelf-life studies and stability testing. Background in better-for-you food, functional food, private-label NPD, or a fast-growing consumer brand. Experience delivering products into D2C and retail channels across DACH or Europe. AND WHY AHEAD? Working at ahead is more than just a job - it’s your opportunity to develop as a professional and as a person, while shaping the future of snacking. Our mission is to make low sugar the new standard, and we pour that ambition into every product we create. You’ll become part of a team where international talent, startup drive, real impact, and true ownership come together. Hypergrowth Environment: If you're looking for greenfield, creative freedom, and real impact, you're in the right place. We're a team that is scaling fast - with purpose Great Workspace: A central office in the heart of Hamburg near the Alster, top equipment (MacBook), snacks, drinks, plenty of ahead products - and yes, a ping-pong table. We’re also pet-friendly, so you can always bring your furry friend along Amazing Team: Young, international, ambitious - inspiring colleagues who collaborate, support each other, and genuinely enjoy working together Career Growth: Develop through cross-functional projects, structured feedback cycles, and a steep learning curve in a dynamic, high growth environment. We offer a fair, attractive salary with role-dependent bonus opportunities Great Benefits: Fuel yourself with ahead snacks, drinks, and merch - we’ve got you covered. On top: a €50 monthly allowance to spend as you like - Urban Sports Club, mobility options, or vouchers from your favorite brands (IKEA, Rewe, Rossmann and more) Vacation Days: Enjoy 28 vacation days plus two extra days off on December 24 (Christmas Eve) and December 31 (New Year’s Eve) Events & Offsites: Regular after-work hangouts and legendary annual team offsites you won’t forget This role is based in Hamburg, with the flexibility of up to 2 home office days per week and the option to work from abroad for agreed upon periods. If this resonates with you, we're excited to go ahead with you! title: Gestionnaire service facturier F/H
description: Nous recrutons un gestionnaire service facturier à l’Agence comptable. Vous jouerez un rôle essentiel dans le traitement et le paiement des dépenses de l’UTC, depuis la réception des factures jusqu’à leur mise en paiement. Vous aurez la possibilité : . d'exercer vos compétences dans un environnement agréable et stimulant, au service de la communauté universitaire (étudiants, chercheurs, enseignants-chercheurs…) . de rejoindre une équipe accueillante, dynamique et expérimentée . de bénéficier de conditions de travail permettant un bon équilibre vie professionnelle - vie personnelle. Votre mission Vous assurez la réception, le contrôle, la comptabilisation et le paiement de tout type de dépense : factures, marchés publics, bourses, missions, gratification des stagiaires. Vous contribuez activement aux opérations de la chaîne de dépense. Vos activités Vous assurez la réception, la gestion et la dématérialisation des factures (espace numérique de travail, portail Chorus Pro). Vous procédez à la fiabilisation et à la mise en qualité des données comptables. Vous vérifiez la réalisation du service fait et l’apurement des opérations en attente. Vous contrôlez les pièces justificatives (factures, ordres de mission, bourses notamment) et leur validité. Vous liquidez les factures et procédez au paiement. Vous participez également à des opérations courantes du service comme la gestion des bourses. Vous êtes amené à suivre l’exécution de marchés publics, de contrats de maintenance ou de conventions et à renseigner les tableaux de suivi. Vous identifiez les anomalies, les rejets ou les pièces manquantes et vous assurez leur régularisation avec les interlocuteurs concernés. Une partie importante de votre activité repose sur la relation avec les gestionnaires des départements, des laboratoires et des services. Vous assurez les relances, suivez les demandes en cours et contribuez à l’apurement des opérations, si nécessaire. Vous suivez avec une attention particulière le délai global de paiement des centres financiers qui vous sont rattachés. Vous intervenez également sur une période spécifique comme la fin d’exercice. Nous recherchons un profil avec une expérience en comptabilité, à l’aise avec l’analyse de données comptables et financières courantes, appréciant les activités nécessitant méthode, précision et respect des procédures. Informations complémentaires Dates pour candidater Du 05/10/2026 au 04/11/2026 Type de recrutement et date prévisionnelle de recrutement Poste ouvert aux personnels de catégorie B, par voie statutaire (mutation, détachement) ou contractuelle (contrat à durée déterminée d’un an, prolongation possible pouvant aboutir à un CDI) – à pourvoir début janvier 2027 Salaire mensuel brut Suivant statut ou par la voie contractuelle, selon expérience Pour les fonctionnaires, RIFSEEP : catégorie B - Groupe 2 Pour les agents contractuels, salaire mensuel brut de 1 867 euros à 2 500 euros, selon expérience Volume horaire 37 heures et 30 minutes/semaine - 1 607 heures/an Congés 50 jours de congés, RTT comprise, par année universitaire Contexte et environnement de travail Vous rejoindrez une équipe de 4 personnes, le service facturier au sein de l’Agence comptable. Placé sous l’autorité de l’agent comptable, vous rendrez compte à la responsable du service facturier, particulièrement sur les dossiers nécessitant une intervention ou un arbitrage. Vous serez en contact avec de nombreux interlocuteurs : les membres de l’équipe du service facturier et de l’agence comptable, les chargés d’affaires de la direction des affaires financières, les gestionnaires des différents services de l’UTC, les partenaires et usagers (fournisseurs, organismes, étudiants, stagiaires). Dans un contexte de forte mobilisation, vous participerez à la modernisation des pratiques du service facturier et la migration vers Sifac+ prévue pour le 01/01/2028. Une première expérience professionnelle dans le domaine comptable est attendue. Diplôme et formation Diplôme : baccalauréat au minimum, BTS / DUT apprécié Domaine de formation : Comptabilité, gestion comptabilité, finance Connaissances et compétences opérationnelles Systèmes d’information financiers, maîtrise de Sifac ou Sifac+ ou à minima d’un ERP SAP fortement appréciée Maîtrise des concepts de base en comptabilité Connaissances des règles de la GBCP ou à minima de leur existence dans le contexte des finances publiques Mettre en œuvre des procédures et des règles Connaissance de l’enseignement supérieur et de la recherche Utiliser avec aisance les outils bureautiques (tableur et traitement de texte, notamment), la messagerie électronique et des logiciels spécifiques à l’activité Communiquer et faire preuve de pédagogie Travailler en équipe Compétences comportementales Rigueur dans le suivi des dossiers et des délais d’exécution des tâches confiées Dynamisme Sens relationnel Sens de la confidentialité exigé Capacité à vous adapter à des périodes d’activité plus soutenues, notamment lors des pics d’activité en fin d’exercice Être capable de proposer des solutions simples aux problématiques rencontrées avec les divers interlocuteurs. title: CDI - DESIGNER JUNIOR JERSEY (H/F)
description: LA MAISON JACQUEMUS Jacquemus a été fondée par Simon Porte Jacquemus en 2009 à Paris, en France. Dédiée à la mémoire de la mère du créateur, la marque puise son inspiration dans une passion pour la culture. Les collections femme et homme font référence à l'art de vivre à la française et aux gestes universels de beauté, intégrant des influences allant de la photographie d'art aux arts décoratifs, en passant par le cinéma, la peinture et la sculpture. Au fil des années, Jacquemus a mis en scène ses défilés dans des lieux uniques et inattendus, notamment une piscine parisienne, le Musée Picasso, un champ de lavande en Provence, un champ de blé aux abords de Paris, un marais salant en Camargue et une plage à Hawaï. Plus récemment, la marque a investi des lieux tels que le canal du Château de Versailles (Le Chouchou), la Fondation Maeght (Les Sculptures), la Casa Malaparte (La Casa) et l'appartement parisien d'Auguste Perret (La Croisière). Basé dans le 8ᵉ arrondissement de Paris, Jacquemus est une maison de mode indépendante comptant plus de 300 employés. Réputée pour sa forte présence numérique et son expansion internationale, la marque a développé des expériences de vente innovantes à travers le monde avant d'ouvrir son premier flagship permanent au 58 Avenue Montaigne à Paris en 2022. Depuis, des boutiques ont été ouvertes à New York (SoHo) et Londres (New Bond Street). VOTRE ROLE Rattaché(e) à la Head of Design, vous intervenez sur la création des collections homme et femme, jersey, bain et flou show, des recherches d'images jusqu'au suivi des prototypes en normalisation. Ce poste couvre à la fois la création et le développement produit : vous travaillez en lien avec les usines partenaires et participez au bien aller de chaque pièce. VOS MISSIONS Réaliser les recherches iconographiques et construire les boards de collection Mener les recherches de volumes, de finitions et de graphismes Réaliser les visuels sur Photoshop et les maquettes Assurer le sourcing matière Établir les fiches de lancement et suivre les corrections de prototypes Réaliser les dessins techniques Participer aux essayages Accompagner les pièces jusqu'à la normalisation, en lien avec les usines VOTRE PROFIL Vous justifiez d'une première expérience d'environ 2 ans en tant que designer junior, idéalement sur le jersey et/ou le flou. Vous avez également : Une sensibilité forte pour le bien aller du vêtement, avec un attrait pour le flou et le travail en 3D La maîtrise de la suite Adobe (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign) et une aisance en dessin technique Un esprit autonome, débrouillard et force de proposition La capacité à prendre rapidement des automatismes et à gérer plusieurs sujets en parallèle L'envie d'évoluer au sein d'un studio créatif exigeant Le poste est basé à Paris dans le 8ème arrondissement Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Netzwerkingenieur (m/w/d)
description: Bei FlixTrain gestaltest du die Zukunft der Mobilität aktiv mit. Wir bieten dir nicht nur sichere Arbeitsplätze sowie attraktive Zusatzleistungen, sondern auch ein dynamisches, internationales Umfeld, in dem deine Ideen echten Einfluss haben. Als Netzwerkingenieur (m/w/d) bei FlixTrain verantwortest du die Technologie, die bestimmt, wie unsere Fahrgäste an Bord verbunden sind, navigieren und jede Reise erleben - von WLAN und Netzwerk-Infrastruktur über On-Board-Units bis hin zu mobilen Endgeräten für unser Zugpersonal. In einer Bahnwelt, in der Konnektivität zum entscheidenden Differenzierungsmerkmal wird und Technologien wie Starlink neu definieren, was möglich ist, prägst du unmittelbar, wie FlixTrain vorne bleibt und weiterhin hochwertige, unvergessliche Reisen bietet. Als Teil des Product-Development-Teams im Bereich Rolling-Stock & Maintenance sorgst du dafür, dass unsere On-Board-Hardware ein herausragendes Reiseerlebnis für unsere Fahrgäste, einen reibungslosen Betrieb und eine gute Arbeitsumgebung für unser Zugpersonal ermöglicht. Deine Arbeit beeinflusst direkt, wie FlixTrain im Wettbewerb um Konnektivität an Bord die Nase vorn behält und verlässliche, hochwertige Reiseerlebnisse liefert. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Operations, Customer Product und FlixTech sowie mit externen Partnern wie Talgo, ECMs und Lieferanten (z. B. Icomera, Advantech) zusammen. Über die Rolle Du verantwortest das gesamte On-Board-Technologie-Ökosystem von FlixTrain - WLAN, Netzwerke, On-Board-Units und mobile Endgeräte - und gibst dich nie mit dem Status quo zufrieden Als zentrale technische Ansprechperson für alle On-Board-Systeme bewertest du Spezifikationen, wägst Trade-offs ab und triffst fundierte, gut begründete Entscheidungen Kontinuierlich überwachst du die Performance unserer On-Board-Technologie, erkennst Probleme frühzeitig und treibst Verbesserungen voran, die jede Reise reibungsloser machen Cross-funktionale Projekte rund um Konnektivität, Netzwerk-Performance und die Integration mobiler Endgeräte in die Fahrzeugflotte leitest du eigenverantwortlich und mit klarem Fokus auf Wirkung Technische Spezifikationen und Netzwerkarchitekturen definierst du so, dass sie ambitioniert und zugleich umsetzbar sind und nahtlose Schnittstellen zu unserer Fahrzeugflotte gewährleisten Testszenarien und funktionale Validierungen entwickelst du - besonders an der kritischen Schnittstelle zu Kund*innen und Zertifizierungsstellen – und stellst so sicher, dass unsere Lösungen im echten Betrieb funktionieren Neue Technologien wie 5G, IoT und Starlink behältst du im Blick und übersetzt deine Erkenntnisse in konkrete Empfehlungen für die Technologie-Roadmap von FlixTrain Über Dich Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Bachelor- oder Masterstudium in Telekommunikation, Informatik, Elektrotechnik oder einem verwandten Bereich Mit mehr als zwei Jahren praktischer Erfahrung in Netzwerkarchitektur, WLAN-Systemen oder Mobile Device Management überzeugst du - idealerweise im Umfeld von Schienenfahrzeugen oder einer vergleichbar komplexen technischen Umgebung Ausgeprägte Problemlösungskompetenz zeichnet dich aus, ebenso wie nachweisliche Erfahrung im Troubleshooting komplexer Netzwerksysteme unter Zeitdruck Verantwortung übernimmst du gern: Du bringst Themen eigenständig zum Abschluss und leitest cross-funktionale Initiativen mit Menschen aus unterschiedlichen Teams und Disziplinen souverän Klar und überzeugend kommunizierst du mit technischen Expert*innen wie auch mit nicht-technischen Stakeholdern, ohne dabei an Präzision zu verlieren Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse bringst du mit, da du in einem internationalen Team arbeitest und mit deutschsprachigen Lieferanten und Behörden zusammenarbeitest Von Vorteil ist Erfahrung mit Lieferanten von Schienenfahrzeugsystemen sowie Vertrautheit mit dem vertraglichen, technischen und regulatorischen Umfeld der Bahnbranche Bei uns zählt der Blick auf das Ganze – auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen zu 100 % erfüllst, aber dennoch glaubst, etwas bewegen zu können, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung! Was Wir Bieten Reisevorteile: 12 kostenlose Flix-Gutscheine + 12 Rabattgutscheine für Freunde & Familie. Arbeiten von Überall: Je nach Rolle kannst du bis zu 60 Tage pro Jahr von einem anderen Standort aus arbeiten. Hybrides Arbeitsmodell: Wir sind ein Unternehmen mit Bürokultur, bieten jedoch Flexibilität, um Arbeit und Leben in Einklang zu bringen. Gesundheits- und Wohlfühlangebote: Zugang zu vertraulichen Einzelberatungen, Kursen und Stressbewältigungsmaßnahmen – für dich und bis zu vier Familienangehörige. Lernen & Entwicklung: Nutze Sprachkurse, Schulungen und Experten-Sessions, um deine Fähigkeiten auszubauen. Mentoring-Programm: Vernetze dich mit erfahrenen Kollegen, um Einblicke zu gewinnen und deine Karriere zu beschleunigen. Warum Teil von Flix werden? Bei Flix konzentrieren wir uns darauf, Reisen einfach, sicher und erschwinglich zu gestalten – sowohl für unsere Passagiere als auch für unsere Mitarbeiter. Hier geht es schnell voran, und es gibt viel Raum, etwas zu bewegen. Wir wachsen und entwickeln uns täglich weiter und suchen Menschen, die bereit sind, sich einzubringen und die Art und Weise, wie wir arbeiten, mitzugestalten. Wenn du einen Job suchst, in dem du wachsen und etwas bewirken kannst, dann bist du bei FlixTrain genau richtig. Hier kannst du Teil eines Teams werden, in dem dein Beitrag zählt und du deine Reise selbst gestalten kannst! Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Manager - Tax Data Analytics Engineer
description: About Wolt At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe. Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life. We are looking for an experienced Data Analytics Engineer to join our growing Tax Data Mart team. This role will be a key contributor to the team and will be responsible for building the tax data operations function for our Deliveroo and Wolt legal entities. This includes building and operating the data pipelines and infrastructure that power tax analytics and support decision-making across the company. As DoorDash continues to grow its global footprint across multiple business lines, we are looking for a candidate with experience working with Tax teams to gather requirements, and designing scalable data processes to support them.. This person will grow our unique community via your blend of tax, data technology, and process improvement experience. About the Role You will be reporting to the Senior Manager of Tax Data & Operations, and play an integral role in DoorDash's data function, owning the processes for ingesting, transforming, and controlling our data, ensuring accuracy, and making it available to analytics and business users. As a member of this team, you will lead the design, implementation, and operation of data pipelines and related processes to support the Company's exponential growth. What you'll be doing Lead the collection of Tax Data and Reporting requirements through close relationships with Tax team counterparts Design, build, and maintain scalable, reliable data pipelines (ETL/ELT) that serve data across the company Develop and optimize data models and warehouse structures to support analytics and reporting Participate in new business initiatives and identify their impact on existing data system(s) and processes. Work closely with Analytics, Data Science, and business partners in the development and validation of new data sources. Identify and document business, functional and technical requirements to support new business initiatives and to enhance existing system functionality. Leverage AI & AI assisted tooling to build and automate recurring data tasks & pipelines. Monitor data quality, reliability, and observability, and resolve data-related issues for our internal business partners. Participate in defining the Company's data tooling needs, including the maintenance of existing systems. Prepare documentation related to our data systems and processes. Share knowledge and best practices with engineers and analysts across the team. Our humble expectations You have 7+ years of experience in a Tax data & technology or similar role. Experience using Data Build Tool (DBT) or a similar product to manage data flows. Experience using Claude, Cursor and similar AI tools. You are an expert at using SQL with experience using Snowflake. Proficiency in Python (or a comparable language) for building data pipelines. Experience with modern data stack and orchestration tools such as Airflow, Spark, or Kafka. You have strong attention to detail and analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills. You're an independently motivated person with a proven ability to manage multiple projects and prioritize work independently. You have excellent written and verbal communication skills. Project management experience, including creation of project plans, milestones, and due dates. Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related degree. Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel. Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash . title: Senior Process Engieer
description: ABOUT US tozero is Europe’s leading deep-tech startup specializing in the recycling of lithium-ion batteries. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR We are looking for a Senior Process Engineer to take a leading technical role in the design, scale-up, commissioning and ramp up of our battery recycling processes. This role sits at the intersection of technology development, process engineering, and industrial scale-up. You will translate experimental and operational data into robust process designs, challenge engineering assumptions, and ensure that our future plants are built on solid fundamentals. Your focus will be on the processes that matter most to our technology — graphite and lithium extraction. By working closely with R&D, Operations and external engineering partners, you will actively lead and engage in activities associated with: a) engineering design; b) commissioning and ramp up; c) process development. We are looking for someone who is comfortable working in a production environment, but who can also take a step back and understand what the data is telling us, and engineer the process we need at different scales. WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT Must Have's: 1. Future Plant Design & Scale-up ● Own key process design activities for our next-generation plants. ● Develop and review PFDs, P&IDs, mass and energy balances, process descriptions and equipment specifications for future capacity expansions. ● Translate pilot and industrial operating data into reliable engineering design criteria and scale-up assumptions. ● Perform process calculations and equipment sizing to ensure our future plants are designed based on validated engineering data rather than theoretical assumptions alone. 2. Targeted Process Expertise & Optimization ● Become a technical reference for some of our most critical process steps. ● Apply strong chemical engineering fundamentals to the optimization of graphite and lithium extraction and post-processing. ● Identify the parameters controlling yield, purity and process stability and translate these insights into concrete process improvements. ● Work closely with R&D and Operations while maintaining a strong focus on process performance and technology development rather than daily troubleshooting. 3. Data Analysis & Process Modeling ● Turn plant data into engineering decisions. ● Evaluate operational and experimental data, build and validate mass balances and process models, and identify gaps between expected and actual process performance. ● Define what data needs to be collected to support future scale-up decisions. ● Technically guide data analysts and other engineering functions to ensure that models and analytics remain grounded in physical and chemical reality. ● Translate analysis into clear recommendations for process upgrades and future plant designs. 4. Commissioning & Process Validation ● Make sure what we designed actually works. ● Participate in FATs/SATs, commissioning activities and process performance validation for new equipment and plant expansions. ● Develop acceptance and process validation criteria based on the original design intent. ● Evaluate commissioning and operational data to confirm that installed systems achieve their calculated performance targets. ● Work closely with Operations during handover while ensuring clear ownership transfers once the process meets its design criteria. 5. Operational Readiness, Process Safety & SOPs ● Design processes that can be operated safely and consistently. ● Translate process design and engineering intent into clear Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), operating envelopes and process documentation. ● Participate actively in HAZOPs, LOPAs, and other process safety reviews, ensuring that process risks are identified and addressed during design rather than after installation. ● Support Operations in understanding the design basis and critical process parameters of newly commissioned systems. Nice-to-have's: Vendor & EPC Coordination ● Represent tozero's process requirements with external engineering partners and equipment suppliers. ● Prepare and review technical specifications, vendor proposals and engineering documentation. ● Challenge unsupported assumptions, identify over-engineered solutions and ensure equipment is correctly sized for our process. ● Support technical bid evaluations and equipment selection, balancing process performance, CAPEX, operability and scalability. ● Act as a strong technical counterpart to EPCs, engineering contractors and equipment vendors throughout project execution.
