title: Payroll Specialist
description: About Ledger We’re a team of experts pushing the limits of what’s possible, united by our common goal to unlock true freedom through digital ownership, making technology accessible for all. We believe in a world where users, creators and enterprises manage their value with ownership and freedom. Our curiosity drives us to innovate, empowering individuals on a global scale. We believe change is constant and our team moves forward as one, with a culture of problem-solving where every employee is empowered and supported to challenge tradition and create solutions. Our mission is simple: to make self-custody accessible and give people the keys to their own financial futures. If you want to make a true impact, we want you to join us at Ledger. At Ledger, we’re proud to be the global platform for digital assets and Web3, with over 20% of the world’s crypto assets secured through our Ledger devices. With our headquarters in Paris, and offices in Vierzon, Grenoble, Montpellier, London, Portland, Geneva, Zurich and Central Singapore, we have a team of around 600 professionals developing a variety of products and services to enable individuals and companies to securely buy, store, swap, grow and manage crypto assets – including the Ledger hardware wallets line with more than 7.5 millions units already sold in 200 countries. The team: You're joining as we reshape the People & Operations Experience team, which brings together ops, payroll, people tech, engagement and internal comms. That makes this a build-and-run role. You'll run payroll from day one and help design how the function works going forward, from processes to tooling to documentation. The role You'll take ownership of French payroll, starting with a proper handover from the colleague who runs it today and building towards running it independently. Alongside it, you'll look after the employee lifecycle: joiners, leavers and everything in between. It's real responsibility, with a team around you. Your development goes in two directions: continuous improvement of how People Ops works, and a progressive move into Global Payroll (US, UK, Singapore) as your confidence and scope grow. Your arrival also creates room for the whole team to take on bigger things, and that includes you. What you'll do Own French payroll Run the full monthly cycle: data collection, absences and leave, inputs, controls, validation and payslip checks Prepare and submit statutory filings on time (URSSAF, DSN, IJSS/Net-entreprise and other mandatory declarations) Manage variable pay and contractual changes, and build the VPI file for ADP Decidium Work with Finance on transfer files, cost reporting, headcount tracking and variance analysis Handle day to day equity payroll declarations (stock options / BSPCE) as you slowly build your expertise Manage benefits, meal vouchers and provider relationships Track regulatory changes and turn them into better processes Run the employee lifecycle Handle joiners and leavers: contracts, health insurance and transport registration, visa and absence data Keep Workday data accurate and compliant Help document and improve the processes being rebuilt, and contribute to cross-functional People projects You'll work with Finance, Talent Acquisition, HRBPs, C&B and our provider ADP. What you bring 2–3 years of French payroll experience, with hands-on exposure to the monthly cycle and a readiness to own it Solid knowledge of French social legislation (URSSAF, DSN) and experience with a payroll tool (ADP or similar) Rigour: you close the month on time, without being chased A builder's instinct: you document as you go and like making things work better Comfort working in English in a multicultural team Curiosity about international payroll and a real appetite to widen your scope At Ledger, we are dedicated to continually investing in our employees which is why we offer more than just salaries; we provide comprehensive compensation packages that include a wide range of benefits. Here are some of the benefits you can look forward to: Flexible work options - Our hybrid policy allows employees to work from home up to 3 times per week Health & Wellness support - Health and Life Insurance. Financial growth opportunities - Employees can become shareholders in Ledger as well as other financial benefits depending on your country of work. Commuter allowance - Ledger offers a commuter allowance to contribute to your preferred means of transportation. Learning & Development - A comprehensive suite of training solutions providing a personalised learning experience for every employee. For regionally specific benefits, your Talent Acquisition contact will be able to provide you with more information. We’re committed to building an inclusive hiring process. If you need any adjustments or accommodations, just let us know, we’ll do our best to support you. Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Technical Lead - AI Ops
description: At Brevo, we’re not just building a CRM. With our technology, we’re helping millions of organizations build lasting relationships with their customers. From emails and SMS to WhatsApp, Chat, and Marketing Automation, our tools are intuitive, powerful, and built to scale with every ambition. We give businesses a clear view of the customer journey, so they can focus on what matters: connection. As a certified B Corp , we’re proud to grow with purpose, committed to high standards of social and environmental impact, not just performance. Today, more than 500,000 businesses across 180 countries —from NGOs like Amnesty International to global brands like Carrefour, eBay, Louis Vuitton, and Michelin—trust Brevo to engage their audiences, cut through complexity, and deliver results. Our reliable technology and 75+ integrations help them create unparalleled customer experiences, without the usual tech headaches. We recently exceeded 200m ARR and reached a major milestone by becoming a Unicorn , backed by strong growth and global expansion - and we’re just getting started! The Role Brevo is transforming all of its operations to become AI native: We are redefining the way we work internally, the way we consume data (analytical and operational), the way we interact with each other. From customer support teams to RevOps, from Analytical engineer to finance team, all our jobs will be transformed and we becoming manages of agents. The AI Ops team drives this transformation: it builds and operates AI agents, applications, and the associated tooling, in production. We bring impact at high speed. We're looking for a Tech Lead to set the technical direction of AI Ops and lead the engineers who build it. You'll own the architecture of our agent platform and raise the bar on how we ship, while staying hands-on in the code. This is not a research-oriented role: we're looking for a builder with experience making systems work in production. Why join us ? A rare, AI-native playground: make a profitable scale-up's operations AI-native, with agents in production and visible weekly impact, backed by best-in-class tools (Claude, internal agentic tooling, dedicated observability) and an AI-assisted engineering culture. A fast paced organisation able to redefine itself quicker than any other Real autonomy: define problems with business teams, own solutions through to production. Your Impact at Brevo: Design, build, and operate AI agents in production. Integrate internal data to build relevant context accurately and in a controlled way (context engineering). Discover needs directly with business teams (CX, RevOps, Data), hand agents over in forward-deployed-engineer mode, and contribute to the architectural vision of the agent platform. Own the architecture of the solutions we build, and make the key technical decisions (multi-agent design, pre-processing, deterministic routing, LLM-as-judge, observability, human in the loop surface of interaction) Own deployment and operations: CI/CD, sandbox/production environments, monitoring, and agent observability. Set engineering standards for code quality, code review, evals, testing, and deployment. Make sure the team follows them. Mentor and grow the engineers on the team Who you are: Must-have: Proven tech lead experience: you've set the technical direction for a team, made architecture calls, and mentored engineers. Whole-system thinker: you challenge architecture decisions and weigh the business impact of technical choices. Comfortable with ambiguity: you turn a fuzzy problem into a shipped solution without a pre-written spec, and help your team do the same. DevOps-fluent: end-to-end deployment, infra-as-code, and debugging network environments (VPN, proxies). Agents & LLMs: hands-on experience shipping agents to production (ADK, LangChain, or similar), including applied prompt engineering and evaluation. You build with AI daily (Claude Code, Cursor, or equivalent) and push the team to do the same. Fluent in French and English. Nice to have: ADK v2 (Google Agent Development Kit) and the A2A protocol. Langfuse or an equivalent LLM observability tool. LLM cost optimization at scale (caching, routing, model selection). Our candidate journey: 30 min call with Talent Acquisition Vision & systems interview with the Chief Data and AI Officer Technical assessment Team meet-and-greet Why people love working at Brevo: A place to grow, together : Join an international team in a bright, collaborative office located in a vibrant neighborhood. Practical perks for everyday balance: RTT days off, 50% public transport reimbursement, Sustainable Mobility Package (whether you ride a classic bike or go electric, we support your choice to commute greener) and daily Swile meal vouchers (€ 12.50/day) . Learning, every step of the way: Access to English classes and 155,000+ courses on Udemy, plus a strong internal culture of knowledge-sharing and support. Flexible for life : A remote-friendly setup, budget to support your home workspace, and relocation assistance for international talents. Wellbeing that works : Top-notch private healthcare (70% covered), 6-week second-parent leave, extra time off if your child is sick and needs you, and Several services related to prevention, health and personal and professional well-being on Welii platform A culture that cares : From inter-office trips to regular team events, there are plenty of ways to connect beyond your day-to-day. You’ll also find active social, green, and LGBTQIA+ communities, plus Work Council benefits via Leeto, all here to support what matters to you, inside and outside of work. Whoever you are, wherever you’re from, if this role speaks to you, we’d love to hear from you. Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Demande Generation Manager
description: About Scality Scality builds data infrastructure software for enterprise AI, cyber resilience, and sovereign control at multi-petabyte to exabyte scale. Its AI Data Infrastructure platform reduces operational burden through AI-powered autonomous operations while aligning the right storage media, performance, and protection to each workload through human-approved lifecycle policies. Built on CORE5 cyber resilience and open-code principles, Scality software delivers extreme performance, operational simplicity, and sustainable economics. The world's most demanding enterprises and government organizations depend on Scality to power AI initiatives, defend critical data, and build infrastructure that lasts for decades. Recognized as a leader by Gartner, Scality is where AI remembers, learns, and thinks. F ollow us on LinkedIn. Visit www.scality.com and our blog. About the role Scality is looking for an experienced Demand Generation Campaign Manager to own our global campaign program. You plan, launch, and optimize the campaigns that generate qualified leads and opportunities across our enterprise and mid-market go to market in the Americas, EMEA, and Asia Pacific. This is a hands-on role for a marketer who thinks strategically. You take a pipeline target, decide how to reach it, and run the campaigns that get there. You hold yourself to the numbers: leads and opportunities generated, conversion by stage, cost per lead and per opportunity, and channel efficiency. Most of the work is digital. You also run the campaigns around our webinars, trade shows, and partner programs, from promotion to lead follow up. The main challenge is generating demand in a market that is changing fast. Buyers increasingly get their information from AI tools rather than the channels marketers have relied on, and gated content and volume downloads are losing their effect. This role needs the creativity to build demand where the old playbooks no longer work. You own the campaign function in an international marketing team. You work closely with the Head of Growth, who runs paid media, SEO, and web, and with marketing operations and nurture. You work with the AMER field marketing manager and the EMEA regional marketing team on campaigns for their events and partner programs, and with product marketing on messaging and assets. You also work with sales, SDR, and partner teams in every region. What you will be doing Own the global campaign plan and calendar, translating pipeline targets into integrated campaigns across paid social, paid search, email, webinars, content syndication, and account-based marketing Take each campaign from brief to launch: audience and targeting, offer, messaging with product marketing, landing pages and forms, promotion, lead routing, and reporting Run campaigns for webinars, trade shows, field events, and partner programs, from promotion before the event to lead follow up after Run the thought leadership and customer webinar program, from topic and speakers to registration, delivery, and follow up Work with the Head of Growth on paid media strategy, spend allocation, and experimentation across LinkedIn, Google, and new channels Build campaigns with marketing operations in HubSpot and Salesforce, and own campaign structure, naming, and attribution in Salesforce Own weekly and monthly lead generation reporting to marketing and executive leadership: leads and opportunities against goal, conversion by stage, cost per lead and per opportunity, and spend by channel and region Align with sales and SDR teams across regions on lead handoff, follow up, and pipeline acceleration Manage campaign budgets and agencies, and prioritize spend against pipeline impact Run experiments across audiences, offers, and channels to improve conversion and lower acquisition cost What you bring to the table Ten years or more of experience in lead generation, demand generation, or digital marketing, running integrated campaigns end to end International experience: you have run campaigns across several regions, ideally including the US, and understand how buyers and channels differ by market Experience in B2B enterprise software, ideally in storage, data management, backup, or adjacent data infrastructure markets A track record of campaigns that produced measurable pipeline, with the numbers to back it up Hands-on experience with paid social and paid search, and with webinar and event campaigns Strong command of HubSpot and Salesforce and of campaign analytics The ability to shape a plan from a pipeline target while staying hands on in execution The creativity to generate demand where buyers rely on AI over traditional channels and gated content no longer carries the funnel Native or near-native English, written and spoken. You write campaign copy for US and international audiences Comfort working with colleagues across time zones, with regular overlap with the US team in the afternoon Life at Scality We offer careers with an opportunity to bridge international borders, an intensely fun environment with smart people. We encourage promotion and elevation through training and development programs. We care for our employees through company supported programs such as sports and wellness programs, social responsibility programs, and generous benefits packages. We support team building and get together events across all of our locations around the world. Life at Scality is exhilarating. Our internal motto is: work hard, play hard, eat well and amaze the customer! Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

description: Qui sommes-nous ? Q ENERGY France est un acteur majeur du marché des énergies renouvelables en France. Autrefois affilié au groupe RES, l’entreprise œuvre depuis 27 ans dans le développement, la construction et l’exploitation de projets éoliens et photovoltaïques. Aujourd'hui également positionnée sur le marché du stockage d'énergie, Q ENERGY poursuit son expansion vers de nouveaux domaines afin de proposer des solutions intelligentes et complètes pour la production et la fourniture d’énergie durable en France. L'entreprise compte près de 300 collaborateur.rice.s et 6 agences sur le territoire ainsi qu'un siège social basé à Avignon. Q ENERGY France est une entreprise de la holding européenne Q ENERGY Solutions, créée en 2021 par Hanwha Solutions dans l'objectif de conduire à la prochaine génération de production d'énergie verte et flexible en Europe. Basée à Berlin, Q ENERGY Solutions est une société sœur de Q CELLS, fabricant de modules photovoltaïques reconnu à travers le monde. Les deux sociétés constituent la division Energie du groupe Hanwha Solutions, basé à Séoul. Vos missions : Rattaché.e au Responsable Asset Management and O&M, vous aurez pour objectifs d'analyser les performances des centrales éoliennes, photovoltaïques et de stockage et d'en garantir la fiabilité des données. Vos missions principales seront : Collaborer avec les gestionnaires d’actifs (Asset Managers) pour suivre et analyser les performances des parcs éoliens, photovoltaïques et des systèmes de stockage en exploitation. Garantir l’intégrité des données collectées, les analyser et les partager afin d’assurer une gestion efficace des tableaux de bord. Travailler avec les différents départements de Q ENERGY afin d’optimiser la rentabilité de nos projets éoliens, solaires et de stockage ainsi que la performance des centrales. Mettre en place des tableaux de bord automatisés à destination des parties prenantes. Administrer les bases de données et exploiter les outils MySQL et Power BI. Assurer le support dans la gestion quotidienne des données ainsi que dans la création des politiques et autorisations d’accès. Être responsable de l’historisation SCADA et des plateformes de supervision. Assurer la supervision des systèmes SCADA et des réseaux, réaliser les diagnostics SCADA, détecter les anomalies et les corriger pendant la phase d’exploitation. Être le référent technique pour toutes les questions liées au SCADA et à la gestion des installations éoliennes, photovoltaïques et de stockage en exploitation. Collaborer avec les équipes Développement, Achats et Construction afin d’améliorer les outils de suivi et de partager les bonnes pratiques. Participer à l’amélioration continue : fiabilité des installations, animation de groupes de travail. Assurer le suivi des obligations contractuelles du prestataire SCADA en phase d’exploitation. HSE : Contribution à la culture Santé, Sécurité et Environnement de l’entreprise via : Réalisation du travail dans le respect des mesures de prévention mises en place au sein de l’entreprise et reprises notamment dans le Document Unique, les Politiques Santé, Sécurité et Environnement, procédures, modes opératoires et guides Déclaration de tout événement ou situation pouvant représenter un danger pour les personnes y compris collègues et prestataires et/ou l’environnement Participation aux événements de formations et de sensibilisations traitant de ces thématiques Qualité : Respect et mise en œuvre de la politique d’entreprise et des procédures qualité Participation à la mise à jour des documents du système de management de la qualité Déclaration des non-conformités et participation à la mise en place d’actions correctives Participation aux actions et projets d’amélioration continue et de partage des savoirs Requirements Votre profil : De formation ingénieur généraliste, vous disposez de solides compétences techniques et aimez évoluer dans des environnements à la croisée de plusieurs expertises. Vous avez notamment de bonnes connaissances en automatisme, ainsi qu’en informatique et réseaux de communication. Des bases en électricité HT/BT vous permettent également de comprendre les principaux enjeux techniques liés aux installations. À l’aise dans les échanges, vous êtes reconnu.e pour vos qualités de communication, votre esprit d’équipe et votre capacité à travailler de manière autonome. Vous savez également prendre des décisions rapidement lorsque la situation l’exige. Un bon niveau d’anglais technique est attendu afin de pouvoir évoluer dans un environnement professionnel international. title: Head of Formal Verification (m/f/d)
description: Your mission You own the direction of our formal verification business. Our managers keep delivery predictable. You decide what the organisation becomes. You report to the CEO and are a member of the executive leadership team. You carry the FV consulting business as a whole — where it goes, how it performs, who leads it — and you answer for it. You will not solve verification problems, and you will rarely run a project or an account yourself. Concretely, you own: Direction . The roadmap for FV consulting. Which capabilities, markets and problem domains we pursue, and what we decline. Customers. You are the face of LUBIS EDA to our key accounts and at executive level. You open the doors your managers cannot, and you carry the conversations that decide a long-term relationship. Organisation . Structure, standards, playbooks, talent pipelines, and the career framework in practice. You keep improving how we work, and you decide when a new technology — AI among them — changes the way we deliver. Leaders . Our Verification Managers report to you. You hire them, develop them, and grow the bench behind them. This is the main measure of the role. Quality . Holding the quality bar under commercial pressure. Our entire positioning depends on it. Product interface . What our engineers learn on customer projects is the best input our software roadmap gets. Your profile You have developed leaders, not "only" engineers. You have set direction where there was no precedent, made the calls, and carried an organisation with you. You build systems that outlast your attention. You need credibility in formal verification. Not to overrule your senior engineers. You need it to make the calls only you can make: is a capability gap real, is a quality standard achievable at the price we quote, does a bet on a new formal domain hold. YOUR EXPERIENCE 12+ years in semiconductor verification, EDA or adjacent engineering services. 5+ years in leadership, including managers reporting to you. Fluent in formal methods and their trade-offs. Credible with a customer’s engineering leadership and on a conference stage. You know how technical services are priced and defended on quality rather than volume. Nice-to-have: you have scaled a technical organisation past start-up stage, where the systems had to be built. Why us? LUBIS is growing, and we’re looking for a Head of Formal Verification. This is one of those roles where you don’t just join an organisation. You help build it. Our formal sign-off business is growing. Our customers are getting bigger. So are our ambitions. We’re looking for someone who wants real ownership of what comes next: how we develop our people, how we deliver outstanding projects, how we work with our customers, and what world-class technical consulting at LUBIS should look like. You’ll work directly with our leadership team. You’ll have the freedom to shape structures and standards. You’ll build an organisation around some of the strongest formal verification expertise in the market. We’re not looking for someone to maintain what already exists. We’re looking for someone who gets excited about making it better, bigger and more professional. If you want a leadership role with real influence, and the chance to build something you’ll be proud of, come build it with us. Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: People Analytics Data Engineering Intern (Winter/Spring 2027)
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: Austin Texas</strong></p> <p><strong>Internship Details: 3 days in office (12 week internship, January - May)</strong></p> <h3><u>About the Role</u></h3> <div> <p>Cloudflare's People <span class="il">Analytics</span> organization transforms enterprise workforce data into a governed, trusted source of truth that informs company-wide reporting, regulatory compliance, and AI-enabled decision support. As a Data Engineering Intern, you'll help build and extend a modern data warehouse that unifies HR, recruiting, and performance systems, and contribute to an AI-powered <span class="il">analytics</span> agent allowing stakeholders to query workforce data in natural language.</p> </div> <div> <p>This position suits a candidate with an understanding of SQL and data modeling principles, and an interest in data governance, quality assurance, and the responsible application of artificial intelligence within enterprise systems. The intern will collaborate closely with our data engineering team and cross-functional business partners, gaining practical experience in cloud-based data warehousing, ELT pipeline development, and applied AI infrastructure.</p> </div> <div> <h3><u>What You'll Build & Do</u></h3> </div> <div> <ul> <li><strong>Data Pipeline Development:</strong> Design, develop, and implement ELT pipelines to integrate additional enterprise data sources into a centralized cloud data warehouse.</li> <li><strong>Data Governance: </strong>Support the implementation of historical data retention frameworks, automated data lifecycle management policies, and ongoing data quality validation processes to ensure warehouse accuracy and regulatory compliance.</li> <li><strong>Data Quality Assurance:</strong> Conduct root-cause <span class="il">analysis</span> to identify and remediate data integrity issues, including calculation discrepancies and record inconsistencies.</li> <li><strong>AI-Enabled <span class="il">Analytics</span> Support: </strong>Contribute to the expansion of the semantic data layer underlying an internal AI <span class="il">analytics</span> platform, ensuring new capabilities are delivered in a manner that safeguards sensitive personal information.</li> <li><strong>Cross-Functional Collaboration: </strong>Partner with stakeholders across People Operations, Compensation, Talent Acquisition, and Engineering to translate business requirements into scalable, reliable data solutions.</li> </ul> </div> <div> <h3><u>Qualifications</u></h3> </div> <div> <ul> <li>Currently enrolled in a graduate program in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Statistics, or a related discipline</li> <li>Demonstrated proficiency in SQL; working knowledge of Python and cloud-based data warehouse platforms (e.g., BigQuery) preferred</li> <li>Strong interest in data governance, information privacy, and the responsible deployment of artificial intelligence systems</li> <li>Excellent attention to detail and a demonstrated ability to methodically identify and resolve data quality issues.</li> </ul> </div><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2>Available Locations: Austin, TX, Dallas, TX, New York, NY </h2> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>The Pre-Sales Customer Engineering organization owns the technical sale of the Cloudflare solution portfolio, ensuring maximal business value, fit-for-purpose solution design and adoption roadmap for our customers. Customer Engineering is made up of individuals from a wide range of backgrounds - from Financial Consulting to Product Management, Customer Support to Software Engineering, and we are serious about building a diverse, experienced and curious team. </p> <h4><strong>What you'll do as a Solution Strategy Lead</strong></h4> <p>Scaling Cloudflare’s most complex and critical accounts requires unparalleled focus. While Client Directors own the commercial relationships and Customer Engineers drive pre-sales, this role serves as the essential strategic link bridging the two. As a dedicated trusted advisor for 1–5 of our highest-value accounts, you will take a deeply consultative approach to map the customer's entire technical ecosystem. You will drive enterprise-wide transformation from initial strategic positioning through the complete customer lifecycle.</p> <p>You are the single thread connecting high-level strategy to flawless execution, orchestrating cross-functional teams to deliver exceptional outcomes. While not a "hands-on-keyboard" engineering role, you possess the technical acumen to proactively steer complex engagements and step in decisively when it matters most.</p> <h1><strong>Platform Focus Areas</strong></h1> <p>Accelerate ARR growth by orchestrating parallel expansion motions across three distinct platform domains.</p> <h2><strong>App Modernization</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Scope: </strong>Migration from legacy application architectures to Cloudflare's edge platform. Includes moving workloads from on-premise or hyperscale compute to Workers, consolidating storage on R2, and modernizing data layers with D1 and Durable Objects, all while considering security posture.</li> <li><strong>Stakeholders: </strong>VP Engineering, Platform Architects, Infrastructure leads, CISO</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Developer</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Scope: </strong>Adoption of Cloudflare's developer platform for new application development. Workers, Workers KV, Pages, Queues, Durable Objects, R2, D1. Positioning Cloudflare as the compute and storage layer for net-new projects.</li> <li><strong>Stakeholders: </strong>VP Engineering, Developer Experience leads, Platform teams</li> </ul> <h2><strong>AI</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Scope: </strong>Adoption of Cloudflare's AI infrastructure for inference and orchestration. Workers AI, Vectorize, AI Gateway. Positioning Cloudflare as the AI inference layer at the edge.</li> <li><strong>Stakeholders: </strong>CTO, Head of AI/ML, Data Platform leads</li> </ul> <h1><strong>Core Accountabilities</strong></h1> <table> <tbody> <tr> <td> <p><strong>Accountability</strong></p> </td> <td> <p><strong>Description</strong></p> </td> </tr> <tr> <td> <p><strong>Platform Adoption Roadmapping</strong></p> </td> <td> <p>Develop account-specific adoption plans across App Modernization, Developer, and AI. Map customer workloads to Cloudflare capabilities. Define sequencing and milestones.</p> </td> </tr> <tr> <td> <p><strong>Cross-Functional Coordination</strong></p> </td> <td> <p>Coordinate SE, CS, and Product resources against adoption milestones. Run account team operating rhythm. Ensure internal alignment on customer priorities.</p> </td> </tr> <tr> <td> <p><strong>Technical Executive Relationships</strong></p> </td> <td> <p>Build relationships with CTOs, VPs of Engineering, and Platform Architects. Engage technical decision-makers on platform strategy. CD retains procurement and CFO relationships.</p> </td> </tr> <tr> <td> <p><strong>Expansion Development</strong></p> </td> <td> <p>Identify and qualify platform expansion opportunities. Hand off to CD when commercial-ready. This individual builds the case; CD closes the deal.</p> </td> </tr> <tr> <td> <p><strong>Voice of Customer to Product</strong></p> </td> <td> <p>Bring strategic customer requirements into Product roadmap discussions. Provide quarterly briefings on adoption patterns, blockers, and feature needs.</p> </td> </tr> </tbody> </table> <h1><strong>Success Metrics</strong></h1> <h3><strong>Platform Adoption</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Products per account: Number of Cloudflare products in production per strategic account</li> <li>Developer platform adoption: Strategic accounts with Workers, R2, or D1 in production</li> <li>AI adoption: Strategic accounts with Workers AI or AI Gateway in production</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Revenue Influence</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Expansion pipeline: Dollar value of platform expansion opportunities developed and handed to CD</li> <li>Net Revenue Retention: NRR on strategic account portfolio (shared metric with CD)</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Product Feedback</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Requirements submitted: Strategic customer requirements brought to Product quarterly</li> <li>Adoption blockers resolved: Product or engineering issues addressed that were blocking adoption</li> </ul> <h1><strong>Customer-Facing Positioning</strong></h1> <ul> <li>To customer executives, this role helps them realize value from Cloudflare's entire platform:</li> <ul> <li>An expert and trusted advisor; peer to their architects and technical leads</li> <li>Focused on Platform adoption and business outcomes, not transactions</li> <li>Turns platform capabilities into production workloads and business value</li> </ul> </ul> <h3><strong>The Profile</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Architectural Command:</strong> 10+ years of experience in Customer Engineering Leadership, Product Management, Consulting, or Technical Strategy within a global SaaS or infrastructure environment.</li> <li><strong>Executive Presence:</strong> Exceptional communication skills with the ability to influence C-level executives and internal product leads simultaneously.</li> <li><strong>Relentless Curiosity:</strong> A natural obsession with "How it works" and "How it could be better." You are comfortable in high-pressure, ambiguous environments.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Desirable skills, knowledge and experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>7+ years of deployment experience in similar role or experience in a technical leadership role</li> <li>Previous experience as a Customer Engineer leader, consultant or technical marketing engineer building, architecting or deploying security solutions</li> <li>Good understanding of AI, security challenges and its applicability to today’s enterprise landscape</li> <li>Proven track record using AI to help drive revenue</li> <li>Strong knowledge of Security Architecture, Design and Operations</li> <li>Working knowledge of the broader threat landscape and the ability to distill technology trends, and explain complex behaviors in simple terms</li> <li>Proven experience working with customers and partners in successful design and deployment of solutions</li> <li>Ability to juggle and successfully drive projects with customers, prospects, and partners.</li> <li>Experience with cloud computing solutions implementations including Microsoft 365, Azure, Google, AWS</li> </ul> <h2>Compensation</h2> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location. <br>This role is eligible to earn incentive compensation under Cloudflare’s Sales Compensation Plan. description: About Quandela: Quandela is a global leader in quantum computing, designing, building, and delivering cutting-edge quantum solutions for research and industry. Its offerings include the most energy-efficient quantum computers for data centers, full-stack quantum computing solutions accessible via the cloud, and algorithm access services for academic and industrial customers. Following a pragmatic, step-by-step roadmap, Quandela has been deploying industrial-grade systems since 2023 while developing future generations of fault-tolerant quantum computers capable of scaling through the integration of thousands of photonic components. Quandela is committed to making quantum computing accessible to all in order to address the most complex industrial and societal challenges. Learn more at: Quandela | Leading Photonic Quantum Computing Solutions Our ambition is to build large-scale fault-tolerant quantum computers capable of solving problems beyond the reach of classical computation. Getting there will require several generations of intermediate architectures. Choosing the right ones means understanding what can be built, what these systems can compute and how efficiently they can do so. About this position: You will join Quandela’s Quantum Information team within Architecture , working on the evaluation and design of our near- and mid-term quantum architectures. Your role will sit between quantum theory, computational capability and real hardware constraints . You will develop methods to evaluate architecture concepts, understand their performance and limitations, and help guide future architecture choices. Depending on your background, you may draw on complexity theory, quantum learning theory, quantum-system characterisation, benchmarking or related areas . You will work closely with our Device Physics, FTQC and Q.Algorithms Team. Requirements What you'll do: As a Quantum Information Scientist working on Architecture & Performance, you will: Evaluate and compare the capabilities and limitations of near- and mid-term quantum architectures. Draw on methods from complexity theory, benchmarking, characterisation and related fields to assess different architecture designs. Incorporate realistic noise, native operations and physical constraints into your analyses. Investigate when and how different architectures could provide meaningful computational capabilities or advantages. Develop scientific models and numerical tools to explore architecture-performance trade-offs. Study how architecture choices interact with algorithms, resource requirements and QEC strategies. Progressively propose and lead new research projects around architecture design and performance. You will work across our Architecture team and Algorithms and Applications team, connecting questions from the physical layer to computational capability and potential applications. - How you'll grow: During your first 3–6 months Become familiar with Quandela’s technologies, architecture roadmap and ongoing research while contributing to existing evaluation and performance studies. Within 1 year Take increasing ownership of architecture studies, compare different concepts and bring your own scientific perspective to the team. Longer term Lead exploratory research projects, propose new architecture directions and contribute to shaping Quandela’s future architecture roadmap. -- What we're looking for: We are looking for a scientist with a strong theoretical background in quantum computing, scientific autonomy and an interest in connecting different layers of the quantum-computing stack. Must-have PhD in Quantum Information, Quantum Computing, Physics, Mathematics, Computer Science or a closely related field. Strong expertise in one or more relevant areas, such as quantum complexity theory, quantum learning theory, quantum-system characterisation, performance analysis or quantum algorithms. Experience connecting theoretical or computational questions with realistic implementation, hardware or experimental constraints. Ability to assess the capabilities and limitations of quantum systems or architectures. Experience with scientific modelling, numerical simulation and Python-based scientific computing. Scientific autonomy and ability to structure open-ended research problems. Collaborative and personable, with the ability to communicate ideas clearly to people from other fields of expertise. Professional English. Important, but you can grow here Quantum Error Correction and early fault-tolerant architectures. Hardware-aware algorithm or architecture design. Quantum benchmarking and performance metrics. Noise modelling. Resource and computational-cost analysis. Collaboration with experimental or hardware-oriented quantum-computing teams. Bonus Quantum compilation or native-gate-aware circuit design. Photonic quantum computing. Resource estimation. Experience comparing quantum approaches against strong classical baselines. Previous ownership of collaborative research projects. You do not need to cover every topic above. We welcome both candidates with postdoctoral or equivalent industrial R&D experience and strong recent PhDs demonstrating scientific autonomy. Benefits Join a growing quantum-computing company and contribute directly to the research behind future generations of quantum architectures. Explore open scientific questions grounded in real hardware constraints. Work across Quantum Information, Device Physics, FTQC and Algorithms. Take ownership of broad and exploratory research projects. Contribute to the scientific directions of a growing team. Plus: Competitive compensation aligned with your experience and level of responsibility. Company savings plan. 100% health coverage through Alan. Transport reimbursement or sustainable mobility bonus. Swile meal vouchers. Access to Gymlib. Process Talent Acquisition interview, 30–45 min Interview with Quantum Information hiring manager, 30-45 min Presentation of previous research work and discussion with members of the theory team Reference checks Technical discussion based on a scientific paper or research topic Offer For the technical exercise, you may be asked to explore scientific material outside your direct area of expertise and discuss how you would connect it to a broader architecture problem. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. To make that happen, a complex orchestra of IP address configuration and distributed systems need to be in harmony to deliver packets from users, through our edge network and then onwards to our customers origin servers or networks.</p> <p>On the Addressing team, you will architect, program, and maintain core software services that enable large corporate networks to be protected by Cloudflare. Recent projects range from IP conservation efforts, supporting use cases for Policy driven IP address assignment, designing traffic engineering tools that improve the quality of service for billions of users around the world, and building customer APIs to control BGP dynamically.</p> <p>The Addressing team works closely with our system reliability engineers, network engineers  and product engineering teams to build automated systems that span the entire Cloudflare stack.</p> <h3>About the role</h3> <p>We are looking for talented Software Engineers to join our small but growing team. You will work on a range of microservices written mainly in Go. You’ll be designing and developing new APIs and data models to manage our rapidly expanding addressing needs.</p> <p>The ever growing suite of Cloudflare products and services means our addressing tools are always evolving. You will have the opportunity to take on very impactful projects critical for Cloudflare. You will spend time learning the inner workings of our edge routers, servers, DNS and IP provisioning pipelines. You will work closely with other engineers to understand their needs and create scalable platforms to be used across the company.</p> <p>Some of the technologies we use include Go, PostgreSQL, Docker, Kafka, Lua, Clickhouse, SaltStack, Prometheus and the usual Unix/Linux tools and workflows. We strive to build reliable, fault-tolerant systems that can operate at Cloudflare’s scale.</p> <h3>Examples of desirable skills, knowledge, and experience</h3> <ul> <li>You are naturally curious and willing to take a step to learn something you don’t have experience in</li> <li>You lead. We are a growing team and you will have a huge role shaping our products, tools and system designs from the ground up</li> <li>You have experience writing high-quality code in one or more system programming languages (Go, Python, C/C++)</li> <li>You have experience with modern Unix/Linux development and runtime environments</li> <li>You have a solid understanding of TCP/IP and basic networking in general</li> <li>You have a basic understanding of the HTTP/S/TLS stack</li> <li>You have a working knowledge of SQL and relational databases such as PostgreSQL or MySQL</li> <li>You have experience building and operating distributed systems</li> <li>You have excellent debugging skills and attention to detail when breaking down problems</li> </ul> <h3>Bonus Points</h3> <ul> <li>Experience working with Go</li> <li>Experience working with Rust</li> <li>Familiarity with UI design, workflows and implementation</li> <li>Familiarity with anycast or multi-site unicast networks</li> <li>Knowledge of DNS and DNS based traffic management techniques (e.g geo DNS)</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. title: Key Account Manager — Treasury Expert
description: About Agicap Créée à Lyon en 2016 par trois entrepreneurs français, Agicap est l'une des scale-ups avec la plus forte croissance d’Europe, avec plus de 8 000 clients, 600 employés et une croissance rapide du chiffre d'affaires (multiplié par 7 entre 2021 et 2024). Agicap fait partie du French Tech 120, qui récompense les startups les plus prometteuses de France. Agicap permet aux directions financières des entreprises de taille intermédiaire de gérer et de prévoir efficacement leur trésorerie, de payer leurs fournisseurs et de se faire payer. En combinant un système de gestion de trésorerie avec des solutions de gestion des comptes fournisseurs et des comptes clients sur une seule plateforme, Agicap ambitionne de devenir la nouvelle référence en matière de gestion de trésorerie pour les entreprises de taille intermédiaire. Nous avons levé 145 millions d’euros depuis notre création, auprès de fonds de capital-risque prestigieux tels qu’AVP, Greenoaks, Partech et BlackFin, avec un dernier tour en novembre 2024. Ces ressources supplémentaires alimentent encore davantage notre innovation produit, nous permettant de croître significativement et d’accélérer notre expansion internationale à travers le monde. Nous sommes convaincus que notre succès réside dans nos équipes passionnées et dévouées, engagées à bâtir une entreprise où chacun peut évoluer et construire sa carrière. Nous sommes constamment à la recherche de nouveaux talents, visant l’excellence et prêts à rejoindre notre aventure ambitieuse ! Home page Customer Stories Our Values ⚡️ Le rôle Agicap est en pleine phase de scale-up : nous signons chaque mois de nombreux nouveaux clients, et développer et fidéliser nos clients existants est désormais tout aussi important. L'expansion et le churn font partie des premiers indicateurs suivis par notre board. En tant que Key Account Manager, vous êtes responsable d'un portefeuille d'environ 150 comptes mid-market : des entreprises de plus de 50 M€ de chiffre d'affaires, souvent des groupes multi-entités, des sociétés en hypercroissance ou détenues par des fonds de private equity. Vous travaillez avec des DAF, directeur·rices financier·ères, trésorier·ères, responsables comptables et parfois des CEO. Ce qui rend ce poste unique : vous apportez une vraie expertise en trésorerie. Vous ne vous contentez pas de comprendre les enjeux des équipes finance (maîtriser les prévisions de trésorerie, améliorer la performance financière, assurer la gestion quotidienne des paiements et de la liquidité, gérer la relation bancaire, intégrer et piloter toutes les entités d'un groupe) : vous savez les challenger. Vous êtes un·e véritable conseiller·ère de confiance pour vos clients. Vous rejoignez une équipe de 7 KAM qui a obtenu d'excellents résultats cette année, avec un fort esprit d'équipe et des objectifs ambitieux. 🎯 Vos missions 🤝 Construire des relations solides avec les décideur·ses finance Instaurer une relation de confiance avec les décideur·ses de vos comptes et cartographier toutes les parties prenantes clés, souvent sur plusieurs entités Comprendre leur contexte business, leur organisation trésorerie, leurs process et leurs priorités, et les challenger avec les bonnes pratiques adaptées Gérer les frictions et les situations complexes avec assurance 📈 Développer votre portefeuille Définir et piloter une stratégie de développement pour chaque compte : upsell, renouvellement, contrats pluriannuels, recommandation Identifier de nouvelles opportunités : nouvelles entités, nouveaux cas d'usage, évolutions dans l'organisation ou le contexte business du client Mener des découvertes et des démos produit centrées sur les cas d'usage trésorerie, construire des business cases et négocier les offres Porter vos objectifs mensuels d'expansion et de rétention 📊 Démontrer la valeur et sécuriser la rétention Animer des Executive Business Reviews (EBR) pour vous aligner sur les enjeux stratégiques du client et mesurer son retour sur investissement Détecter tôt les signaux faibles de churn et sauver les comptes à risque Suivre et analyser votre performance avec votre manager pour progresser en continu 🔗 Être la voix de la trésorerie chez Agicap Trouver le bon équilibre entre la mise en avant du produit et le bon timing : notre produit évolue vite, à vous de fixer les bonnes attentes avec vos clients Identifier les besoins d'activation ou de paramétrage et les transmettre à l'équipe Onboarding Partager vos retours terrain avec les équipes CS et Produit pour améliorer nos process et notre produit 👀 Votre profil Vous avez une solide expertise en trésorerie / cash management, acquise en direction trésorerie, en conseil, en banque ou chez un éditeur de logiciels trésorerie / finance Vous savez expliquer et challenger des sujets comme les prévisions de trésorerie, le BFR, le cash pooling, la connectivité bancaire ou la consolidation multi-entités Vous avez fait vos preuves dans un rôle client avec des objectifs commerciaux (account management, upsell, renouvellements ou business development), et vous savez mener une bonne découverte Vous êtes à l'aise avec des décideur·ses finance exigeant·es et vous savez conduire des négociations complexes Vous êtes moteur de votre propre montée en compétences : résilient·e, vous aimez résoudre des problèmes et vous vous remettez en question en permanence Vous êtes à l'aise dans un environnement qui va vite, où tout n'est pas encore parfait Vous avez un fort esprit d'équipe et vous aimez partager vos connaissances Vous parlez couramment français et anglais ⭐️ Bonus : une expérience sur un TMS ou un ERP (Kyriba, SAP, Sage, Cegid…), une connaissance de l'environnement SaaS, Proactively monitor customer health scores and telemetry to ensure rapid time-to-value, resolve integration bottlenecks, and reduce deployment risk.</li> <li><strong>Commercial Accountability & Expansion: </strong>Carry a variable quota tied directly to new business acquisition and/or ongoing account growth. Lead technical Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to translate platform capabilities into return on investment for C-level executives.</li> <li><strong>Trusted Advisory: </strong>Act as a trusted technical advisor throughout the entire customer lifecycle, maintaining a continuous, deep relationship with key stakeholders from initial onboarding through maturity, renewal, and expansion. title: Senior Customer Engineer, Strategic Pursuits, APAC (Based in Singapore)
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h4>Available Locations: Singapore</h4> <p><strong>What you will do </strong></p> <p>The Strategic Pursuits Customer Engineer (CE) is a trusted technical advisor and strategic partner to a focused portfolio of Cloudflare’s most important accounts. You will work alongside account teams and senior customer stakeholders to understand each organization’s business priorities, technology landscape, and long-term transformation agenda—and translate them into measurable outcomes with Cloudflare.</p> <p>This role combines deep technical credibility with strategic account leadership. You will shape multi-year technical strategy, connect Cloudflare’s platform capabilities to enterprise-wide initiatives, and orchestrate the right Cloudflare resources across sales, product, support, services, and leadership. You will guide customers from discovery and technical validation through adoption, value realization, renewal, and expansion, while building durable relationships across engineering, security, infrastructure, product, and executive teams.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Strategic account technical leadership:</strong> Own technical relationships and account strategy for a focused portfolio of strategic customers; align architecture and engagement plans to customer priorities and Cloudflare opportunities.</li> <li><strong>Executive and stakeholder partnership:</strong> Build trusted relationships with technical and executive leaders; lead strategic discussions, briefings, workshops, and reviews that connect technology decisions to business outcomes.</li> <li><strong>Enterprise architecture and transformation:</strong> Design Cloudflare architectures and phased roadmaps for complex environments, identifying cross-platform opportunities and dependencies.</li> <li><strong>Opportunity shaping and technical validation:</strong> Lead discovery and technical validation with account teams, including solution narratives, demonstrations, proof-of-concept plans, and resolution of complex objections.</li> <li><strong>Adoption, value realization, and risk:</strong> Coordinate internal teams and partners to support deployment, track customer outcomes, and address adoption risks—without replacing implementation owners.</li> <li><strong>Commercial outcomes and expansion:</strong> Connect adoption to retention, renewal, and expansion; identify cross-sell opportunities and contribute technical insight to account and commercial planning.</li> <li><strong>Cross-functional orchestration and customer advocacy:</strong> Mobilize Cloudflare experts around customer priorities, represent customer needs internally, and share product feedback.</li> <li><strong>AI and workflow improvement:</strong> Use AI and internal tools responsibly to improve research, analysis, documentation, and routine work.</li> <li><strong>Enablement and reusable knowledge:</strong> Develop and share technical resources, architecture patterns, workshops, and lessons learned for use across strategic accounts.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Requirements</strong></p> <ul> <li>Significant customer-facing technical experience supporting large, complex enterprise or strategic accounts.</li> <li>Ability to build lasting technical and executive relationships, influence decisions, and coordinate cross-functional teams.</li> <li>Skill in designing and explaining enterprise network, application, and security architectures, including trade-offs and migration considerations.</li> <li>Deep knowledge of Cloudflare’s product suite and the wider security, networking, and cloud landscape.</li> <li>Strong discovery, listening, facilitation, and presentation skills; able to communicate with engineers and C-suite leaders.</li> <li>Understanding of enterprise sales cycles, account planning, SaaS value realization, renewals, and expansion.</li> <li>Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or advanced technical degree preferred.</li> <li>Willingness and ability to travel extensively for strategic engagements and industry events.</li> </ul> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

title: Sales Enablement Manager - France
description: À propos de Lexroom Chez Lexroom , nous développons l'état de l'art de la recherche juridique agentique. Notre plateforme décompose chaque question juridique en sous-questions précises, puis mobilise des agents spécialisés pour explorer en parallèle les codes, jurisprudences, doctrines et textes européens. Chaque source est minutieusement analysée, les liens implicites entre principes sont identifiés, et toutes les informations sont synthétisées dans un rapport structuré, avec chaque affirmation soigneusement sourcée. Ce qui, auparavant, demandait une semaine à une équipe se réalise désormais pendant une pause café. Notre mission : rendre le droit plus rapide, plus clair et plus fiable, afin que les avocats et les directions juridiques puissent se concentrer sur l'essentiel. Nous construisons l'équipe commerciale en France, et nous cherchons la personne qui va la former, l'accompagner et la faire monter en compétence à travers la Lexroom Sales Academy. Pourquoi rejoindre Lexroom ? Un produit qui tient ses promesses : nos démos sont impactantes et convainquent dès la première session, pas besoin de six mois de POC. Un marché en pleine effervescence : tous les cabinets français recherchent une solution IA, et les usages sont encore à inventer. Un avantage concurrentiel fort : vous ne formez pas des commerciaux à vendre un assistant IA de plus, mais une approche radicalement nouvelle que les prospects n'ont jamais vue. Un impact direct : la qualité de l'équipe commerciale française dépendra de ce que vous construisez. Vos responsabilités Piloter la Lexroom Sales Academy en France : concevoir et animer des programmes de formation récurrents (onboarding, ramp-up, formation avancée), avec objectifs, contenus, calendrier et indicateurs de succès. Gérer l'onboarding des nouvelles recrues commerciales : première semaine et deux premiers mois de ramp-up, en coordonnant agendas, supports, intervenants internes et exercices pratiques. Animer vous-même les modules de formation : méthodologie de vente, discovery, démos, traitement des objections, négociation, gestion du pipeline, avec role-plays, coaching sur les appels et feedback structuré. Maintenir les contenus à jour : playbooks, scripts, templates et supports de l'Academy, en phase avec l'évolution du produit, du marché et des performances de l'équipe. Transformer les succès internes (appels, emails, séquences, deals complexes) en ressources de formation réutilisables. Travailler main dans la main avec les Sales Managers et les AE pour que la formation se traduise concrètement dans le pipeline, les appels et les démos. Aligner l'Academy France avec les initiatives globales et adapter au marché français les best practices déjà éprouvées en Italie. Profil recherché Expérience en management commercial, sales enablement ou gestion de projet en environnement B2B (idéalement SaaS, tech ou conseil). Solide mindset PMO : capacité à transformer des besoins en plans structurés, aligner les parties prenantes, tenir les délais, livrer et mesurer l'impact. À l'aise aussi bien en animation (formations, ateliers, role-plays) que dans le travail de détail sur les process, les contenus et les métriques. Excellentes compétences en communication, résolution de problèmes et collaboration transverse. Très opérationnel : vous ne vous contentez pas de concevoir des programmes, vous participez aux appels, analysez les chiffres et itérez vite. Français natif, anglais courant (équipes internes internationales). Intérêt pour le droit : une expérience dans le secteur juridique ou des services professionnels est un plus, mais pas indispensable. Ce que nous offrons Rémunération fixe: 80 k€ brut annuel + variable sur objectifs Equity Mutuelle Alan, titres-restaurant, accès Wellpass (sport et bien-être) Travail hybride, bureaux à Paris Team retreats et off-sites Processus de recrutement Entretien Talent Acquisition : motivation et parcours. Entretien avec le hiring manager : expérience en enablement et approche pédagogique. Mise en situation : conception et animation d'un module de formation. Entretien final : valeurs et culture. Offre. Compensation: €80K • Offers Bonus • €80K • Offers Bonus Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Product Manager, Healthcare (H/F)
description: Withings est une entreprise française pionnière de la santé connectée. Depuis 2008, nous concevons des produits et services qui permettent à chacun de mieux comprendre sa santé et aux professionnels de santé de mieux accompagner leurs patients. Balances connectées, montres, tensiomètres, dispositifs médicaux et services digitaux : nos technologies sont aujourd’hui utilisées par des millions de personnes et s’intègrent de plus en plus au parcours de soin. Nous cherchons aujourd’hui un(e) Product Manager Healthcare pour contribuer au développement de nos produits et services de santé, notamment autour du Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM), du suivi des maladies chroniques et de nouveaux parcours de soin digitaux. Vos responsabilités Comprendre les besoins des patients, médecins et équipes de soin et les transformer en solutions simples et efficaces. Concevoir de nouvelles fonctionnalités Healthcare, en particulier autour du Remote Patient Monitoring et du suivi des maladies chroniques. Développer des outils permettant aux professionnels de santé de mieux exploiter les données Withings, de gagner du temps et d'améliorer la qualité du suivi patient. Imaginer des parcours patients favorisant l'engagement, l'éducation thérapeutique et l'adoption de comportements favorables à leur santé. Définir la vision produit, les priorités et la roadmap en collaboration avec les équipes Engineering, Design, Medical, Data et Business. Définir et suivre les KPI permettant de mesurer l'utilisation et l'impact réel des fonctionnalités développées. Étudier le marché, les usages et les évolutions du secteur de la santé digitale afin d'identifier de nouvelles opportunités. Transformer rapidement des idées en prototypes afin de les confronter aux utilisateurs avant d'investir dans leur développement. Nous recherchons un profil capable d'aller au-delà de la définition fonctionnelle d'un produit. Les outils d'IA générative transforment profondément la manière de construire des produits. Nous attendons du Product Manager qu'il sache les utiliser pour accélérer son travail : explorer une idée, analyser des données, créer un prototype fonctionnel, automatiser certaines tâches ou tester une expérience utilisateur. L'objectif n'est pas seulement de produire des spécifications mais d'être capable de rendre rapidement une idée tangible, afin de mieux collaborer avec les utilisateurs, les designers et les ingénieurs. Requirements Profil recherché Formation Bac+5, idéalement école d'ingénieur ou formation scientifique/technique équivalente. Environ 3 ans d'expérience ou plus, idéalement dans un environnement produit ou technologique exigeant. Solide culture technique et réelle envie de comprendre comment les produits fonctionnent. Forte sensibilité produit et design : capacité à simplifier des problématiques complexes et à concevoir des expériences intuitives. Maîtrise des outils d'IA générative, notamment pour créer rapidement des prototypes, développer des fonctionnalités ou automatiser certaines tâches. Capacité à prototyper et à manipuler des outils techniques ; savoir coder ou avoir déjà développé des projets personnels est un vrai plus. Intérêt marqué pour la santé, la médecine, la santé digitale et les nouvelles technologies. Forte capacité analytique et aptitude à utiliser la donnée pour prendre des décisions produit. Excellente capacité à collaborer avec des équipes multidisciplinaires : Engineering, Design, Medical, Data et Business. Autonomie, curiosité et capacité à évoluer dans un environnement rapide où de nombreux sujets restent à inventer. Excellente maîtrise du français et de l'anglais, à l'écrit comme à l'oral. Benefits Rejoindre l'aventure Withings, c'est : Intégrer l'un des pionniers et leaders mondiaux de la santé connectée, plusieurs fois primé au Consumer Electronics Show. Contribuer à des projets innovants et ambitieux visant à construire la santé de demain. Travailler dans un environnement international avec des équipes basées notamment à Issy-les-Moulineaux, Boston, Hong Kong et Shenzhen. Participer directement à l'amélioration de nos produits et services, notamment en les testant avant leur lancement. Approfondir ses connaissances médicales grâce à la Withings Med Academy et aux interventions régulières de professionnels de santé. Bénéficier de nombreux avantages : Stock Options, smartphone et ordinateur de votre choix, restaurant d'entreprise, avantages culturels et sportifs, et bien plus encore. Et surtout, rejoindre des équipes passionnées qui cherchent à avoir un impact concret sur la manière dont la santé sera suivie et prise en charge demain. Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Deal Intelligence Analyst
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: </strong>Lisbon </p> <hr> <h4><strong>About the Deal Desk Team</strong></h4> <p>The Deal Desk team is a critical component of the Finance function, serving as a trusted advisor to critical internal stakeholders as deal architect working on structuring, negotiating, approving and closing large complex commitment deals while balancing margin preservation, compliance, and velocity. We are committed to building a data-centric and AI-augmented Deal Desk that leverages predictive analytics and automated workflows to optimize pricing in real-time and automate routine approvals, allowing for deeper strategic focus.</p> <p><strong>Role Summary</strong></p> <p>As a Deal Intelligence Analyst, you will be the analytical engine driving our transition to a data-centric and AI-augmented Deal Desk. Sitting within the Finance function, you will design the data systems and executive dashboards that allow our deal architects to analyze complex deal terms, protect margins, and close large, complex commitment deals with unprecedented velocity.</p> <p>This role is designed for a "full-stack" analyst. You won't just be querying pre-cleaned data—you possess the technical skills to build the pipelines that feed your insights. You will leverage Cloudflare's Developer Platform (Workers, R2, D1, Workers AI) alongside standard data warehousing tools to extract raw CRM and CPQ data, integrate it into AI workflows, and deliver actionable insights that directly impact margin preservation and our global growth.</p> <p><strong>What you’ll do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build Advanced Dashboards & Analytics: Design and maintain executive dashboards and self-serve reporting systems that provide real-time visibility into deal terms, discount thresholds, win/loss rates, and margin performance across all regions.</li> goals.</li> <li>Develop Data Pipelines: Apply your data engineering skills to build and maintain data cleansing tools that help refine data from Salesforce, CPQ, and billing systems, transforming it into clean, usable semantic models.</li> <li>Power AI Workflows: Assist in integrating structured deal data into Deal Desk tools to help automate routine approvals and surface real-time pricing or building predictive models.</li> <li>Proven experience designing analytical data models; domain expertise in financial and SaaS metrics (e.g. margins, discount rates, ARR, NRR) is a strong plus</li> <li>Strong programming skills in Python (or TypeScript) with hands-on experience building ELT/ETL pipelines, interacting with APIs, and cleaning raw data.</li> <li>Experience designing computing/serverless architectures (Cloudflare Workers, R2, D1).</li> <li>Expertise, or interest in learning, CRM data structures (especially Salesforce custom objects), CPQ complexities, and the quote-to-cash lifecycle.</li> <li>Solid communication skills with the ability to bridge the gap between technical data systems and operations.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice-to-Have Skills</strong></p> <ul> <li>Background working closely with Deal Desk, Finance, RevOps or Sales Strategy teams at a high-growth SaaS or technology company is a plus</li> <li>Strong programming skills in Python (or Google Cloud Platform or other analytics databases</li> </ul> <p>If you're excited by fast-paced innovation, dedicated to driving global growth, and want to help build a better internet, we'd love to hear from you.</p> <p><strong> </strong></p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale As the only enterprise finance platform that unifies financial and operational data, embeds AI, and extends to meet changing business needs, we're empowering some of the world's leading organisations to Take Finance Further. We believe finance leaders need more than traditional Corporate Performance Management (CPM) tools.
